tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /grub mtha' kun shes nas mtha' bral sgrub pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos rnam par bshad pa legs bshad kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /
༄༅/ /grub mtha' kun shes nas mtha' bral sgrub pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos rnam par bshad pa legs bshad kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /grub mtha' kun shes nas mtha' bral sgrub pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos rnam par bshad pa legs bshad kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

na mo mañdzu shrī ye/ grub mtha' kun shes nas mtha' bral sgrub pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos rnam par bshad pa legs bshad kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ rje btsun bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge legs gser gyi gzhi las 'thon/ /sku bzhi'i bang rim mngon par mtho/ /phrin las gzi 'od mu mtha' med/ /thub dbang lhun por gus phyag 'tshal/ /skal bzang blo mun mthar byed cing*/ legs bshad pad mo'i tshal skyong ba/ /mkhyen brtse'i gzi 'od mchog gi mchog /'jam mgon bla ma'i nyin byed rgyal/ /gang gi drin las bdag blau'i dpal| /sprin bral nyi ma ltar gsal bas/ /thub bstan pad tshal rgyas phyir du| |legs bshad gzi 'od 'di spro'o/ /'dir phan bde mtha' dag gi gter chen po rgyal ba'i bstan pa la ma rtogs pa dang log par rtogs pa dang the tshom gyi rab rib dang ldan pa dag gi rmongs pa drung nas phyung ste/ yang dag pa'i lam dri ma med pa la 'god par 'dod nas bstan bcos 'di brtsams so/ /de yang mtshan gyi don ni rgya gar skad du zhes sogs te/ 'phags yul du sbyar ba dngos ma yin yang rjes su mthun pas/ de ltar smos pa tshad ma rigs pa'i gter la sogs pa bzhin no/ / gzhung gi don la/ bshad pa la 'jug pa ni/ grub pa zhes sogs tshigs su bcad pa gcig ste/ rkang pa gnyis kyis mchod par brjod pa dang gnyis kyis bshad par dam bcas so/ /de la grub pa ni sa'i ming ste/ mdo sde rgyan las/ mtshan nyid gang zag bslab pa dang*/ /phung po grub pa rtags dang ni/ /nges pa'i tshig dang thob pa yis/ /gnas pa dang ni sa nyid do/ /zhes mdor bstan dang*/ grub pa dag kyang ma grub dang*/ /grub pa dag tu yang 'dod do/ /zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs la/ phyogs gzhan nas kyang grub pa chung ngu dang 'bring dang mchog gi rnam gzhag gsungs pa las ches mchog tu gshegs pas na grub pa'i mthar phyin te rang don mthar phyin pa'o/ /rang gi rtogs pa gzhan la smra ba ni drang srong ser skya dang rkang mig la sogs pa yang yin mod kyi brjod bya'i don la 'khrul ba dang bcas pa yin la/

sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kho na 'khrul med du gsung ba po yin pas smra ba rnams kyi gtso bo dang*/ 'chad par 'gyur ba'i grub mtha' thams cad kyang rgyal ba'i gsung rab las 'byung bas na/ grub mtha' kun gsung ba po thub pa'i dbang po la bstan bcos rtsom pa'i thog mar spyi bos 'dud pa ni/ dam pa'i spyod pa dang mthun zhing skabs kyi bya ba mthar phyin pa'i ched du bsod nams khyad par can sgrub pa ste/ lha las phul byung gi bstod par/ snying nas dad dam ji ltar dga' ba dang*/ /the tshom gyis sam gzhan gyi ngor yang rung*| |gang zhig thub dbang la ni phyag byed pa/ /des ni lha yi bde sogs phun sum 'thob/ /ces dang sangs rgyas la dmigs pa'i bsod nams gzhal du med pa sogs mang du gsungs te yi ge mang du dogs pas mi spro'o/ /dam bca'i rgyu mtshan ni/ spyir rang dang gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pa ni dam pas bsngags pa'i yon tan yin pa'i phyir dang*/ rgyal sras rnams kyis mi bslabs pa'i/ /dngos de gang yang yod ma yin/ /zhes sogs dang*/ ye shes rgyas pa'i mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa' bstan bcos thams cad la mkhas par bya'o/ /de la mkhas na thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du zhugs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes sogs dang*/ byang chub sems dpas bslab par bya ba'i rig pa'i gnas bco brgyad kyi nang na/ grangs can dang bye brag pa'i bstan bcos kyang yod pa'i phyir dang*/ jo bo chen pos/ ngang pas chu las 'o ma len par ltar/ /rang gi 'dod pa dang du blang bar gyis/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rang gi 'dod pa yang dag pa'i lta ba tshol na yang*/ dbu ma'i gzhung lugs mtha' dag gi phyogs snga ma shes na de ji ltar 'gog tshul mi shes shing de lta na rang gi lta ba lhan skyes 'gog par mi nus te/ lta ba dang grub mtha' thams cad ni lhan cig skyes pa'i blo dang bstun nas gzhag pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /bshad pa nye bar dgos pa la/

bdag lta'i 'dzin stangs spyir dgag pa dang*| so sor dgag pa'o/ /dang po la/ rang gzhan gyi khyad par bshad pa dang*/ gzhan la sdang zhugs spang ba/ blang dor bsdus te bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ dmigs pa dang 'dzin stangs sogs kyis phye ba'i sna tshogs pa'i lta ba dang grub mtha'i dbye ba ni rnam pa shin tu mang ste/ slob dpon sman pa'i zhabs kyis/ lta ba lnga brgya bdun cu bshad pa dang*/ slob dpon snang bral gyis| lta ba sum brgya drug cu rtsa gsum bshad pa dang*/ mdo sde tshangs pa'i dra ba las| lta ngan drug cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ dad pa cher 'byung gi mdo las 'byung ba mngon pa kun las btus su drangs pa las/ dam pa min pa'i lta ba nyi shu rtsa brgyad gsungs pa dang*/ gzhan yang*/ lung ma bstan gyi lta ba bcu bzhi/ pha rol smra ba bcu drug 'jig lta nyi shu la sogs pa dang*/ yang dag pa'i lta ba la yang dbye ba mang du gsungs pas so/ /de ltar gdod ma nas phyi pa'i rig byed dang nang pa'i gsung rab las 'byung ba mang yang gdod ma nas grub pa'i lta ba de dag smra ba po'i gang zag ni shin tu rigs mi mthun pas gzhag pa rang sde sangs rgyas pa dang gzhan sde mu stegs pa ste rang gzhan gyi sde par 'dus te/ gnyis yin dang gnyis ma yin gyi phung po gsum pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang rgya gar na lha min gyi chos ni gnyis ka ma yin par spyan ras gzigs kyis gsungs pa ni gdod ma nas yod pa min gyi/ rā ma ṇa la sogs pas gsar du sbyar la*/ bod na yang sangs rgyas par mi gtogs pa dang*/ gtogs kyang lung rigs ltar snang gis bran du bkol te/ grub mtha' bzhi'i nang du ma 'dus pa mang du byung ba rnams kyang de bzhin no/ /'o na phyi nang gi khyad par gang zhe na/ lta ba rang rkya thub pa'i bdag yod med du smra ba tsam gyis ma yin te/ rang sde gnas ma bu pa dang bon gyis ma nges pas so/ /sgom pa zhi lhag cha mnyam pa'i ting nge 'dzin khyad par can med pa dang yod pas ma yin te/

mu stegs la bsam gtan dang gzugs med kyi dngos gzhi'i ting nge 'dzin dang mngon shes la sogs pa yod pas so/ /spyod pa sems can la 'tshe ba yod med kyis ma yin te/ gcer pu dang sbyor sgrol chos su smra bas ma nges pa'i phyir ro/ /'bras bu thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa thob byar byed pa dang mi byed pas ma yin te/ mu stegs grangs can dang gcer pu pa sogs kyang de 'dod pas so/ /des na phyi nang 'di gnyis so sor 'byed pa'i khyad par byed chos ni bzhi yin te/ lta ba dang sgom pa dang spyod pa dang 'bras bu rnams tha dad pa'i phyir te/ lta ba bka' btags kyi phyag rgya bzhi dang*/ sgom pa srid rtse'i gnyen po dang spyod pa ngal zhing dub pa'i mtha' dang 'dod pa bsod snyoms kyi mtha' ste/ mtha' gnyis po spong ba dang*/ 'bras bu'i thar pa spang bya zad pa'i bral ba khyad par can 'gog bden du ste re re la yang 'dod pa dang*/ mi 'dod pa rnams so| |phyag rgya bzhi ni/ chos kyi sdom bzhir grags pa ste/ 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag zag bcas thams cad sdug bsngal/ chos thams cad bdag med/ mya ngan las 'das pa ni stong zhing zhi ba'o/ /zhes mdo las gsungs pa'o/ /'o na 'dul ba lung las/ gnyis pa mi 'byung zhing*/ 'od ldan du yang*/ phyag rgya gsum dang yang dag ldan/ /zhes bshad pa ci zhe na/ gang mi rtag pa de sdug bsngal du gsungs pas dang po'i shugs kyis go ba la dgongs so/ /rang sde bye smrar gtogs pa 'ga' zhig bdag 'dod cing skad cig gis mi 'jig pa'i 'dus byas khas len pa yang yod mod/ phung po las don gzhan bdag rtag par mi 'dod cing*/ gtan 'jig mi srid pa'i rtag dngos su khas mi len pas mu stegs dang khyad par che'o/ /srid rtse'i gnyen po ni mu stegs la med de/ bdag med bden pa'i rnam pa can gyi lam las rgyab kyis phyogs shing*/ gong na sa gzhan med pas zhi rags kyi rnam pa yang med pa'i phyir te/

mkhas mchog dpa' bos/ khyod kyi bstan la mi phyogs pa'i/ /skye bo gti mug gis ldongs pa/ /srid rtse'i bar du song nas kyang*/ /sdug bsngal yang 'byung srid pa sgrub/ khyod kyi bstan pa'i rjes 'brang ba/ /bsam gtan dngos gzhi ma thob kyang*/ /bdud kyi mig ras btsa' bzhin du/ /srid pa rnams ni 'dor bar byed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro| |spyod pa'i skyon ni mtha' gnyis su lhung ba ste/ rnyed bkur la chags pas/ ngan pa dang nyung ngus mi chog par bzang po dang mang po 'dod zhen gyis sgrub cing spyod pa dang*/ rang tshul khrims rnam par dag pa dang ldan/ bdag med kyi lta bas dngos 'dzin rags pa las grol ba zhig gis/ sgrub pa'i tshe chos la gnod pa'i 'bad rtsol mi dgos/ spyod pa'i tshe chags zhen dang mngon zhen drag po mi skye na bzang zhing mang ba spyod pa la yang bag 'khums mi dgos kyang*/ de ltar byed pas lus sems gdung ba gnyis ni/ rim pa bzhin rgyang 'phen pa dang gcer bu pa la gtso bor yod la/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis ni/ gos dang zas dang gnas mal dang sman te gnas bzhi po mtha' gnyis su ma lhung ba la bslab par nan gyis gsungs pas so/ /'bras bu thar pa yang bshes springs du/ sa chu me rlung nyi zla bral thob mdzod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar rgyang 'phen ni/ 'byung bzhi sems dang bcas pa dang*/ de dang bral ba gnyis 'khor 'das su 'dod pas/ thar pa dang 'byung bzhi'i gzhi mthun 'dod la/ ne tsos nyi mar btol nas ni| |thar par mchis par bshad ces grag /ces sogs nyi zla thar par 'dod pa dang*/ gcer bu pas/ nam mkha'i dbyings na thar pa gdugs bkan pa lta bur 'dod pa sogs kyis thob bya'i thar pa la rmongs pas thob byed lam la yang rmongs la/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa ni/ thar pa'am mya ngan las 'das pa 'gog bden du bzhed pas so/ /de dag ni 'thad mod kyi/ dkon mchog gsum las gzhan la skyabs su 'gro ba phyi rol mu stegs kyi 'jog byed du kha cig 'dod pa yang 'thad do zhe na/

de lta na bod kyi gshen rab rjes 'brang dang bcas pa rnams der 'gyur la 'dod mi nus te/ bdag med kyi rnam gzhag rgyas par khas len la bdag med dang phyag rgya bzhi 'dod pa'i mu stegs ni mi srid pas 'di ni blos btags gnyis min du rigs so/ / gnyis pa gzhan la sdang zhugs spang ba ni/ lta ba smra ba phal cher rang lta la mchog tu bzung nas gzhan la sdang smras kyi ser ba 'bebs la| khyad par dbu ma chen po par khas 'che ba dag gis/ shing rta chen po dag la yang gshe na/ phyi rol pa la lta ci smos/ rang gi rjes 'jug dag gis kyang rang lugs la gus shing 'dzin skyong spel gsum byas pas mi chog gi gzhan phyogs la sdang smras ma byas na bstan pa ma bzung bar 'dod pa dag ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bzhed pa ma yin te/ 'jig rten na phugs kyi phan pa dang 'phral gyi bde ba mtha' dag ni rgyal ba'i phrin las kho na yin te/ 'bras bu de ni rgyu dge ba med par mi 'byung la/ dge blo phra mo tsam yang sangs rgyas kyi mthu las 'byung dgos pa'i phyir te/ spyod 'jug las/ ji ltar mtshan mo mun nag sprin rum na/ /glog 'gyu skad cig bar snang ston pa ltar/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas mthu yis brgya lam na/ /'jig rten bsod nams blo gros thang 'ga' 'byung*/ /zhes sogs mdo dang sngags las mang du gsungs pa'i phyir/ mu stegs kyi sgras brjod rigs la dbye na/ ming btags pa dang der sprul pa dang*/ rang rgyud pa'i mu stegs te dbye ba gsum yod pa'i phyir te/ lang kar gshegs pa las/ ji srid sems ni 'jug pa'i bar/ /de srid 'jig rten rgyang 'phen yin/ /zhes rnam rtog ma zad kyi bar la rgyang 'phen gyi sgras gdags par gsungs shing*/ bden smra'i mdo las/ yid bzhin nor dang mching bu phrad gyur pa/ /bden pa'i tshul du nam yang 'byung ba med/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas rin chen mu stegs can/ /zhing gcig tu ni nam yang 'byung ba med/

/mu stegs can sgo 'di kun bsam gtan dang*| |mngon shes dbang sgyur thabs mkhas yin shes kyis/ /shes rab thabs kyi spyod pas blo ldan rnams/ /rnam par 'phrul ba sna tshogs ston par byed/ / ces dang*/ rab tu zhi ba rnam par nges pa cho 'phrul gyi mdo las kyang*/ seng ge chen po'i mdun du ri dwags phra mo mi gnas pa bzhin du/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdun du mu stegs gnas par mi nus mod kyi/ sems can smin par bya ba'i don du de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis byin gyis brlabs pa ni ma gtogs so| |zhes zab mo'i lam la dngos su bkrir mi rung ba dag rim gyis gzhug pa'i phyir du/ sangs rgyas dang byang sems mang pos/ de'i ston par sprul nas rig pa'i sgo du ma ston par gsungs la/ de dag gi gdul bya mang po rang rgyud pa yin pa la dgongs nas ni/ chos 'di las phyi rol tu gyur pa la dge sbyong gi tshul dang 'phags pa'i lam med do zhes dang*/ kun tu rgyu klan ka tshol ba'i bsam pas 'ongs pa de dag la dkar po'i chos gcig tsam yang ngas ma mthong ste| zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ phyogs 'dzin ni nyes pa kun gyi 'byung gnas yin pa'i phyir te/ zhe sdang lta bu'i sdig pa med/ /ces sogs dang*/ yid kyi nyes pa rang bzhin gdug pa ste/ /zhes sogs dang*/ rang gi lta la chags dang de bzhin du/ /gzhan gyi lta la 'khrul gang rtog pa nyid/ /ces sogs mang du gsungs shing*/ sde dang ris su chad pa'i 'khrul long gis 'jig rten mtha' dag rgud par 'gyur ba mngon su gyis mthong ba'i phyir ro/ /de ltar na sdang zhugs tshul gyis rang sde ston pa gcig gi bstan pa la tshangs pa'i spyod pa mtshungs par spyod pa dgalta spyod kyi cha phra mo re tsam mi mthun pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas phan tshun smod pa lta zhogaston pa dang bstan pa la rgyab kyi phyogs pa'i gzhan sde'ang smad du mi rung bas gnas 'di la gzab par bya'o/

/gsum pa/ blang dor bsdus te bstan pa la/ mdor bstan ni/ rang dang gzhan gyi grub mtha' smra ba'i dbye ba rnam pa mang yang blang bya dang dor bya'i tshul gyis bsdu na gnyis su 'dus te/ rtag chad gang rung gi mtha' sogs su 'dus pa'i phyir te/ rgyu mtshan ni blo lhan skyes 'khrul pa'i 'dzin stangs sgrub par byed pa dang 'gog par byed pa gnyis su 'dus pa'i phyir ro/ /mtshan gzhi ni/ klu sgrub zhabs kyi lugs las gzhan pa rang gzhan gyi sde pa dngos por smra ba rnams dang dpal mgon 'phags pa'i lugs de nyid do/ /de yang rtog dpyod dang ldan par rlom pa thams cad kyang*/ rang rang gi blo thog ma med pa nas rjes su zhugs shing 'phral gyi 'khrul rgyus ma bslad pa 'di la gang snang ba thams cad ni snang ba ltar don la grub pas yul bden pa dang blo tshad mar bzung nas lta ba dang grub mtha' 'jog pa sha stag yin la lhan skyes kyi rig rgyun 'dzin stangs spros pa thams cad dang bral ba yul gyi gnas tshul dang blo'i snang tshul shin tu mthun pa zhig skye bo thams cad kyi rgyud la thog ma med pa nas rang chas su gnas pa ni/ glo bur dri mas sprin dang rnyog pas bsgṛbs nas mngon du ma gyur cing*/ gsung rab phal cher las gsungs kyang sbas la/ cha dang zur gyis cung zad smos pa rnams la ni/ blau gros rno zhing gsal bar khas 'che ba dag gis sgro 'dogs dang skur 'debs kyi lta ba du ma'i 'khrul gzhir gyur te rnam pa sna tshogs su smra bar byed do/ / rgyas par bshad pa ni/ lhan skyes 'khrul ma 'khrul gnyis kyi dang po 'khrul ba'i 'dzin stangs dpang du btsugs nas grub mtha' 'jog pa'ang phyi sogs 'dus te/ rtog pa 'khrul ba'i 'dzin stangs rtag pa dang gcig pu dang cha med du 'dzin pa 'dis ji ltar bzung ba ltar grub par rlom nas phyi rol pa'i grub mtha' dang*/ rtog med lhan skyes 'khrul pa'i 'dzin stangs kyis ji ltar bzung ba la 'phral gyi gnod pa ma mthong bas rgyu byas nas rang sde'i grub mtha' bzhag pa'i phyir ro/

/dang po phyi rol pa la grub mtha' smra ba shin tu mang yang*/ mtho ris dang thar pa gnyis ka'am gang rung re re mi 'dod pa'i chad smra dang 'dod kyang rgyu byed pa po rtag dngos dang cha med sogs khas len pa'i rtag smra gnyis su 'dus te/ nye ba mngon sum la snang tshod las gzhan pa med par 'dzin pa dang*/ ring ba gtan tshigs ltar snang la brten pa'i lkog gyur blos btags la bden par 'dzin pa'i dbye bas so/ /gnyis pa rang sde la sde pa bco brgyad sems tsam rnam bden rdzun sogs mang yang phyi don smra ba dang sems tsam pa gnyis su 'dus te/ mngon sum gzhan rig phyi rol rgyang chad du 'dzin pa 'di la gnod pa can gyi tshad ma ma mthong nas ji ltar snang ba ltar don dam du grub par 'dod pa dang*/ de las blo mchog tu gyur pas de la gnod pa mthong yang kha nang ltas myong rig tsam du snang ba 'di la gnod pa gang yang ma mthong zhing 'khor lo tha ma phal cher gyis de ston par mthong nas snang ba shes rig tsam du 'dod pa'i dbye bas so/ /de ltar lhan skyes 'khrul pa dpang du btsugs nas grub mtha' 'jog pa po phyi nang de dag ni/ 'khrul pa la 'khrul pa bsnan nas rtag chad gang rung gi mthar sogs lhung ste lhan skyes 'khrul ba'i 'dzin stangs lung rigs ltar snang la brten nas bden zhen gyis 'bad pas bsgrubs nas lhan skyes kyi sa bon drung bo lung rigs kyi brlan dang drod kyis bskyangs te lta ba kun brtags kyi ljonashing rgyas par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /des na de dag ni gol sa bcad pa'i phyir dang de'i rigs can drang ba'i phyir du bslabs par bya ba yin pas sdang zhugs kyis 'dor bar mi bya yang rang rang mchog tu bzung nas gong ma'i khyad par mi 'tshol ba ni spang bar bya la| 'phral dang yun du blang zhing spyad par bya ba'i yul dang yul can yongs su rdzogs pa ni lugs gzhan las mi rtogs te/ 'khrul sogs nas rtogs shing yul can sogs nas gsungs pa'i phyir ro/

/de ltar na rang nyid 'khor ba las thar pa tsam don du gnyer bas kyang klu sgrub zhabs kyi lugs ni nges par bslab par bya zhing*/ lugs mtha' dag la ma sbyangs kyang re zhig gi dgos pa 'grub mod kyang*/ de yang mthar thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam la bslab dgos pa ni/ mthar thug theg pa gcig tu sgrub pa'i lung rigs kyis legs par grub pas sems can 'dor ba'i blo ni sgo du ma nas 'dor dgos la/ sems can rjes su 'dzin na ni/ phyi nang gi gzhung lugs mtha' dag 'dor du mi rung ba dang mthar ma thug gi bar du chog par mi 'dzin pa dang*/ phyi nang gi bstan pa mtha' dag rgyal ba'i thabs mkhas kyi phrin las su shes nas dag snang phyogs med du 'byongs pa'i dad pa khyad par can dang*/ dngos bstan la yang khyad med du bzung nas blun dad kyis rmongs par byas pa min par/ legs bshad nyes bshad 'byed pa'i blo gros rtsal je rgyas su song ba gnyis 'gal ba med pa'i blang dor gyi gnad dam pa chos spaung gi nyes chen 'gog cing*/ mchog dman la nges pa 'drongs par man ngag sgo du ma nas btsal bar bya'o/ /de ltar dngos por smra ba'i lta ba thams cad kyang lhan skyes 'khrul ba la brten nas gzhag par bshad pa 'dis ni/ lhan skyes dang kun brtags gnyis 'dzin stangs gtan mi mthun par 'dod pa dang*/ kun brtags 'gog pa'i rigs pas lhan skyes mi khegs par 'dod pa'i log rtog chen po gnyis legs par bkag ste/ 'dzin stangs kyi gtso bo mthun par bstan cing*/ kun brtags kyi zhen yul sun phyung bas lhan skyes la shin tu gnod par bstan pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan du na gnod pa mang ste/ grub mthas blo ma bsgyur ba'i gang zag la nang ning dang da lo'i bdag gcig tu 'dzin pa dang*/ shar dang nub tu phyin pa'i bdag gnyis ril po cha med du 'dzin pa med par thal ba dang shing rta chen po dag gis bshad pa'i kun brtags kyi grub mtha' chen po dag la 'khrul gzhi med par thal ba dang*/

gzhung lugs chen po rnams su kun brtags kyi lta ba'i zhen yul 'gog pa'i rigs pa 'ba' zhig gsungs pa rnams don med du thal ba'i phyir ro/ / 'o na/ bdag med rtogs tshe rtag pa'i bdag spong zhing*/ /'di ni ngar 'dzin rten du'ang mi 'dod pa/

/de phyir bdag med shes pas bdag lta ba| |dpyis kyang 'byin zhes smra ba shin tu mtshar/ /rang khyim rtsig phug sbrul gnas mthong bzhin du/ /'di na glang chen med ces dwogs bsal te/ /sbrul gyi 'jigs pa'ang spong bar byed pa ni/ /kye ma gzhan gyis gnam bor 'gyur nyid do| |zhes kun brtags kyi zhen yul med par rtogs pas lhan skyes la mi gnod par gsungs pa ci zhe na/ kun brtags kyi zhen yul de lhan skyes ngar 'dzin gyi rten nam yul du mi 'dod na skyon de yod par gsungs pa'am/ lung rigs ltar snang gis brtan par byas pa'i kun brtags kyi bdag de ngar 'dzin lhan skyes kyi rten du dgos na/ bskal ba mang por dud 'gror skyes pa sogs lhan skyes mi srid par 'gyur ba'i skyon yod pa la dgongs pa'o/ /grub mtha' kun shes las le'u dang po rgya cher bshad pa'o// // bdag lta'i 'dzin stangs so sor dgag pa la/gang zag gi bdag dgag pa dang*/ chos kyi bdag dgag pa'o/ / dang po la/ phyi rol pa'i 'dod pa spyir bstan pa/ so sor bshad pa/ zhar byung gzhan yang dgag pa dang*/ thun mong du dgag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ phyi rol sogs tshigs bcad gcig ste/ spyir sems can gyi rigs ni shes bya'i gnas tshul dang 'jig rten phyi ma phan chad ky-i ngang tshul la rtog dpyod gang yang mi 'jug par tshe 'di'i bde sdug gi blang dor tsam don du gnyer ba ni ngan song gi 'gro ba gsum dang lha mi phal che ba yin la/ de dag 'bum phrag tsam gyi nang na de dag la rtog cing grub mtha' la zhugs pa ni re re tsam du zad do/ /de dag kyang 'og ma 'og ma ni ches mang la/ gong ma gong ma ni ches nyung ste jo bo chen pos/ deng sang rgya gar na mu stegs kyi grub mtha' la mkhas pa brgya brgya'i tshe na bye brag tu smra ba'i grub mtha' shes pa re re/ de brgya brgya na mdo sde pa re re/ de brgya brgya na sems tsam rnam bden pa re re/

de brgya brgya na rnam rdzun pa re re/ de brgya brgya na dbu ma rang rgyud pa re re/ de brgya brgya na zla ba grags pa'i lugs shes pa re re tsam las med ces gsungs pa ltar ro| |de ltar na phyi rol rgyang 'phen gyi grub mtha' shes pa yang sems can gyi rigs ni shin tu nyung bar snang ste/ mir skyes pa tsam yang shin tu dkon pas so| |de la phyi rol pa'i nges tshig ni/ bstan pa 'di dang ston pa 'di las phyi rol tu phyogs te/ 'jig rten pa'i shes rab kyi shes bya'i don la dpyod par byed pa yin lugs kyi mya ngan las 'das pa dang rjes su mthun pa'i lam med pa'o| |'on kyang de la cung zad nye bar gyur pas thar pa'i mu dang stegs la gnas pas mu stegs zhes bya bas na 'jig rten phal pa las ni ches mchog tu gyur te/ shes bya'i gnas lugs dpyod pa la sogs pas so/ /mtshan nyid ni/ lta sgom spyod 'bras bzhi'i sgo nas sangs rgyas pa'i bzlog mthar gnas pa'i grub mtha' smra ba po'o/ /rtsa ba'i dbye ba ni/ bod kyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po rig pa'i ral gris/ de 'dra'i mu stegs rang rgyud la/ /bsam gtan pa dang rtog ge gnyis/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bsam gtan pa dang gzugs med kyi mngon shes lnga ldan te/ ji skad du/ drang srong chen po lnga mngon shes/ /mkha' la ring du 'gro ba yang*/ gang du 'chi ba yod min pa'i/ /go 'phang der ni 'gro ba med/ /ces bshad pa ltar ro/ /de yang ye shes rgyas pa'i mdo dang rtog ge 'bar ba sogs nas bsam gtan pa blo dman 'bring mchog gsum gyis bskal pa sum cu dang drug cu dang dgu bcu rjes su dran par bshad la/ de 'dra ba rnams ni 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas byung zhing*/ rtog ge pa yang spyir de dang 'dra mod kyi 'chad 'gyur gyi grub mtha' phal cher ni bskal pa 'di nyid la byung ba'o/ /de yang rtog ge 'bar bar/ drang srong mchod 'os zhes bya bas rang gi 'khor grangs can pa la sogs pa rnams la blos btags pa'i grub mtha' sna tshogs byin pa na tshangs pas kyang sleb pa na des/

tshangs pa chen po bde bar byon/ /shin tu 'phyi bar 'dir 'ongs so/ /bstan bcos thams cad byin zin pas/ khyod ni rig byed 'di long zhig/ces smras te/ de la rig byed byin par bshad la/ gzhung lugs gzhan las ni 'og nas 'chad pa ltar rang rang gi ston pas dus tha dad du byas par bshad do/ /dbye ba ni/ ye shes snying po kun las btus las/ dbang phyug la sogs yon tan 'dod/ /grangs can sgra rnams yon tan med/ /tshangs pa 'dod pa bram ze rnams/ /'di rnams de nyid rnam gsum gnas/ /zhes yon tan can dang grangs can dang tshangs pa ba gsum yin zhes dang*/ rtog ge 'bar ba las grangs can pa dang*/ bye brag pa dang rig byed kyi mtha' gsang ba pa dang*/ spyod pa can te bzhi/ dus 'khor du/ /tshangs pa ba/ dbang phyug pa/ khyab 'jug pa/ rgyang 'phen pa/ gcer bu pa/ skabs gzhan du grangs can pa ste drugabacom ldan ral gris/ dbye ba bcu gnyis dang der ma 'dus pa'i yon tan smra ba sogs mang du byas pa sogs gzhung lugs rnams las mang du gsungs kyang 'og nas 'chad pa ltar chad sogs so/ /de dag kun kyang 'dod pa thun mong ba ni bdag smra ba dang*/ rtag dngos smra ba dang 'tshe ba chos su smra ba dang thub sogs mthun te/ nye bar len pa bzhi'i nang nas bdag tu smra ba nye bar len pa ni mu stegs spyi'i chos su gsungs shing chad smra'i gtso bo rgyang 'phen gyis kyang 'byung bzhi dang rdzas gcig pa'i bdag 'dod cing*/ phung po skad cig smra ba yi/ /shwakya pa rnams bdag med na/ /mtho ris thar pa la dgos pa'i/ /'bad pa don med nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes pa mu stegs spyi'i gzhung yin pa'i phyir dang*/ gzhung der/ gal te 'gags na 'gags gyur pas/ /ji ltar 'bras bu 'byin par 'gyur/ /zhes sogs kyis bya byed las gsum rtag par 'dod pa'i phyir dang*/ sems can la mi 'tshe ba rlom pa'i gcer bu pa yang*/ rang lus dka' thub du mas gdungs te rang la 'tshe ba'i phyir dang*/

rigs sna tshogs dang rus sna tshogs bsdus nas spyod pa sna tshogs ston cing 'tsho ba sna tshogs kyis 'tsho la/ sgyu ma'i blau brid sna tshogs kyis 'jig rten slu bar byed pa'o zhes sogs skur ba du ma 'debs par byed pa'i phyir ro/ / gnyis pa la/ chad smra ba dgag pa dang*/ rtag smra dgag pa'o/ / dang po la/ 'dod pa brjod pa dang*/ de dgag pa'o/ /dang po la/ ming gi rnam grangs/ smra ba po'i ston pa/ des bzhag pa'i grub mtha' dngos sogs las/ dang po ni/ shi ba'i tshe bdag rgyun chad par smra ba dang*/ tshe 'di la gang legs bsgrubs pas chog par 'dzin pas dang*/ 'jig rten pha rol rgyang ring du 'dor bas dang*/ skye ba snga phyi sogs med par 'dod pas dang*/ drang srong chen po lha'i bla ma la ston par 'dzin pas dang*/ des byas pa'i phung po'i rgyud la brten pas dang*/ nyi shar chu bo thur du 'bab pa dang*/ /sran zlum tsher ma gzang ring rno ba dang*/ /rma bya'i 'jug bkra la sogs dngos rnams kun/ /rgyud yod ma yin ngo bo nyid las byung*/ /zhes gsungs dang*/ de bzhin du ngo bo nyid dang rang bzhin don gcig pas chad smra sogs ming gi rnam grangs brgyad do/ / ston pa ni/ spyir rengs byed kyi bu lhag spyod la sogs pa snyoms 'jug pa drug bram ze tshangs pa'i tshe'am rgyus rgyal la sogs pa rjes sgrog pa drug khyad par rtog ge pa drug ni/ 'od srungs rdzogs byed dang*/ yang dag rgyal ba can dang*| mi pham skra'i la ba can dang*/ ka ti'i bu nog can dang*/ gnag lhas kyi bu kun tu rgyu dang*/ gnyen gyi bu gcer bu pa ste ston pa drug tu grags pa ste/ 'di dag so so'i 'dod pa ni/ 'dul ba lung gi mchog zung dang 'od srungs chen po sogs kyi dris pa na gsal lo/ /yongs su grags shing sngon du bstan bcos byed pa po ni/ drang srong lha'i bla ma phur bu pa sum cu rtsa gsum du lha min las g.yul rgyal du re nas skye ba snga phyi dang dge sdig med par ston pa'i bstan bcos byas shing*/

de nas rim gyis 'phel te mi yul du babs pa las btus pas drang srong 'jig rten mig gis brtsams pa'i rtsa ba la/ slob dpon chos grags dang dus mnyam du byung ba'i drang srong 'jug stobs kyis 'grel ba byas nas 'phel lo zhes dbu ma spyan ras gzigs brtul zhugs las bshad do/ /rtsa bar de gnyis go rim ldog pa ni tshig sbyor bde ba'i ched de zhi ba lha dang 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ /zhes sogs bzhin no/ /de ltar ston pa de dag gi rjes su 'brang ngo/ /grub mtha'i dngos kyi rgyu ni ji tsam dbang po'i spyod yul ba/ /skyes bu'ang de tsam kho nar zad/ /bzang mo mang thos gang smra ba/ /de dag spyang ki'i rjes dang mtshungs| |zhes rang gi bu mo la bgrod par 'dod nas smras pa lta bu 'dod yon sogs so/ /dam bca' ni bsgrub pa bzhi dang dgag pa lnga ste/ 'byung ba rgyu dus na mi gsal ba'i bdag dang*/ 'bras bu kun lus sems rdzas gcig tu mngon du gyur pa gsal ba'i bdag dang*/ mi gsal ba 'byung bzhi'i 'gro ba gsal ba mi dang dud 'gro'i 'gro ba ste 'gro ba gsum yin gyi lha dang dmyal sogs med par 'dod pas 'gro ba gsum du bsgrub pa dang*/ rang nyid rjes dpag mi 'dod pas gtan tshigs med kyang gzhan la grags pa'i gtan tshigs kyi 'god tshul/ bum pa chos can/ lus sems rdzas gcig pa'i bu dang bum pa gang rung gi zla dang bcas pa yin te/ ut+pa la min pa'i dngos po yin pa'i phyir/ dper na rtsig pa bzhin zhes sogs sgrub par byed la/ spyir rgyu med dang*/ gal te rgyu yod na'ang/ skye ba yongs su len pa na/ /'byung rngub dbang po blo dang ni/ /rang gi rigs la ltos med par/ /lus nyid 'ba' zhig dag las skye/ /zhes pa ltar skye ba snga ma dang*| gang gang 'chi sems de dang de/ /skye ba gzhan du rjes 'gro med/ /'chi sems yin pa'i phyir na dper/ /nyes bral 'chi kha'i rig pa bzhin/

/zhes skye ba phyi ma 'gog pa dang*/ ji ltar tsher ma la sogs kyi/ /rno ba nyid sogs rgyu med de| |glo bur ba nyid yin pa ltar/ /de bzhin sdug bsngal sogs rgyu med/ /ces las 'bras 'gog pa dang*/ blo ni lus la brten pa'i phyir/ /goms pas grub pa med| |ces thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas med la/ de med par des gsungs pa'i chos dang dge 'dun med ces dkon mchog gsum 'gog pa dang*/ ji tsam dbang po'i spyod yul ba/ /zhes sogs kyis tshad ma mngon sum gcig pu las med pas mtho ris dang dmyal ba sogs ma mthong ba'i dngos pau 'gog pa dang*| rjes dpag ni tshad ma ma yin te/ tshad ma'i mtshan nyid dngos po 'dzin pa med pa'i phyir dang*/ lha sbyin gyi bu las sngo sangs dpog pa sogs gtan tshigs thams cad 'khrul ba'i phyir zhes rjes dpag tshad ma 'gog par byed do/ /de dag las kyang dgag pa lnga pa des bzhi pa ma mthong ba'i dngos po bkag pa de bsgrubs nas de dang ni/ gong gi 'byung bzhi'i bdag la sogs pa bsgrub pa bzhi yis dgag pa lnga'i dang po skye ba snga phyi med pa de sgrub cing de grub pa yis dam bca' lhag ma mtha' dag grub par 'dod pa rnams ni 'dod pa mdor bsdus te brjod pa ste/ rnam 'grel le'u gnyis pa'i phyogs sngar dngos su yod pa dang med kyang 'gog byed kyi rigs pa rnams dang sbyar bas gsal lo/ /de dgag pa ni/ lnga pas bzhi pa sgrub pa'i bsgrub bya sgrub byed gnyis ka mi 'thad de/ kun gyis thams cad du ma mthong ba'i dngos po mi srid cing 'ga' zhig gis 'ga' zhig tu ma mthong sogs nas 'gal ba'i phyir/ gzhan yang tshad ma gtan med du 'gyur te/ rjes dpag mi 'dod la mngon sum yang 'gog par 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ 'byung ba dang sems gnyis gzhan rig gis mthong mi mthong dang rang rig gis myong mi myong so sor snang bzhin du gcig tu 'dod pa'i phyir na'o/ /spyir rgyun dang ldan pa'i sems chos can/

rang rgyu snga ma sngaun du song ba dang rang 'bras phyi ma bskyed par nges te/ sems yin pa'i phyir/ dpe da lta tshe 'di'i sems kyi mtshon no de bzhin du brda la ma byang ba'i byis pa chung ngu chos can| chags sogs skye ba snga ma rnams su goms par gsal te/ bslab mi dgos par chags yul la 'jug pa'i phyir/ rig pa bem po'i nyer len las mi skye ste/ bem rig nyer len so sor nges pa'i phyir ro/ /yang zhes pa'i tshig gcig pu 'dis don gzhan yang ston pa ste/ de ltar skye ba snga phyi grub tu chug kyang*/ thams cad mkhyen pa mi grub bo zhe na/ dngos po'i gshis la zhugs pa'i thabs shes khyad par gyi blo chos can/ goms rkyen khyad par can dang ma bral bar yun ring du goms nas gsal snang khyad par can 'byung ste/ rten brtan cing goms rkyen dang nyer len rigs mi mthun la mi ltos par sems kyi yon tan yin pa'i phyir| dper na/ chags sogs goms pa las je gsal du mthong ba bzhin tai/ 'dod 'jigs mya ngan gyis brlams dang*/ /rkun po rmi sogs kyis bslad pa| |mdun na gnas pa ji bzhin du/ /yang dag min pa'ang mthong bar 'gyur| |zhes sogs so/ /mi gsal ba'i 'gro ba khas len pa ni rtog ge pa mtha' dag gi gtsug rgyan du mi 'thad do/ /de 'dra khas len pa ni grangs can pa dang de las kyang blun pa'i phyugs dang mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ /rtswa sogs rtse na glang chen brgya/ /sngon tshe ma mthong yod do zhes/ /de skad grangs can phyugs las gzhan/ /ngo tshar [ mtshar ] bcas pa su [ sus ] brjod rtsol/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa la/ dbye ba mdor bstan ni/ mu stegs rtag smra ni sde bzhi ste/ grangs can sogs kyi phyir ro/ /'di bzhi yang dug gsum cha mnyam pa dang 'dod chags dang*/ zhe sdang dang gti mug shas che ba dang rim bzhin sbyar la/ sgra bshad ni 'og tu so sor 'chad do/ /mtshan nyid so sor brjod pa la bzhi las/ grangs can la 'dod pa brjod pa yang*/

rnam grangs/ dbye ba/ ston pa/ grub mtha'o/ /dang po ni shes bya grangs su bcad pa la nan tan du byed pas dang/ rdul mun snying stobs kyi yon tan cha mnyam pa rang bzhin dang mi mnyam pa rnam 'gyur du 'dod pa dang*/ drang srong ser skya'i bu brgyud yin zhing de'i rjes su 'brangs pa dang*| gzhung lugs sum cu pa zhes bya ba mchog tu 'dzin cing bdag gi rnam grangs sum cu 'dod pas dang*/ da ltar gyi snang ba 'di thams cad gtso bos byas shing de'i rang bzhin du gnas par smra ba rnams kyis grangs can pa sogs so| |gzhung la lar grangs can pa dang ser skya pa tha dad du byas pa'ang snang ste/ slob dpon 'phags pa lhas/ grangs can sgra rnams yon tan med/ /ser skya pa rnams stong pa'i tshul/ /zhes dang*/ grub chen sman zhabs pas/ bdag gi rnam grangs sum cu las/ dus las byung ba dang 'dod rgyal dang gnam gyis bskos pa dang gyi na bzhi ni grangs can gyi 'dodapa yin no/ /rnam 'byor dang tshad ma dang*/ dag pa dang ma dag pa bzhi ni ser skya'i 'dod pa yin no/ /zhes dang*/ 'od ldan las kyang*/ gang dag grangs can dang ser skya la sogs pa'i bstan bcos de kho na nyid yin pa'i blos 'don pa de dag la ni yul 'khor gyi bsod snyoms dug tu 'gyur ro/ /zhes bshad mod/

ser skya'i mnga' zhabs spyi dang drug skor lta bu mngon no/ /gnyis pa ni/ mngon gsal smra ba lha med pa dang rnam 'gyur smra ba lhar bcas zhes kyang bya ba gnyis so/ /don ni/ 'o ma zho'i rang bzhin du gnas pa rkyen gyis mngon par gsal ba rang bzhin nam/ gtso bo'i rgyu tsam las byung ba yin gyi blo sngon du gtong ba'i lha gzhan med pa dang*/ de gnyis rang bzhin gcig kyang rnam 'gyur tha dad du song ba ni gtso bo ma zad lha chen dbang phyug gis blo sngon du btang nas kyang byas zhes smra la 'dis ni shes bya tshig gi don drug kyang 'dod do/ /'on kyang dbang phyug par ni mi 'gyur te/ gtso bo bden zhen gyis 'dod pas so/ /gsum pa ni/ sngon tshe lo dpag med kyi dus su drang srong ser skya zhes bya bas bsti gnas su bsgoms pas mu stegs kyis thar pa thob par rlom nas rang gis mthong ba'i de nyid gzhan la ston par 'dod nas grangs can gyi bstan bcos byas shing/ phyis rnal 'byor dpyod pa dbang phyug lhar 'dzin pa'i drang srong chu klung gis kyang dbang phyug nag po'i rgyud sum cu pa dang drug cu pa sogs byas pas na ser skya sogs so/ /bzhi pa la gnyis las/ dang po mdor bstan ni/ 'jal byed tshad ma gsum gyis gzhal bya'i shes bya nyer lnga 'jal bar 'dod do/ / gnyis pa rgyas bshad la 'jal byed gsum las/ mngon sum tshad ma ni dbang po'i 'jug pa la 'dod de/ de yang rna ba dang pags pa dang mig dang lce dang sna la yid kyis byin gyis brlabs nas sgra la sogs pa la zhen cing lta ba'o// zhes grangs can spyi pa 'dod la/ ston pa chu klung ni/ dbang shes kyis yul gyi bye brag 'dzin pa'i sems kyi 'jug pa lnga las mchog gi 'jug pa zhes pa bslu med kyi bya ba nyid dbang po'i 'jug par 'dod do/ /rjes dpag gnyis las rang don rjes dpag ni/ 'brel ba bdun gyis yul 'jal ba ste/ lhas byin dang rta lta bu nor dang nor bdag gi dang*/

'jim pa rdza bum lta bu rang bzhin dang rnam 'gyur gyi dang*/ rdza mkhan dang rdza bum lta bu rgyu dang rgyu can gyi dang*/ sa bon dang myu gu lta bu rgyu dang 'bras bu'i dang*/ sdong po dang yal ga lta bu yan lag dang yan lag can gyi dang*/ ngur pa khyo shug lta bu grogs dang grogs can gyi dang*/ bya rog dang 'ug pa lta bu dgra gshed kyi 'brel ba'o| |gzhan don rjes dpag nyid ni/ rnam ldan dang bsal 'ongs gnyis te/ rang rgyud sgrub ngag yan lag lnga ldan dang*/ thal 'gyur gyis gzhan phyogs bkag nas rang phyogs bzung ba'o/ /yid ches pa'i lung ni/ dbang sogs nas lnga bcu pa sogs pa'i gzhung ste| de ltar mngon rjes lung gsum ni tshad ma'o/ /gzhal bya la gzhi 'bras lam gsum las/ dang po la/ mdor bstan ni/ lugs 'di'i shes bya grangs nyer lnga ni bsdu na gtso bo dang bdag shes rig gi skyes bu gnyis su 'dus te/ rang bzhin dang rang bzhin min pa gnyis su 'dus pas so/ /rgyas bshad la/ so sor bshad/ bsdus te bstan pa'o/ /dang po la bdag dang gtso bo bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gtso bdag gnyis kyi nang nas bdag ni shes bya nyer lnga'i nang nas tha ma yin te/ 'di ltar gtso bo dang chen po dang nga rgyal dang sgra dang reg bya dang gzugs dang ro dang dri ste de tsam lnga dang*/ nam mkha' rlung me chu sa ste 'byung ba lnga dang*/ rna ba dang pags pa sogs nang blo'i dbang po lnga dang*/ ngag dang lag pa dang rkang pa dang 'phongs dang 'doms te phyi las kyi dbang po lnga dang gnyis ka'i dbang po yid de dbang po bcu gcig dang*/ tha ma bdag shes rig gi skyes bu'o zhes so/ /bdag 'di'i ngo bo ni/ byed po dang za po gnyis las za po yin la 'jig mi srid pas rtag cing sa sogs kyi yon tan min la byed pa po yang min pa dang bem shes gnyis las shes rig yin pa dang*/ gnas rgyang ring du 'tshol mi dgos kyi gtso bo'i glor gnas shing rtogs dka' bas drang srong ser skyas kyang mi mthong ba'i khyad par gyi chos de rnams dang ldan pa'o/

/bdag gi khyad chos 'di dag ni mu stegs phal cher 'dod de/ dbu ma 'jug pa las/ za po rtag dngos byed po min pa'i bdag /yon tan bya min mu stegs rnams kyis btags zhes so/ /gtso bo la/ spyi'i ngo bo ni/ bdag las gzhan nyer bzhi po kun la spyi ming gtso bo zhes bya zhing yon tan dang bem po dang yul yul can gnyis las yul yin no/ /bsdu na rang bzhin rgyu'i gtso bo dang rnam 'gyur 'bras bu'i gtso bo gnyis su 'dus la/ de gnyis kyi thog ma ni nyer lnga'i dang po yin zhing dug gsum mam bde sdug btang snyoms sam snying stobs dang rdul dang mun pa ste rang bzhin gsum mam yon tan gsum cha mnyam pa byed pa po yin la rtag pa dang gcig pu dang kun la khyab cing 'on kyang rgyu brgyad kyi mi gsal te/ khyab tshul ni til la til mar bzhin dang*/ rgyu brgyad ni ha cang nye phyir ring phyir dang*| |cha phra'i phyir dang bsgribs phyir dang*/ /zil gnon phyir dang 'dres phyir dang*| |dbang po nyams phyir yid med phyir zhes bshad do/ /rnam 'gyur 'bras bu bsdus pa'i gtso bo ni nyer gsum ste/ rgyu'i gtso bo de'i dngos 'bras ming la blau'am chen po ste blau zhes kyang zer/ chen po zhes kyang zer/ skabs la lar nang gi byed pa zhes kyang zer ro/ /de ni me long ngos gnyis pa lta bu shel ltar gsal zhing dwangs pa yul rnam 'gyur gyi tshogs dang shes pa bdag gi gzugs brnyan gnyis ka phyi nang nas 'char bas gzugs brnyan gnyis 'dres pa ni gzhal bya mngon gyur gyi mtshan gzhi dang*/ gzugs brnyan gtod pa po'i yul shes gnyis ni lkog gyur gyi mtshan gzhi ste de gnyis nyid du nges pa ste/ ming la blo zhes 'dogs kyang sems med pa'i bem por 'dod de/ sems pa ni rgyun la 'jig mi srid pa'i bdag gcig pu yin gyi skye 'jig srid pa rnams sems med du 'dod do| |chen po'am blo de la sogs te*/

yul gdung sim bar mar myong ba'i sdug bde btang snyoms gsum po de rdul las gyur pa dang*/ rnam 'gyur las gyur pa dang 'byung ba las gyur pa'i nga rgyal gsum yin pa'i phyir te/ rim bzhin rmongs pa dang 'dod chags dang g.yo ba shas che ba'i rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ nga rgyal de gsum gyis dngos dang brgyud pa'i 'bras bu skyed tshul ni/ dang po rdul las gyur pa'i nga rgyal gyis sgra sogs zhes te sla'o/ /de skad du yang dbang phyug nag po'i rgyud las rang bzhin las chen de las nga rgyal yin/ /de las tshogs ni rnam pa bcu drug go /bcu drug po ni de dag rnams las kyang*/ /lnga po rnams las 'byung ba chen po lnga/ /zhes bshad do/ /de ltar yul shes gnyis kyi gzugs brnyan blo la shar ba ni shes par yul za zhing spyod pa'i don te blo la shar ba'i don ni skyes bus shes par byed do/ /zhes so/ /de ltar shes bya thams cad yul shes gnyis su bsdus pa'i yul las gzhan pa ni shes pa yin pa la bsams nas| mig sogs yul gyis bsdus pa rnams chos can/ gzhan gyi don byed de/ 'dus shing bsags pa'i phyir/ mal cha dang stan la sogs pa bzhin no/ /zhes pas bdag sgrub par byed de/ bdag la chos can gyi don dang rtags kyi don gnyis ma tshang bas so/ / gnyis pa ni/ rgyu dang rang bzhin ming gi rnam grangs dang 'bras bu dang rnam 'gyur ming gi rnam grangs su byas pa'i mu bzhi las thog ma ni gtso bo dang bdun ni blo dang nga rgyal dang de tsam lnga'o/ /bcu drug ni lhag ma rnams so| |de skad du yang rtsa ba byed yin bya ba min/ /chen po sogs bdun bya dang byed| |bcu drug po ni bya ba nyid/ /skyes bu bya min byed pa'ang min/ /zhes so| |bden gnyis su bsdu ba ni/ thog sogs te/ drang srong ser skyas/ yon tan rnams kyi rang bzhin mchog /snang ba'i lam du 'gyur ma yin/ /snang ba'i lam du gang gyur de/

/sgyu ma lta bur shin tu gsog /ces bshad de/ kun rdzob rang stong skra shad snang ba lta bu dang/ don dam gzhan stong 'od gsal bden grub ces zer ba dang rjes su mthun te/ de yang sems tsam rnam rdzun pa'i gzhung lugs dang shin tu nye'o/ rnam 'gyur 'di dag la sim gdung bar mar snang ba'i rtags kyis de skyed pa'i gtso bo rang bzhin nam yon tan gsum ldan dpog par 'dod de/ ji skad du/ rangs dang mgu dang kun dga' dang*/ /bde zhing zhi ba'i sems nyid dag /res 'ga' yang ni snang gyur ba/ /de dag snying stobs yon tan no| |mi dga' yongs su gdung ba dang*/ /mya ngan 'dod dang mi bzod dag / gang du snang ba'i gtan tshigs kun/ /de dag rdul gyi gtan tshigs 'dod/ / rmongs dang de bzhin gti mug dang*/ /bag med gnyid dang g.yel ba dang*/ / lan 'ga' yang ni snang gyur pa/ /de dag mun pa'i yon tan 'dod/ /ces so/ 'bras bu thar pa ni/ bdag shes rig gis sogs te/ gtso bo skyengs te rnam 'gyur rnams rang gi rang bzhin ngang du bsdus nas bdag gcig pu zla med du gyur pa thar pa thob par 'dod do/ /thar lam ni/ de nyid nyer lnga legs par shes pa de la sogs te/ de nyid nyi shu lnga shes na/ /ral ba'am bye bo cod pan sogs| |cha lugs gang gis gnas gyur kyang*/ /grol 'gyur 'di la the tshom med| |ces so// de dgag pa ni/ thar pa thob pa'i tshe skyed byed gtso bo ma log bzhin du skyed 'bras rnam 'gyur rnams 'gag pa mi 'thad de/ rgyu sogs 'gal ba'i phyir/ gtso bo ni gcig tu bden pa min par thal/ rdul mun snying stobs gsum yin pa'i phyir/ blo bde chos can/ bem po ma yin par thal/ myong ba'i ngo bor skyes pa'i phyir/ bdag chos can/ rtag pa ma yin par thal/ shes rig yin pa'i phyir/ khyod la bcings bzhin pa las grol ba'i thar pa mi srid par thal/ rtag pa'i phyir/ de ltar na grangs can gyi grub mtha' phal cher ni don la med bzhin du blos btags pas rjes 'jug slu bar byed pa yin la/

rnam 'gyur sna tshogs su 'dod pa'i kun rdzob thams cad rdzun pa slu chos su 'dod pa la sogs pa 'ga' zhig ni 'thad par yang rung zhing*/ dngos po'i gnas lugs la blo kha cung zad kyang ma phyogs pa'i blun dad tsam sgom pa las ni gnas lugs mthong ba la nye ru song bas mtha' gcig tu sdang smra mi bya'o/ / gnyis pa dbang phyug pa dgag pa la yang gnyis las/ dang por 'dod pa brjod pa la/ rnam grangs/ ston pa/ dbye ba/ grub mtha' dngos so/ /dang po ni/ ming gi rnam grangs dbang phyug pa zhes sogs drug ste dang po gsum lha chen gyi ming gi mngon brjod yin la de lhar 'dzin pa de dang de'i ming ngo*| |ye nas srid pa zhes pa ni/ snod bcud gdod ma nas 'dis byas zhes smra bas so/ /tha ma gnyis ni/ mig btsums nas rnal 'byor sgom pa dang*/ 'ug pa'i sgro gos su gyon pas so/ /gnyis pa ni/ lha chen u ma'i srung ma la drang srong mdzes pa brtul zhugs grub pa zhig bzhag pa na/ de la u ma chags nas mdun du 'dug ste chags tshul du ma bstan pas/ des mig rang gi rkang pa la phab ste brtul zhugs bsrungs pas dbang phyug mnyes nas gzhung lugs rtsom pa por dbang bskur ba dang*/ gzhan gyis bor ba'i gzegs ma za zhing brtul zhugs spyad pas dbang phyug grub ste gzhung mang du brtsams pas/ de gnyis la ming de ltar du grags pas so/ /bstan bcos ni/ dbang phyug nyid kyis bshad pa'i zhi ba'i rgyud dang dbang phyug nag po'i rgyud dang*/ gzegs zan gyis byas pa'i bstan bcos mang po rnams la 'chad nyan du byed do/ /gsum pa dbye ba ni bzhi ste/ rig pa can sogs so/ /bzhi pa la gzhi lam 'bras gsum las/ dang po la/ lha dang tshad ma dang*| gzhal bya'o/ /dang po ni/ lha chen dbang phyug ni shes bya kun mkhyen pa/ gnas gangs ti se'i ri'i steng na 'byor pas brgyan pa'i stan la 'dug cing*/ u ma dang khyu mchog la sogs pa'i 'khor gyi tshogs stong gis bskor ba mtsho ma dros pa nas 'ongs pa'i dgra bcom pa lnga brgya dang lhan cig gnas zhes/

lha las phul byung gi 'grel par slob dpon shes rab go chas bshad do/ /lha chen de'i yon tan ni dbang phyug brgyad ldan te/ dbu ma spyan ras gzigs brtul zhugs las/ lag pa dag dang rkang pa dag /mig dang bzhin dang lus rnams kyis/ /mang po byed cing 'jig byed pas/ /des na phra bar brjod pa yin/ /nam mkha' rlung dang sa dang ni/ /chu dang me dag gnas byed cing*/ /sdus pa dag ni rgyas byed pas/ /de na yang bar brjod pa yin/ /'byung po kun la dbang byed cing*/ /gnas pa dang ni rgyu ba dag /gang dang gang 'dod de byed pas/ /des na bdag por gyur pa yin| |bdag la rag lus rang dbang can/ /'ga' yang 'jig pa yod ma yin| |thams cad dbang du gyur pas na/ /des na dbang du gyur pa yin| |yul dang bza' ba bca' ba dang/ /gzhan yang yid kyis gang bsam pa| |yid kyi rjes 'gro mi sdod pas/ /des na gar yang phyin zhes bya/ /'jig rten gsum na mchog gyur cing*/ gnas pa dag dang rgyu ba dang*/ /'byung po kun gyis brjed pas na/ /des na mchod par bya ba yin/ /snying stobs rdul dang mun pa gsum/ /de dag gang la gnas 'gyur pa/ /mig 'byed tsam gyis byed 'gyur pas| |des na 'dod dgur ldan zhes bya/ /thar pa'ang yang na lha yi lus| |gang du bdag nyid 'dod gyur pa/ /thams cad 'dod pas thob 'gyur ba| |des na dga' mgur gnas zhes bya/ /zhes bshad pa bzhin no/ /des snod sogs ni/ snod bcud 'di chos can/ dbang phyug gis blo sngon du btang nas byas te/ sdod cing 'jug pa'i phyir dang*/ sogs pa dbyibs dang ldan pa'i phyir dang*/ don byed nus pa'i phyir zhes dang*/ ser sna can la longs spyod dang gtong phod can dbul po dang dge ba can sdug bsngal dang sdig pa can bde ba dang ldan pa rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu 'chol pas grub ste/ yon tan nor ldan tshe thung dang*/ ngan par spyod rnams tshe ring dang*/ /gtong ldan dbul po mthong bas na|

|dbang phyug gis byas gsal ba yin/ /zhes sogs bshad do/ /gzhung gzhan nas ni dbang phyug de nyid gzugs can min pa dang rnam pa gsum gyi srid pa khyab pa'i gnas na gnas pa dang mdud pa sogs tshan pa gsum ni khyim bcu gnyis dang*/ yul gzugs la 'jug pa'i lam mig ces sogs yid kyi bar drug dang*/ sa sogs 'byung ba'i de nyid lnga dang*/ gzhan yang sngags dang*/ 'dod pa dang*/ bdag dang*/ zhi ba'i de nyid de bzhi dang thig le zhi ba chos su smra bar gsungs la/ dbang phyug sgra bsgrags kyi rgyud las/ dbang phyug nus ma mnyam sbyor bas/ rmad du byung ba'i bde ba skye/ /nus can tshul gyis bsgoms pa yis| |yang dag tu na dngos po med/ /nus can ma yin stong nyid lta/ /sgro 'dogs thams cad rnam 'joms pa'o/ /zhes dang dbang phyug 'khrigs pa grub pa las/ /dbu ma'i ye shes skye bar 'dod/ /bum pa can gyis rlung gis ni| |bskal pa'i bar du 'chi med sgrub/ /ces pa ltar 'khrig pa chos su smra zhing*| rlung gi rnal 'byor mang po yang bshad do/ /yang gzhung gzhan nas/ lha chen 'di ri rab kyi byang shar thod pa dgu brtsegs kyi pho brang na/ khyab 'jug dang dga' byed dbang phyug la sogs pa pho dang*/ dbu ma dang drug ldan ma la sogs pa mo'i 'khor nyi shu rtsa re re dang*/ gzhan yang gnod sbyin dang rims kyi bdag mo la sogs pa du mas bskor nas gnas pa dang*/ khyab 'jug gis ser skyar sprul nas rgyal po dug can gyi bu drug khri bsad nas dmyal bar shor/ de dag gi tsha bo bha gī ra tha zhes bya bas tshangs pa bsgrubs nas/ lha'i chu bo gang gā mi yul du phab pa/ lha chen 'di'i ral pa bkram pas lo stong gi bar du bgor/ des dbang phyug nyid la gsol ba btab ste ral pa btsir ba'i thigs pa gcig ti se'i steng du babs pa mtshor gyur pa las gang gā sogs chu klung bdun byung*/ gang gā lha chen gyi bsti gnas shig tu babs pa na lha chen khros te 'thungs/

yang gsol ba btab pas slar skyugs pa sa 'og tu song bas dug can gyi bu rnams kyi sdig pa bkrus nas tshe 'phos nas mtho ris su skyes pa sogs kyi rnam thar yod pas/ lha 'di ni lus dang rdzu 'phrul shin tu che'o zhes smra'o/ /'dis 'jig rten sprul tshul ni 'jig rten 'di zhig nas nam mkha' stongs par gyur pa'i tshe/ 'dis snod bcud byed 'dod kyi blo skyes pa na/ bar snang gi rdul phran rtag pa snang mi rung du gnas pa rnams phan tshun phrad de se gol gtogs pa'i bar la 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor grub cing*/

me'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su gser gyi sgo nga zhig byung ba brtol ba'i nang nas tshangs pa gdong bzhi pa pad+ma'i mngal na gnas pa zhig byung ba des 'jig rten thams cad byas pas na dbang phyug gis byas zer ro/ /tshad ma ni bzhi las/ mngon sum ni rig pa can pa rnam med kyi sgo nas khyad par yon tan 'dzin pa'i rtog par 'dod la/ de tshad ma dang des drangs pa'i khyad par can rdzas 'dzin pa'i blo ni 'bras bur 'dod do/ /bye brag pa ni mngon sum shes pa ma yin gyi dbang don phrad pa'i 'brel ba tsam du zad la/ de tshad ma dang de las don nges pa 'bras bur 'dod do/ / rjes dpag gi rang don la yang*/ rig pa can pa/ sprin 'dus pa las char 'bab pa dang*/ mdar chu brub pa las phur char bab pa dang*/ du ba las me yod par dpog pa gsum snga ma can dang lhag ma can dang spyir mthong ba'i rjes dpag ces zer la/ bye brag pa ni/ rig byed rgyas pa 'don pa las rgyang ring po shes par dang*| zla ba shar ba las rgya mtsho 'phel bar dang*/ ston ka'i chu dwangs pa las skar ma ri byi mo 'char bar dpog pa lta bu rnams rtags yang dag dang*/ khyab 'brel med pa dang*/ chos rtags tha mi dad pa dang khyab 'brel the tshom za ba gsum ltar snang ste/ ma grub pa dang med pa dang the tshom can zhes smra'o/ /gzhan don rjes dpag ni/ sgrub ngag yan lag lnga ldan no/ /nyer 'jal ni/ ba lang ci 'dra zhes 'dri na ba men 'dra'o zhes pas ba lang rtogs pa lta bu'o/ /sgra byung tshad ma ni/ dbang phyug ni thams can mkhyen te/ thams cad kyi byed pa po yin pa'i phyir/ dper na rdza mkhan gyis rdza la dgos pa thams cad shes pa bzhin no zhes bsgrubs nas/ dbang phyug gi lung thams cad der 'dod do| | gzhal bya ni/ tshad ma de bzhis/ rdzas dang yon tan dang las dang spyi dang bye brag dang*/ 'du sogs so/ /de ltar shes bya tshig gi don drug ste/ rdzas dang yon tan las dang spyi| |bye brag 'du ba drug yin no/

/zhes so/ /drug ga bden grub tu 'dod de/ zhi ba 'tshos tshad ma'i de kho na nyid bsdus par/ rdzas la sogs pa'i don drug ni| |dam pa'i don du yod pa'i phyir/ /zhes so/ /de ltar drug las rdzas ni dgu ste| 'byung ba bzhi dang nam mkha' dang dus dang phyogs dang bdag dang yid rnams so/ /de dag rtag mi rtag tu bsdu na/ 'byung sogs tshad du grags pa 'jig rten stongs pa'i tshe snang mi rung du gnas pa de dang sogs rdzas yin la 'byung bzhi'i rdul gyis brtsams pa'i rags pa ni mi rtag pa'i rdzas so/ /drug po kun kyang rdzas yod bden grub tu bshad zin to/ /nam mkha' ni sgra'i yon tan rtag rdzas thams cad du khyab pa'o/ /dus ni 'byung ba rnams kyang dus kyis 'byin/ /skye rgu rnams sdud dus kyis byed/ /dus kyi gnyid log sad byed phyir/ /dus ni shin tu 'da' bar dka' zhes sogs dus can gyi dngos po rnams las rdzas tha dad pa bya ba kun gyi byed pa po'o/ /phyogs kyang shar sogs te de bzhin no/ /bdag ni lus dang dbang po dang blo sogs las rdzas tha dad dang thams cad la khyab kyang gson lus kho na la gnas pa'o/ /yid ni blo rtog bcas rtag dngos so/ /des na bdag sogs so/ /yon tan ni nyi shu lnga ste/ de yang bdag gi yid kyi yon tan bcu gsum ste/ dbang shes lnga'i blo lnga dang bde sdug dang chags sdang dang chos chos min dang 'dus byas pa dang 'bad pa'i shugs rnams so/ dus phyogs kyi yon tan bdun te/ grangs dang bongs tshod so so ba dang phrad pa dang bye ba dang gzhan dang gzhan ma yin pa rnams so/ /'byung bzhi dang nam mkha'i yon tan lnga ste dri ro gzugs reg sgra rnams so/ /las ni 'degs sogs lnga/ spyi ni ngo bo cha med rtag rdzas yod pa nyid dang ba glang nyid lta bu khyab dang nye tshe ba/ gnyis ka'ang kha sogs so/ /gsal ba yod sar 'gro ba dpe thar ra'i lugs dang*/ gsal ba yod med kun tu rjes su 'gro ba dpe lug ka'i lugs tha dad 'dod do/

/bye brag ni dkar po dang nag po sogs so/ /'du ba ni spyi dang gsal ba/ rdzas dang yon tan/ rten dang brten pa/ khyad par dang khyad par can rnams sbrel byed kyi 'brel ba 'brel po las don gzhan te/ de yang 'byor ba'i/ ldan pa'i/ 'phrod 'du'i/ 'du ba'i ldan pa'i/ ldan pa'i 'phrod 'du'i 'brel ba ste/ 'khrul med kyi 'brel ba lnga zhes 'dod do| |de yang dang po gsum mig dang phyi ma gnyis rna ba la sbyor te/ mig gzhir byas nas bum pa dang*/ de'i yon tan dang yon tan gyi spyi rnams dang*/ rna ba gzhir byas nas sgra dang de'i spyi dang sbrel lo/ /lam ni 'jig lta yul la ma 'khrul bar mthong nas de'i 'dzin stangs la gsal snang 'don pa'i bdag sgom pa dang dbang phyug gi rgyud nas bshad pa'i dbang bskur byas pas grol bar 'dod pas de dag thar lam yin par 'dod do// 'bras bu ni/ bshad ma thag pa'i tshig gi don drug sogs dang*/ bcu drug ni/ rkang mig gis bshad pa'i tshad ma dang gzhal bya dang the tshom dang dgos pa dang dpe dang grub mtha' dang yan lag dang rtog ge dang gtan la dbab pa dang rtsaud pa dang rjod pa dang sun dpyis phyin du rgol ba dang rtags ltar snang dang tshig dor dang*/ ltag chod dang*/ tshar bcad kyi gnas rnams te/ zhib mo rnam 'thag gi phyogs sngar bkod do/ /tha ma gnyis kyi dang po tshad ma mdo dang rig sgor 'byung ba dang phyi ma rtsod rig tu 'byung ba rigs gter du bkod do/ /thar pa tha dad du 'dod pa de bzhin du mngon sum yang bem po dang rtog par 'dod de bshad zin/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gis byed tshul yang bye brag pa sngar bshad pa bzhin sdu na brgyud nas skyed pa dang rig pa can pa dbang phyug nyid kyis skyed par 'dod do/ /de dag dgag pa ni/ dbang phyug chos can/ rang 'bras rtag tu skyed pa'am yang na nam yang skyed par mi 'gyur te/ rang 'bras skyed pa rkyen la mi bltos pa'i phyir te/

rtag pas so/ /skyon med de/ 'di ni bskyed par bya la 'di ni mi bya'o zhes 'dod pa la bltos pas so zhe na/ rang 'bras rang dbang du skyed pa'i nus pa med par 'gyur te/ 'dod pa la bltos pas so/ /mi rtag pa nyid du 'gyur te/ 'dod pas bsgyur nus pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang rigs pa'i gnod pa mang ste/ cha med kyi rtag rdzas yin pa dang kun la khyab pa yin pa 'gal ba dang*| sogs pa bdag bem po yin na shing dang 'dra bar 'gyur ba dang/ bde sdug bem po yin na goms pas gsal du 'gro ba mi 'thad par thal ba dang*/ dus phyogs dus can sogs las rdzas tha dad du snang rung ma dmigs pa dang*/ dbang phyug 'dod chags kyis gdungs pas skyon can du rang gzhung las mang du bshad pa/ khyad par 'phags bstod dang*/ lha las phul byung na gsal ba sogs rgyas par spro bar bya'o/ / gsum pa khyab 'jug pa dgag pa la/ dang po 'dod pa brjod pa la/ spyir brjod/ so sor brjod pa'o/ /dang po la/ rnam grangs/ ston pa/ dbye ba/ grub mtha'o/ /dang po ni/ sa gsum la khyab par 'jug pas khyab 'jug dang*/ nor lha sred med kyi bu yin pas nā ra ya ṇa zhes pa sred med kyi bu ste/ des lha min gyi grong bcom pas grong 'joms te de lhar 'dzin pas khyab 'jug pa zhes sogs so| |gnyis pa ni/ gcer bu pa'i ston pa rgyal ba las bogs thon pas rgyal dpogs dang ston pa gzhon nu ma len sogs kyi rjes su 'brang ngo/ /bstan bcos ni/ rtog pa la phan pa'i yal ga lo 'dab dang ldan pa la sogs pa rig byed kyi gsang tshig rnams 'chad cing nyan no/ /gsum pa/ dbye ba tshangs sogs lnga las dpyod pa ni thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa mi 'dod pas de las gzhan sogs so/ /bzhi pa ni/ kun kyang khyab 'jug lhar 'dzin cing*/ de'i khyad chos ni/ lha chen khyab 'jug ces bya ba lha'i drang srong chen po nor lha sred med ces bya ba dang lha mo gtum mo'i bu yin cing/

rgya mtsho'i nang nas sgo ldan zhes bya ba'i grong na rang gi chung ma dpal mo la sogs pa bud med khri drug stong la sogs pa mang pos bskor te gnas pa/ nye dbang dang gos ser can la sogs pa'i ming gi rnam grangs du ma dang ldan pa mngon pa'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas dngos sogs yin par khas len te/ des/ nyi ma'i nang na nga khyab 'jug /skar nang 'od ldan zla ba ste| |rlung nang nga ni 'od zer can/ /snang ba'i nang na nyi ma yin/ /rig byed nang na snyan tshig dang*/ /lha nang nga ni brgya byin yin/ /zhes pa nas/ ri yi nang na ri rab dang*/ /nga ni yi ge'i nang na a/ /zhes smras pa'i phyir ro/ /de bram ze sogs te| nga ni bram ze'i lus gnas nas/ /za bar byed cing sbyin par byed/ /nga ni sbyin byed za ba po/ /nga ni zas dang skye dgu'i bdag /ces kyang smras pas so// dbye ba lha sogs te/ chos sku dang gzugs sku'i rnam pa'o/ /dang po sogs te/ gang gi khyab 'jug yon tan rnams/ /rtag tu bsgoms pas bde thob 'gyur// zhes dang skal ldan nor lha 'di ni thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs/ /'gro ba thams cad lhar 'dren thar pa sby-in par byed/ /nor lha stobs bzang 'chi med la sogs ngo bor gnas/ /skye dgu thar pa bkod nas 'khor ba stong par byed/ / ces bshad de/ 'dis kyang 'khor ba zad mtha' can du 'dod do/ /gnyis pa ma zhi bas khyab sogs te/ nya sogs bcu ru sprul pa yis rim pa bzhin du/ sngon dus kyi dbang gis rig byed bzhi rgya mtsho'i nang du nub pa ston pa dang*| rus sbal gyi gzugs kyis 'jig rten btegs nas rgyun du gnas pa dang*| phag rgod kyi gzugs kyis tshangs pa'i 'jig rten man chad mnan pa dang*| mi'i seng ge'i gzugs kyis lha min gyi dbang po 'gro ba skyong gser can bsad pa dang*/ mi'u thung du sprul nas lha min stobs ldan gom pa gsum gyis blang zhes bslus pa dang/ dza mād ag+ni'i bu dga' byed du sprul nas rgyal bu srid sgrub la sogs pa bsad nas rgyal rigs med par byas pa dang*/

rgyal po shing rta bcu pa'i bu rā ma ṇar sprul nas rang gi chung ma srin po langs ka mgrin bcus phrogs pas/ spre'u ha nu man+dha grogs bcol te srin po btul ba dang*/ nag pos rtsod pa'i dus su sems can gyi don byas pa dang*/ sangs rgyas shākya thub tu sprul nas sngon rgyal rigs bsad pa'i sdig pa sbyangs pa dang*/ rigs ldan bram ze'i bu kar ki rtse zhes bya ba ma 'ongs pa na 'byung bas sems can mang po btul ba'i mthar dus log pa rtogs par 'gyur ba'o/ /de yang dang po gsum la sgro gdags gzhi 'thad ldan med kyang gtam rgyud rnying pa rdzun ma la brten pa dang*/ gzhan rnams ngo mtshar che che rnams khyab 'jug gis sprul par sgro 'dogs pa'o| |rgyu mtshan de ltar nas byas shing rtag sogs bstan te ji skad du/ lus ni rnying pa spangs nas su/ /lus gzhan gsar pa len byed pa'i/ /bdag ni mtshon gyis mi chod cing*/ /mes kyang mi 'tshig chus mi 'drul/ /zhes dang*/ sems rtag dngos la bdag dam pa nor lha'i bu zhes sgro btags pa'i phyir dang/ 'thab dka' rlag par byed pa'i dus su/ gang gis mi ni bsad pa dang*/ /gang zhig gsod par byed pa dang*/ /de dag gnyis ka mi dmigs te/ /bsad dang gsod po yod ma yin/ /zhes sogs chad lta smras pa'i phyir ro/ /so sor brjod pa la lnga las tshangs pa ba ni lha chen tshangs pa de skye gnas gsum par smra ste/ sngar bshad pa ltar dbang phyug gis blos sprul pa'i sgo nga dang*/ yang na khyab 'jug gi lte ba'i pad ma dang yang na des dang por chu'i dkyil 'khor sprul zhing der sa bon bcug pa gser gyi sgo ngar gyur pa las skyed par 'dod pas sa/ /de ming bdun dang ldan pa yin te/ bskal pa bdun la rim pa bzhin du/ rang byung*/ tshangs pa/ skye dgu'i bdag po/ pad+ma'i skye gnas can/ gdong bzhi pa/ mes po/ pad+ma'i snying po can rnams so/ /des 'jig rten gyi ma brgyad bskyed de/

nyi ma'i/ sbyin byed ma'i/ mi'i/ klu'i/ mkha' ld-ing gi ma sogs so| |de brgyad las rim pa bzhin du lha dang lha min mi la sogs pa rang rang ngo*| |de'i lus kyi cha shas snying dang kha/ dpung pa/ brla/ rkang mthil bzhi las mchod sbyin sogs rig byed bzhi dang*/ bram ze/ rgyal rigs/ rje rigs/ dmangs rigs/ mi rigs bzhi byung ba de 'dra'i lha chen de/ spu dkar po sha stag yod pa'i rta gtsang ma'i mchod sogs so/ /yang lugs gzhan las/ tshangs pa'i kha las skye dgu'i bdag po gsal ba zhes bya ba skyes/ des mchod sbyin zhig byed pa na tshangs pa spyan 'dren pa la rang gi bu mo btang bas tshangs pa chags te khu ba byung ba blugs gzar gyis blangs te mer blugs nas drang srong ngan spong dang aṃ gi ra skyes so/ /lhag ma dur ba'i nang du lus pa las drang srong a ti byung zhing*/ des snyan ngag gi ri dang srid srung gi ri la rig byed re re byas pa ni snyan tshig dang srid srung*/ mchod sbyin dang nges brjod gnyis drang srong gzhan gnyis kyis byas te tshangs pa'i bus byas pa la tshangs pas byas zhes kyang 'byung*/ yang de dag gis kha ton tu bton pa tsam yin gyi ma drin pa sogs kyi gtan tshigs las rig byed skyes bus ma byas par 'dod pa yang yod de/ gang ltar yang rig byed rnams ni sgra don so sor nges pas sgra nges sbyor dang bcas/ brjod bya la tshad ma skyed pas shes gsal dang bcas/ ā li kā lis brgyan pas yi ge rnam dbye dang bcas| gzhan yang*/ rig byed las ni gang mi 'byung*/ /rig byed las ni gang ma smras/ /thams cad med par shes bya ste/ /rig byed 'dra ba'i thos pa med| |ces sogs bsngags pa brjod par bya'o/ /gnyis pa dpyod pa pa'am rgyal dpogs pa rnams ni/ grangs can ltar blo bdag 'gal bar mi 'dod kyi blo bdag gcig dang*/ dbang phyug pa ltar bem por mi 'dod kyi shes rig sogs 'dod cing*/ chags sogs nyes sogs nas bden pa'i ngag med par 'dod la/

'jug ngogs bzhi'i yul gyi khrus kyis sdig pa 'dag cing srid sde dang g.yul dang srog rnams 'bad pas bsrungs na mi de 'dag par 'dod do/ /'jal byed tshad ma ni mngon sogs so/ /drug ni mngon sum skad cig gnyis pa phan chad rtog pa dang 'bras bur 'dod pas dang por don la lta ba'i rtog med ni mngon gsum mo/ /du ba las me dpog pa lta bu 'brel ba mngon sum du shes pa dang lhas byin 'gro bar mthong bas nyi ma yang 'gro bar nges pa lta bu 'brel ba spyir mthong ba gnyis ni rjes dpag dang*/ ba men gyis ba lang dran pa lta bu dang*/ rig byed kyi tshig las lkog gyur shes pa lta bu dang*/ lhas byin ma shi bzhin du khang nang na med par mthong bas phyi na yod par go ba lta bu dang*/ chos 'ga' zhig 'ga' gzhi la ma mthong bas der med par rtogs pa rnams ni nyer 'jal sogs so/ /don go drug ni/ tshad ma drug po de rnams kyis drangs pa drug ste/ me tsha bar dang*/ nyi ma song bar dang*/ ba glang ba men 'dra bar dang*/ sgras don rtogs par dang*/ sgra don 'brel bar dang*/ bum pa med par rtogs pa rnams las rim pa bzhin sreg par dang*/ 'gro bar dang*/ zho rgal rung bar dang*/ sgra don 'brel bar dang*/ de rtag pa yin par dang*/ sa phyogs dag pa bar go ba rnams so| |dngos med bzhi ni/ sngon med pa dang*/ zhi gnas med pa dang/ phan tshun med pa dang*/ shin tu med pa ste/ 'o ma la zho dang zho la 'o ma dang*/ rta la ba glang dang ri bong la rwa med par rtogs pa rnams so/ /dpyod pa ba de'i sogs ni/ me'i rtags kyis du ba 'grub pas du ba me'i 'bras bur rig pa dang*/ chags bral ma dmigs pas med par nges pa dang*/ stong yod sar brgya yod par nges pa srid pa dang*/ rgyu mtshan yang dag ma mthong bar gtam rgyud rnying pa las shing sdong la mi ma yin gnas so zhes grags pa dang*/ sring mo'i yid la ming po sleb pa snyam byed pa na de ltar sleb pa snyam sems sogs so/

/de dag gi 'dod pa thun mong du yul shes bya thams cad rnam med mngon gyur yin la/ blo ni rang rig med pa dang lkog gyur rtags kyis 'jal bar 'dod cing*/ 'jal byed ni skyes bu dang tshad ma ni dbang po dang don rtogs ni 'bras bu'o zhes dang*/ blo tshad mar 'dod pa dag kyang khyad par dang khyad par can gyi blo tshad 'bras su 'dod do| | gsum pa brda sprod pa ni/ rnam 'gyur sna tshogs 'di 'byung ba'i gzhir gyur pa sgra yi tshangs pa zhes bya ba rig pas dpyad bzod zhig yod do zhes smra bar byed la/ de yang phyogs dang dus kyi cha med pa dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin skye 'jig dang bral bas rtag pa'i dngos po yi ge oṃ zhes bya ba'o/ /rnam 'gyur sna tshogs 'di sgra'i tshangs pa de'i rnam 'gyur yin pas shes bya thams cad sgrar snang bas khyab pa'i phyir sgra thams cad dngos dbang gis 'jug par 'dod do/ /de skad du zhi 'tshos/ skye 'jig med par yang dag gnas/ /sgra yi rang bzhin tshangs pa mchog /gang de yongs su gyur pa ni/ /dngos po'i 'gro 'dir rab shes bya// zhes dang*/ ji ltar nam mkha' dag pa la/ /rab rib kyis bslad skye bo yis// rab rib sna tshogs dag dang ni/ /ldan pa nyid du mngon par rlom/ /da ltar 'chi med 'gyur med pa'i/ /tshangs pa 'di ni ma rig pas/ /rnyog pa nyid du 'gyur ba ste| |tha dad ngo bor rnam par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /de sgrub pa'i thabs ni phyi nang gi sbyin sreg gnyis kyis sgrub ste/ phyi ni/ re re la yang grong gi mi/ /byol song drug cu drug cu sbyin/ /zhes sogs dang*/ bram ze la ni bram ze bsad/ /rgyal rigs la ni rgyal rigs te/ /ma rungs pa la rje rigs dang*/ /dka' thub pa la dmangs rigs so/ /zhes so/ /nang ni/ go tam me ni bud med de/ /de yi nyer gnas thab khung yin/ /der skyed bu ni du ba ste/ /de yi nang zhugs sol ba yin// de lta bu yi me 'di la/

/skyes bu lha yi sa bon sreg /sbyin sreg de las skyes bu byung*| |de skyes 'tsho bar gyur pa yin/ /zhes so/ /de ltar nang gi sbyin sreg la brten pa'i bde stong ni thar par 'dod do/ /gang gis bag chags bcas sems kyis| |mya ngan 'das pa thob byed pa'i/ /dga' ba'i lta ba gcig pu las/ /lta ba gzhan gyis ci zhig bya/ /zhes dang bde ba gang de tshangs nyid de/ /bde ba de ni thar pa yin/ /zhes so/ /brda sprod pa phal cher ni gnam sa 'bar bar snang ba lta bu mngon sum rnams 'khrul zhing*/ rjes dpag tshad mar la las byas pa yang*/ de las rigs pa bzang ba gzhan gyis brtag na tshad min du 'gro bas tshad ma ni sogs/ de'i ston pa bri sogs te/ rig byed mi slu ba yang mngon rjes mi slu ba las sgrub dgos pas so/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa rig byed sogs te/

skyes bu drang srong chen po nyi ma'i mdog |mug pa las 'das gyur pa de rig na/ /'chi ba las 'das 'gyur te bdag gis rtogs/ /skye med gnas 'gro ba la lam gzhan med/ /ces dang*/ dngos po ma lus 'jig na yang*/ /shes pa nus ldan 'jig pa med/ /ba skya rnams kyi ba bzhin du/ /de ni skye ldan rgyu ru grags/ /ces dang*/ srid pa sna tshogs de las skyes/ /dar gyi srin bu'i skud pa bzhin/ /mkhas pa de yi char thim pas/ /yang srid len par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes sogs dang*/ steng phyogs de'i mgo dang 'og phyogs de'i rkang pa sogs su bshad cing*/ 'jig rten 'jig pa'i tshe des za bar 'dod pa dus 'khor du bkag go /lnga pa rig byed gsang ba'i mtha' smra ba pa ni sogs te/ sa dang me chu la sogs pa/ /de shes rtag pa'i 'jug pa 'di/ /de bdag can nyid bdag nyid ces| |gzhan dag kyang ni rjod par byed/ /gzung 'dzin mtshan nyid dang ldan pa| |'di ni cung zad yod min te/ /de phyir 'di dag thams cad ni/ /rnam shes 'gyur bar yang dag snang*/ /zhes sogs bshad la/ phal cher snga ma dang thun mong ngo*/ /de dgag pa ni/ tshangs sogs te/ lha chen thig le mchog ma la/ /chags pa skyes pas gdong bzhi byung*/ /zhes dang*/ skye dgu'i bdag po rang nyid kyi/ /bu mo dang ni 'khrig ces thos/ /zhes dang*/ khyab 'jug mi thung gzugs sprul nas| |g.yo thabs kyis ni stobs ldan bslus/ /zhes dang*/ rgan pos khyab 'jug mda' yis bsnun/ /zhes dang*/ khyab 'jug gis ni gnyen 'dun dag |le lan gyis ni gtugs par gyur ces dang*/ khyab 'jug dpung drag dbyug tho mtshon cha thogs par brtson/ /zhes sogs rtsa 'grel dang*/ a mar ko ṣa'i 'grel par gtam rgyud mang du 'byung bas so/ /'dod pa phal cher ni rtag pa'i dngos po dang gcig pu cha med kyi gzhi mthun bkag pas khegs te/ skyon gyi gtso bo rtog pa la ji ltar snang ba'i rtag dngos khas blangs pa las gyur pas so|

|nyes zad skyes bu ni/ rtag nyid phyir ram thabs med phyir/ /zhes sogs dang*| mchongs dang chu yi drod bzhin du/ /rang bzhin las 'das min zhe na| |zhes sogs 'gog pa'i rigs pas brtags sogs so/ / bzhi pa gcer bu pa dgag pa la/ 'dod pa brjod pa dang*/ rnam grangs/ ston pa/ grub mtha'o/ /dang po ni/ gos med pas dang*/ ngo tsha med pas dang*/ dka' thub kyis las zad par byed pas dang*/ lus thal mdog tu yod pas dang/ drang srong rgyal ba dam pa'i rjes su 'brang bas dang*/ gos gzhan med pas phyogs dang nam mkha'i gos can yin pas dang*/ phyogs kun tu 'gro bas de dang de'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ drang srong rgyal ba dam pa lhar 'dzin cing khyu mchog dang ldong ris sogs nyi shu rtsa lnga'i rjes su 'brang bar byed do/ /gsum pa la gnyis las/ dang po mdor bstan ni/ gcer bu lus kyi tshad bzhin du/ /srog ni zhum dang rgyas par smra/ /zhes srog ni lus kyi tshad bzhin du che chung du 'dod/ rdzas sam rang bzhin dang rnam grangs sam rnam 'gyur rim pa bzhin du rtag pa dang gzhan mi rtag pa de gnyis kyang gcig tu smra'o/ /'jal byed mngon sum sogs gsum gyis gzhal bya/ dus gsum dang rdzas drug dang*/ tshig gi don dgu dang srog sogs ni gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi gzhi'o/ /sdom pa dang brtul zhugs dang ye shes rnams lnga lnga dang spyod pa bcu gsum dang las zad par byed pa'i dka' thub kyi thabs sna tshogs ni lam mo/ kha ba rgya spos me tog mdog /ba zha bo mo mu tig mdog /gdugs bkan bzung ba'i dbyibs 'dra ba/ /thar pa yin par rgyal bas bshad/ /ces pa ltar srid sogs ni 'bras bu'o| |'gro ba lnga dang yod pa'i lus lnga ni gzhi dang 'bras bu gnyis ka nyid yin par 'dod do/ /gnyis pa rgyas bshad la/ gzhi ni mngon sum gnyis te spyi 'jal ba ni rtog med dang bye brag 'jal ba ni rtog pa'o/ /lhas byin bu las sngo bsangs su dpog pa lta bu la tshul gsum yod kyang yid brtan du mi rung bas tshul gsum ni 'khrul pa'i phyir na gzhan du mi 'thad pa zhes pa'i tshul gcig nyid la sogs te/

dngos po dngos med gnyis ka ni yod pa yin te/ dmigs pa'i phyir zhes pa la/ shes bya thams cad chos can du yod pas mthun dpe med pa'i phyir rjes su 'gro ldog med la/ phyogs chos kyang gzhan du mi 'thad pa nyid du 'dus pas so| |zhes so/ /ston pa tshad ldan gyi ngag lta bu yid sogs so/ /rdzas ni drug ste/ srog dang bdag dang nam mkha' dang phyogs dang sdig pa dang bsod nams rnams so/ /tshig gi don ni dgu ste/ srog dang srog min gnyis/ bcings pa dang thar pa gnyis/ 'gro 'ong gnyis spangs pa dang zag pa dang sdom pa rnams so/ /srog ldan drug ni/ sa chu me rlung gi 'byung ba bzhi dang ljon pa dang 'bras bu'i srog ldan rnams so/ /gzhung gzhan du sogs te/ dang po lnga/ srin bu grog ma/ bung ba| mi sogs rnams te/ lnga po lus dbang gcig pu dang*/ srin bu sogs bzhi/ snga ma snga ma'i steng du lce/ rna ba/ sna/ mig ste mdor na dbang po gcig ldan nas lnga ldan gyi bar rnams so/ /srog dang bdag ni tha dad du bgrangs pa tsam ma gtogs gcig tu 'dod do/ /zag pa ni dge sdig gi las te/ gzhung gzhan du bsod nams dang de min zhes kyang 'byung ngo*/ /bcings pa ni/ lo ma can dang gtsang sbra can dang dbyig gu gsum la sogs pa lta ngan sum brgya re gsum rnams so/ /gzhung gzhan du 'gro 'ong gi tshab tu las dang nges par rga ba zhes 'byung ste/ phyis myong 'gyur dang*/ ming dang rus dang tshe rnams ni las dang*/ de zad pa'i thabs su dka' thub byas pas lus zad pa ni nges par rga ba'o/ /thar pa ni bshad zin to/ /lam la sdom pa lnga ni/ spyod lam gyi dang*/ skad kyi dang*/ tshol ba'i dang*/ mi 'dor ba'i dang*/ nyer gnas kyi sdom pa'o/ brtul zhugs lnga ni/ mi 'tshe ba dang*/ bden par smra ba dang tshangs par spyod pa dang*/ byin pa len pa dang*/ yongs su bzung ba thams cad gtong ba'i brtul zhugs rnams so/ /ye shes lnga ni/ blo gros kyi dang*/

thos pa'i dang*/ mtshams kyi dang*/ spyod pa'i dang*/ mo'i ye shes so/ /bon gyi phywa gshen ni 'di las 'byung ngo*/ /spyod pa bcu gsum ni/ sdom pa lnga dang*/ brtul zhugs lnga dang sgo gsum gyi gsang ba gsum rnams so/ /'gro ba lnga ni/ dmyal ba dang*/ dud 'gro dang*/ lha dang*/ mi dang*/ thar ba'i 'gro ba'o/ /yod pa'i lus lnga ni/ khams zas kyi dang*/ 'od kyi dang*/ yid kyi dang*/ rdzus skyes kyi dang*/ mtha'i lus te lnga'o/ /rim bzhin mi dang dud 'gro/ gzugs gzugs med/ bar do/ thar pa ste 'gro ba lnga pa yang de'o/ /'di dag dus 'khor nas gsungs pa ste/ gzhung gzhan na mi gsal lo/ / kun mkhyen sogs ni/ ser skya dang gzegs zan sogs kyang chags bral dang kun mkhyen min te/ kun 'dzin yongs 'dzin gnyis dang ldan zhing skar ma'i bstan bcos ma brtsams pa'i phyir/ ldog khyab ni rang gi ston pa khyu mchog dang ldong ris sogs la tshang bar 'dod pas kun mkhyen gtan med du 'dod pa ni ma yin no/ /gzhan yang dge sbyong go'u ta ma ni kun mkhyen ma yin te/ lung ma bstan gyi lta ba bcu bzhi lung ma bstan pa'i phyir dang 'khor ba'i mtha' mi shes pa'i phyir dang*/ lhung bzed bkrus pa bzhin du/ log pa'i phyir dang*/ lhas byin gnas nas phyung ba dang sgyu ma mkhan bzang po'i bsnyen bkur bzhag pas zhe sdang dang 'khon 'dzin yod cing*/ lnga sde'i bsnyen bkur 'gog pa ma shes pas rmongs pa dang*/ seng ldeng gi tshal pa zug pa sogs kyis las ma zad pa'i phyir ro// zhes so/ /shing ni sems ldan yin te shun pa bshus na 'chi ba dang dus su se bas rga ba yod la/ dbang po dang ldan pa'i phyir zhes spyir bkod nas/ bye brag tu| 'khri shing dang*/ chu shing dang*/ ma du lung ga dang*/ skyu ru ra dang*/ 'o ma can gyi shing rnams la rim pa bzhin mig rna ba sna lce lus dbang rnams yod de/ shing gzhan gyi gseb tu 'jug shes pa dang*/ 'brug sgra grag pa na 'bras bu 'byung ba dang*|

khyi ro rul pa'i dri la brten nas 'bras bu 'byung ba dang*/ 'o mas bcus pa na ro dngar ba dang*/ reg pa na lo ma 'khums pa'i phyir ro/ /shing mya ngan med la yid dbang yod de/ bud med lang tsho la bab pa rkang gdub dang ldan pas bsnun na ngo tsha ba bzhin du 'bras bu rgyas par 'gyur ba'i phyir zhes mang du smra'o// de dgag pa ni/ srog gam bdag de mi rtag par 'gyur te/ lus sogs kyi phyir na'o/ /rdzas sogs brtag pa byas na mi 'thad de/ gcig na 'o ma 'thung 'dod pas rnga mo 'thung bar thal ba sogs kyi phyir/ gtan sogs te/ tshul gsum ma tshang ba'i tshul gcig pa gtan tshigs su mi 'thad pa'i phyir/ las tsam zad pa'i thabs la 'bad pa don med de/ rtsa ba nyon mongs ma zad pa'i phyir| thar pa gzugs su 'gal te/ spang bya gnyen pos zad pa'i 'gog par mi rung bas so/ /dgag pa rgyas pa ni/ dbu tshad kyi gzhung lugs rnams las shes par bya la/ mdor bsdus ni de tsam gyis mtshon no/ /gsum pa ni/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i phyogs sngar rgya cher 'byung ba/ rgya gar nub phyogs ma kha'i yul du byung ba lha rā ma ṇa'i rjes 'brang sog po'am kla klo stag gzig pa zhes grags pa nang pa dang phyi pa gnyis ka ma yin par lta spyod bar ma do sna tshogs byed pa ni gzhung lugs gzhan gyi phyogs sngar mi gsal zhing*| dus 'khor du bkod pa ni/ spyi don chen mo bstan pa'i rgya mtshor bris zin pas 'dir mi spro la/ bod na yang rdol bon gshen rab mi bo zhes grags pa'i rjes 'brang bon theg pa rim pa dgu ste/ rgyu'i bon bzhi/ 'bras bu'i bon bzhi/ theg pa bla na med pa'i bon no/ /dang po bzhi ni/ phywa gshen/ snang gshen/ 'dur gshen/ 'phrul gshen te/ mo ma dang*/ lha bon po dang*/ gshin chog pa dang*/ mthu gtad byed pa'i bon no/ /'bras bu'i bon bzhi ni/ dge bsnyen dang*/ gtsang ma gtsug phud dang*/ drang srong dang*/ a dkar ba rnams te lta spyod gtso bor byed pa'o/

/ dgu pa ni rdzogs rim pa rdzogs chen pa dang mthun pa ste/ dang po bzhi bod kyi lha 'dres bstan/ bar pa bzhi 'dul mdzod phar phyin rnams 'dra min du bsgyur| tha ma ni rgya nag hwa shang gi lugs kyi lhag ma lus pa ste/ 'di'i lhad 'dres pa ni lta ba mtho mtho mor byas nas spyod pa khyad du gsod pa gzhan yang mang ngo*/ /gsang sngags rnying ma ni/ bstan pa snga dar la/ bla med kyi rgya dpe la ma brten pa'i 'gyur mi byed par bkas bcad pas/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang*/ bi ma la mi tra dang*/ lo tsā ba chen po bai ro tsa na la sogs pas/ gsang 'dus sogs thugs la bzhugs pa rnams don longs su mdzad nas le'u'i go rim sogs rnam gzhag gzhan dang gzhan du mdzad de snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa rnams/ phyis yi ge cung zad 'phyugs pa'i steng du gang zag gzu lum dang rang bzo che ba 'ga' zhig gis rgyud sde shin tu mang por spel zhing bslad pa tsam ma gtogs/ bstan pa snga dar gyi sngags bla med don 'gyur du bzhugs pa/ mkhas shing grub pa'i byang chub sems dpa' du mas thugs nyams su bzhes pa'o| |gang zag gis bslad pa ni/ /bod kyi rtog ge dang dbu ma sogs la'ang shin tu mang ste rgya gar gyi gzhung las 'byung ba dang shin tu mi mthun pa'i mdo sems dbu ma'i grub mtha' du ma yod do/ /de ltar de dag la sogs pa nang pa dang phyi pa gnyis ka ma yin pa'i grub mtha' mang yang*/ 'dir bsdu bar bya ba'i grub mtha' ma yin te/ gdod sogs kyi phyir te/ shes rab can du rlom pa dag gis gsar sogs kyi phyir ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ de ltar na gang zag gi bdag med grub ste/ mu stegs kyis btags pa'i bdag ni 'dogs gzhi phung po las rdzas gzhan du tshad mas ma dmigs pa'i phyir dang*/ phung po dang gcig na rtag gcig dang mi rtag du ma mtshan nyid 'gal bas so/ /dbang phyug la sogs pa'i rtag dngos mi srid de/ rim sogs kyi phyir/

mu stegs dngos dang rjes mthun zhe sdang rang dgar btang nas mthu gtad sogs la mchog tu 'dzin pa dag ni chos can/ khyod la rgyal bas bsngags pa'i chos mi srid de/ rang gzhan la 'phral phugs su 'tshe bar byed pas so/ khyad par 'phags bstod las/ shākya'i rgyal rigs 'khrungs khyod kyis| |gang zhig bden dang mi slu dang*/ /tshangs par spyod dang dul ba dang*| |brtse ldan dam chos legs par dgongs/ /zhes sogs gzhung lugs rnam par dag ma dag ni thabs snying rje chen po dang*/ shes rab gnas lugs kyi don la zhugs pa'i rig shes khyad par can gtso bor ston mi ston gyis dbye bar bya'o/ /gang zag gi bdag dgag pa ste le'u gnyis pa'o// // gnyis pa chos kyi bdag dgag pa la/ rags pa dgag pa dang*/ phra ba dgag pa'o/ / dang po la/ don smra'i 'dod pa bzung ba'i dang/ rnam rig pa'i 'dod pa 'dzin pa'i chos bdag dgag pa'o/ /dang po la/ rang sde'i rigs bsdu ba dang*/ theg dman gyi 'dod pa 'gog pa dngos so/ / dang po ni/ kha gcigarang sde gnas ma bu ba dang*/ bye brag smra ba dang*| mdo sde pa dang*/ sems tsam pa dang*/ dbu ma pa ste lnga'o zhes dang*/ kha cig bye smra sogs bzhi'i steng du gsang sngags smra ba dang lnga'o zhes zer ba ni mi rigs te/ sangs rgyas pa la grub mtha' smra ba lnga pa med par gsungs pa'i phyir/ dus 'khor kyai rdor sogs su grub mtha' bzhi nyid du gsungs shing*/ rdo rje snying 'grel du yang de bzhin dang*/ /theg pa yang gsum du gsungs pa'i mjug tu/ sangs rgyas pa la bzhi pa dang*/ /lnga pa thub pa'i dgongs pa min/ /zhes theg pa gsum dang grub mtha' bzhi nyid du gnas skabs bltos te nges pa mdzad pa'i phyir ro/ /des na rang sde'i grub mtha' smra ba ni bye sogs bzhi nyid du dbye ba nges la| bsdu na phyi rol don du smra ba dang sems tsam pa dang*/ ngo bo nyid med par smra ba'i dbu ma pa ste gsum du'ang 'du ste/ bye mdo gnyis ka don smrar 'dus pas so/

/'o na dbu ma rang rgyud pa phal cher tha snyad sems tsam pa yin la/ thal 'gyur ba phyi don khas len pas don sems gnyis su'ang 'dus par 'gyur ro zhe na| thal 'gyur ba'i phyi don tshad grub ni 'gog par 'gyur la/ 'khrul ngor ma brtags ma dpyad pa'i 'jig rten sgo bstun gyi don sems yod mtshungs dang*/ kun rdzob yang log gam slu mi slu sogs ni 'jig rten gzhan ngo'i rnam gzhag yin gyi/ dbu ma rang lugs kyi grub mtha' ma yin no/ /'o na de dag theg pa gsum dang ji ltar sbyor zhe na/ kha cigadon smra gnyis nyan thos dang sems tsam pa rang sangs rgyas dang*/ dbu ma pa byang sems theg chen gyi grub mtha' smra bar 'dod pa ni/ snga phyi cha mthun dang bar pa la rnam bden pa'i lta ba dang rang rgyal gyi bdag 'dzin spong tshul la chos mthun cung zad yod kyang*/ rnam rdzun pa 'dzin pa bden med zhal gyis bzhes pa dang mi mthun no| |rgya gar gyi a ba dhū tī pa dang gnas brtan byang bzang la sogs pa mdo sde pa theg chen pa yin par 'dod pa ltar/ bod phyi ma 'ga' re yang 'dod pa'i sgo nas gnyis pa mdo sde pa theg chen par sdud pa'i gzhung lugs rnams ni 'khrul te/ bzhi po'i dang po gnyis theg dman pa nyid du nges pa dang tha ma gnyis theg chen pa nyid du nges pa'i phyir/ de ltar na theg dman pa dang theg chen pa gnyis su'ang 'dus so/ /'o na mdo sde pa theg dman pa yin pa la shes byed ci yod ce na/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi sras kyi thu bo mkhas mchog legs ldan byed kyis/ de gnyis so sor ma phye bar theg dman pa zhes gcig tu bsdus shing*/ theg dman mtha' dag sde pa bco brgyad du bsdus la/ mdzod 'grel du/ rtsa ba bkag nas 'grel par rang lugs bzhag pa rnams mdo sde pa'i 'dod pa dang*/

de slob dpon nyid kyang bzhed par bshad pa rnams bod kyi mkhas pa kun la grags shing grub la/ de yang phar cher la gzhan dag ni zhes pa las mi 'byung yang*/ skabs 'ga' rer dpe ston sde pa na re/ zhes dang*/ nub phyogs pa na re zhes bkod nas mdo sde pa'i grub mtha' bzhag pa'i phyir dang*/ sde pa bco brgyad po'i nang du ma 'dus pa'i mdo sde pa'i mtshan gzhi mi rnyed pa'i phyir dang*/ mdo sde pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi gtso bo ni mkhas mchog dbyig gnyen gyi sku tshe'i stod yin la/ des theg chen la skur pa btab nas phyis 'gyod pa skyes te ljags spu gris gcod par brtsams pa'i phyir ro/ /phyogs snga ma dag gi sgrub byed/ mdo sde pas/ bsam pa snying rje dang sbyor ba gzhan don phyin drug la bslabs nas 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pa'i phyir zhes zer ba ni shin tu ma nges te/ bye smras kyang ston pa sangs rgyas kyis dang por sems bskyed tshul dang bar du phyin drug la bslabs tshul gyi skyes rabs du ma dang mthar mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyis mtshang rgya tshul rgyas par 'dul ba'i lung las 'byung ba rnams sgra j-i bzhin du khas len pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du theg chen dbu sems gnyis kas theg dman gyi lam dang gang zag gi rnam gzhag du ma rang lugs la khas len pas de dag theg dman pa'i grub mtha' smra bar thal ba la lan med do/ /des na spyir gang zag theg dman pa dang*/ grub mtha' theg dman pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ theg chen thung mong ma yin pa'i brjod bya/ chos lnga dang ni rang bzhin gsum/ /rnam par shes pa brgyad nyid dang*/ /bdag med gnyis kyi nang du ni/ /theg chen mtha' dag 'dir zad do/ /zhes pa lta bu rnams spyir blau la shong yang*/ theg chen gyi bsam sbyor khyad par can rang rgyud la skyed mi nus par dman pa'i myang 'das tsam don du gnyer ba yin la/ phyi ma ni byang chub gsum ga'i lam dang 'bras bu thung mong ba khas len kyang chos kyi bdag med la sogs pa theg chen gyi gsung rab las 'byung ba'i brjod bya khyad par can mang po blaur ma shong bas/
