de rnams ston byed kyi gsung rab bkar khas len mi nus pa la byed pa yin no/ /gnyis pa la/ 'dod pa brjod pa dang*/ de dgag pa'o/ /dang po la/ 'dod pa mthun pa dang*/ mi mthun pa'o/ /dang po la/ theg chen bka' ma yin par 'dod tshul dang*/ gzhi lam 'bras bu thun mong du 'dod tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ don sogs ni/ theg chen gyi gsung rab 'khor lo bar pa chos kyi bdag med rgyas par ston pa rnams dang*/ tha ma rang bzhin gsum dang rnam shes tshogs brgyad dang sgrib pa gnyis la sogs pa dang*/ rdul phran dang stong gsum skad cig dang bskal pa mi 'ga' bar bshad pa lta bu rnams ni/ rgyal bas gsungs pa'i bka' ma yin no zhes spong bar byed de/ 'dus byas mi rtag zag bcas sdug bsngal/ chos kun bdag med/ myang 'das zhi bar gsungs pa'i phyag rgya bzhi dang 'ga' ba'i phyir te/ rim pa bzhin longs sku 'jig mi srid par rtag tu bzhugs pa'i phyir dang*/ bde nas bde bar 'gro ba la/ /sems yod su zhig sgyig lug 'gyur/ /zhes sogs/ byang sems bde ba 'gro ba'i phyir| |bdag med mchog gi bdag thob nas/ /bdag nyid chen po'i bdag thob 'gyur/ zhes sogs bdag mchog grub par 'dod pa'i phyir/ nyan rang lhag med du zhugs tshar ba pad ma'i sbubs su skye ba blangs nas slar yang lam bsgoms te 'tshang rgya dgos pas so/ /gzhan yang*/ rtog ge 'bar ba bkod pa/ thun mong gi 'dul ba la mi snang*/ mdo sde la mi 'jug chos nyid dang 'gal ba'i sgo nas sde snod gsum du ma 'dus pa'i phyir dang*/ mu stegs la grags pa'i zas gcod pa dang 'jug ngogs kyi khrus dang*/ sngags bzlas pas sdig pa 'dag pa sogs phyi rol pa'i lam bstan pa'i phyir dang*/ rgyang 'phen 'dod pa'i las 'bras med pa sogs kyi chad lta bstan pa'i phyir dang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la sde pa bco brgyad las med par bshad la der ma 'dus pa'i phyir dang*/ mngon sum dang 'jig rten gyi grags pa dang 'gal ba mang du bshad pa'i phyir dang*/

bden bzhi mi rtag sogs kyis de kho na nyid kyi go mi chod par bshad la/ de ltar na de kho na nyid med par 'gyur pa'am/ yang na lhas bstan pa'i de kho na nyid du grags pa/ grog ma bsad nas gser skud la rgyus pa sogs de kho na nyid dul ba'i phyir zhes sogs skyon mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ zhes zer la/ shes sgrib dang chos kyi bdag med khas mi len pas sgrib sogs/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad mi 'dod pas kun sogs/ sangs rgyas la las dang sdug bsngal gyi lhag ma yod pa'i sgo nas skyon kun zad du mi 'dod pas gnas gyur dang*/ theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod khas mi len pas de nas 'byung ba'i rab dga' la sogs pa'i sa bcu dang*/ 'og min gyi longs sku mi 'dod pa sku gsum dang me long lta bu la sogs pa'i ye shes lnga dang bzhi la sogs pa mi 'dod cing khas mi len pa'o/ /gnyis pa la/ 'dod pa po'i gang zag gi dbye ba dang*/ des thun mong du 'dod tshul lo/ / dang po ni/ spyir nyan thos rtsa ba'i sde pa gcig dang gnyis dang gsum du'ang bshad mod kyi grags che ba ni rtsa ba'-i sde pa bzhi ste/ thams cad yod par smra ba dang*/ dge 'dun phal chen pa dang*/ gnas brtan pa dang*/ mang pos bkur ba rnams so/ /de dag las gyes pa'i nyan thos sde pa ni bco brgyad du 'dod de/ 'di ltar/ slob dpon dul ba lhas/ sde pa tha dad bklag pa'i 'khor lor sdom du bsdus pa ni/ 'od srungs sa ston chos srungs sde/ /mang thos gos dmar slob ma dang*| |rnam par phye dang gzhi kun pa/ /thams cad yod pa smra ba bdun/ /shar dang nub dang gangs rir gnas/ /'dus byas rtag par smra ba dang*/ /'jig rten 'das smra phal chen lnga/ /rgyal byed tshal gnas 'jigs med gnas/ /gtsug lag khang chen gnas brtan gsum/ /sa sgrogs ri dang srung ba pa/ /gnas ma bu pa'i sde rnams ni/ /kun gyi bkur ba rnam gsum yin/ zhes pa rnams so/

/de la rtsa ba'i sde pa gcig tu bshad pa ni/ slob dpon shākya 'od kyis thams cad yod smra la gzhi thams cad yod smra zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan du/ skad rigs bzhi las legs sbyar gyi skad du gsung rab 'don pa'i phyir dang*/ sngon 'di gcig pu las med pa las phyis gzhan rnams gyes par bshad pa'o/ / gnyis pa bshad pa la/ rtog ge 'bar bar bshad tshul gnyis te/ rgyal ba mya ngan las 'das nas lo brgya dang bcu drug na chos rgyal mya ngan med kyi dus su/ grong khyer me tog gis rgyas par/ dge 'dun 'khrug long la brten nas phal chen pa dang gnas brtan pa gnyis su gyes la/ de'i dang po la brgyad de/ phal chen pa dang*/ tha snyad gcig pa dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das par smra ba dang*/ mang thos pa dang*/ rtag par smra ba dang*/ mchod rten pa dang*/ shar gyi ri pa dang*/ nub kyi ri pa'o/ /phyi ma la bcu ste/ gangs ri pa dang*/ thams cad yod smra dang*/ gnas ma'i bu pa dang*/ chos mchog pa dang*/ bzang po'i lam pa dang*/ kun gyis bkur ba dang*/ mang ston pa dang*/ chos sbas pa dang*/ char bzang 'bebs dang*/ bla ma pa'o/ /yang na sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas lo brgya dang so bdun na/ grong khyer pa ṭa li pu trar rgyal po dga' bo dang bang chen gyi dus su bdud sdig can bzang po zhes bya bas dge slong gi cha byad du sprul nas rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs bstan pas dge 'dun bye ste/ rtsa ba'i sde pa phal chen pa dang*/ gnas brtan pa gnyis su gyes nas/ lo drug cu rtsa gsum du ma bzlums par lo brgya phrag gnyis pa 'das nas gnas brtan gnas ma'i bus bstan pa bsdus pa na rim gyis gyes te/ phal chen pa la ma gcig dang bu gnyis te/ tha snyad gcig pa dang*/ ba lang gnas pa'o/ /ba lang gnas pa la ma gcig dang bu gsum ste/ mang thos/ rtag smra/ mchod rten pa'o/ /de ltar na phal chen sde pa drug go /gnas brtan pa la ma gcig dang bu gsum ste/ gangs ri pa dang*/

thams cad yod smra dang*/ gnas ma bu pa'o/ /thams cad yod smra la yang ma gcig dang bu gnyis te/ rnam par phye ste smra ba dang*/ bla ma pa'o/ /de'i dang po la yang ma gcig dang bu bzhi ste/ mang ston pa dang*/ chos sbas pa dang*/ gos dmar ba dang*/ 'od srungs pa'o/ /de ltar thams cad yod par smra ba la yang sde pa bdun no/ /gnas brtan gnas ma bu pa la/ dang por ri chen po pa dang*/ mang bkur ba gnyis su gyes*/ dang po la chos mchog pa dang*/ lam bzang pa gnyis su gyes/ mang bkur ba la ma dang bu grong khyer drug pa gnyis su gyes pas gnas ma bu pa bzhi'o/ /de ltar na gnas brtan pa bcu gnyis te sde pa bco brgyad du gyes so/ /rtsa ba'i sde pa gsum du 'dod tshul ni/ gnyis po de'i steng du rnam par phye ste smra ba dang gsum mo/ /'di'i lugs kyis phal chen pa brgyad de/ phal chen pa dang*| shar ri pa dang*/ nub ri pa dang*/ rgyal po'i ri pa dang*/ gangs ri pa dang*/ mchod rten pa dang*/ don grub pa dang*/ ba lang gnas pa'o/ /gnas brtan pa drug ste/ thams cad yod smra dang*/ mdo sde pa dang*/ sngar gyi gnas ma bu bzhi'o/ /rnam par phye ste smra ba bzhi ste/ sa ston pa dang*/ 'od srungs pa dang*/ chos sbas pa dang gos dmar pa'o/ /'o na sde pa de dag gi ming 'dir bshad pa dang gzhan du yang 'byung ba rnams so sor bgrangs na bco brgyad las mang bar 'byung ba rnams ci zhe na/ rnam grangs pa yin te/ 'di ltar/ 'od bsrung pa la char bzang 'bebs/ sa ston pa la dpe ston/ chos srungs pa la chos sbas/ mang thos pa la mang ston/ gos dmar ba la bla ma pa'am 'pho bar smra ba/ rnam par phye ste smra ba la rgyur smra ba dang mo run ta pa'o/ /bye brag gzhan rnams la rnam grangs ma mthong la/ mang bkur ba'i spyi ming gi rnams grangs la a ban+ta ka pa dang ku ru ku l+le'i ri pa zhes bshad do/ /rtsa ba'i sde pa bzhi'i sgra bshad ni/ dus rnams kun tu yod gsungs

phyir| |gnyis phyir yul yod phyir 'bras phyir/ /de yod smra ba'i phyir thams cad| |yod par smra ba 'dod de dag /ces sogs dus gsum da lta ba bzhin du rdzas yod du smra bas dang*/ gyes pa'i tshe dge 'dun phal che ba phyogs gcig tu gnas pas dang*/ gnas brtan 'phags pa'i rigs yin pas dang*/ slob dpon skye bo mang pos bkur sti byas pa'i lugs 'dzin pas so/ /grub mtha' ni shas che ba'i dbang du byas na/ rim pa bzhin dus gsum rdzas su yod/ 'dus byas thams cad skad cig ma dang gang zag gi bdag med de| chos 'khor lam dang mthong lam skad cig bco lnga dang chos phung ming yin/ bskal pa grangs med gsum gyis 'tshang rgya/ dbang shes lam du mi rung*/ lha las 'da' lam skye/ bar srid yod/ 'dus ma byas gsum du 'dod pa rnams dang*| bdag phung tha dad/ bden pa cig car mthong*/ dbang shes lam du rung*/ chos 'khor tshig yin/ chos mchog las kyang nyams srid/ 'phags lam nyams mi srid/ dbang pos yul mi 'dzin/ bar srid med pa rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas legs sbyar mi gsung*/ bskal pa grangs med bcu yan/ sum cu man las gang rung gis 'tshang rgya/ 'gog snyoms la sems yod/ log shes dang mi shes pa med pa rnams dang*/ brjod du med pa'i bdag yod/ shes bya thams cad brjod du yod pa dang med pa gnyis su sdud/ 'dus byas rgyun brtan pa rnams 'jig byed don gzhan gyis 'jig dbang shes lam du mi rung*/ mthong lam skad cig bcu gnyis yin pa sogs so/ /de dag ni nang tshan la yang*/ dus gsum rdzas yod du 'dod tshul bzhi la sogs pa lta bu mi 'dra ba du ma yod de/ rtog ge 'bar bar rang sde pa tha dad bklag pa'i 'khor lo la sogs par blta bar bya zhing*/ de dag las sa ston pa dang 'jig rten las 'das par smra ba gnyis rang gi'adod pa sogs ni mdo sde pa dang mthun no/ /gzhan yang thams cad yod smra ni gsung rab legs par sbyar ba sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha'i skad du 'don/

mkhan po rgyal rigs las rab tu byung zhing bslab pa la gus pa'i mchog sgra gcan 'dzin las brgyud/ snam sbyar rnam phran dgu yan nyer lnga man la/ rtags 'khor lo dang pad ma/ ming dpal dang*/ bzang po dang snying po'i mtha' can te/ bram ze sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po dang ye shes snying po dang shākya shrī la sogs pa'o/ /phal chen pa ni/ skad pra kri ta rang bzhin gyi skad de/ 'od gsal gyi lha dang mthun pa/ 'od ldan nas 'bring du 'don pa zhes bshad de zur chag ces kyang grags so/ /mkhan po bram ze'i rigs las rab tu byung ba sbyangs pa'i yon tan la gnas pa'i mchog 'od srungs chen po/ /snam phran bdun yan chad nyer gsum man chad/ rtags dpal be'u/ ming ye shes dang sbas pa'i mtha' can te/ dī paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na dang*/ a bha ya ka ra gub+ta sogs so/ /gnas brtan pa ni/ skad pi sha tsi sha za'i skad/ mkhan po smyig ma mkhan las rab tu byung ba/ mtha' 'khob 'dul ba'i mchog ka t+yā ya na/ snam phran lnga nas nyer gcig gi bar la rtags dung yod pa ming 'byung gnas dang*/ go cha ste/ rin cen 'byung gnas dang*/ dad byed go cha sogs so/ /mang bkur ba ni a ba shi ta yi dwags kyi skad/ mkhan po 'breg mkhan las rab tu byung ba 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i mchog nye ba 'khor/ snam sbyar gnas brtan pa dang mthun/ ming 'bangs dang sde'i mtha' can te/ dkon mchog 'bangs dang*/ grol ba'i sde dang*/ mchog gi sde dang dul ba'i sde sogs pa'o/ /phyi ma gnyis kyi skad la/ 'od ldan du rim gzhin zur chag dang tha mal pa zhes bshad do/ /ming la mkhan po'i ming gi mtha' can yang 'byung ste/ bod kyi sad mi bdun la/ mkhan chen byang chub sems dpa'i mtshan gyi mtha' rak+ṣi ta zhes sbyar ba lta bu'o/ /ming brje ba yang da ltar gyi cho ga la yin gyi/ sngon chog dang tshur shog sogs la med do/ gzhan yang sde pa so so la byin len byed tshul dang nub lhag gcod tshul sogs bcas rkyang gi 'jog mtshams mi mthun pa ni yod par nges la/

bod dag phal chen sde pa chang 'thung ba la mi tshangs spyod kyi tshab ma'i rtsa ltung du byed do zhes rlung ltar du grags pa ni/ 'dul ba la mi mkhas pa'i gtam 'chol yin te/ 'dod pas bar du mi gcod par 'dod pa ni sdig lta chen po yin pas 'dul bar gtogs pa'i lta ba mi mthun pa yin la/ de lta na sde pa tha dad kyis las kyi kha skong mi rung bar 'gyur na/ bṝ ka ma la shī la'i gtsug lag khang du/ sde pa bzhi ka'i dge slong*/ bsnyen rdzogs kyi kha skong la 'du bar bshad pa sogs dang 'gal lo/ /sde pa bzhi po de dag las kyang thams cad yod par smra ba'i sde pa ni mchog tu gyur te/ kun gyi gzhi yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'di la rigs pa ni/ 'jig rten na ya rabs dag sgra'-i mtshan nyid la brtson par byas nas legs sbyar gyi tha snyad du brjod la/ de las 'jig rten gyi chos lugs bzang po rnams 'byung bas gzhi dang 'dra ba bzhin du/ sde pa 'dis kyang legs sbyar gyi skad du 'don pas ya rabs dang mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ /lung ni sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das pa'i phyi lo dgra bcom pa lnga brgyas rgyal po'i khab tu sde snod gsum bsdus shing*/ lo brgya dang bcu na/ yangs pa can du 'phags pa thams cad 'dod la sogs pa nas sgur po dang zhi ldan la thug pa dgra bcom pa bdun brgyas/ hu lu hu lu la sogs pa'i rung ba min pa'i gzhi bcu bsal nas bsdu ba gnyis pa mdzad cing*/ de rjes chos rgyal mya ngan med 'das nas/ tha mal pa dang zur chag dang 'bring du 'don pa'i skad la mngon par zhen pa'i dbang gis lung tshig mi 'dra ba dang*/ de la brten nas don yang cung zad mi 'dra bar song ste/ gyes pa bco brgyad du gyur gyi bar du sde pa 'di gcig pu yin par lung phran tshegs las gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes mkhas mchog shākya 'od kyis bshad do/ /de ltar tha dad du gyes pa'i rtsod pa cung zad kyis bstan pa sna tshogs su gyur pa ni/

ston pas sngon bram ze'i 'khor phye ba'i las kyi lhag ma yin pa dang*/ thams cad kyang sangs rgyas bstan pa'i nang du 'du bar ni/ sngon sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyi sbyin bdag rgyal po kri kri'i rmi lam bcu'i tha ma/ mi bco brgyad kyis ras yug gcig la brtsad pas re res kyang ras yug re re thob cing*/ thun mong gi ras yug gcig pu yang thun mong du lus par mthong ba/ shāka thub kyi bstan pa bco brgyad du gyes kyang rnam grol thun mong du thob pa'i ltas su lung bstan pa'i phyir ro/ /sde pa mang po de dag kyang bsdu na bdag smra dang bdag med smra ba gnyis su 'du ste/ gzhung gzhan du mang pos bkur ba'i nang tshan du grags shing rtog ge 'bar bar gnas sogs nas kun dang mdo sde pa yang bdag med 'dod pa'i phyir/ mdo sde pa'i mtshan gzhi ni/ sde pa'i nang nas dpe ston sde pa dang gang zag gi nang nas phyi rol don grub mdzad pa po slob dpon dge 'dun srungs dang*/ mdzod kyi tshor ba bde ba bsgrub pa'i phyogs sngar byung ba gtsun pa sogs so/ /gnas ma bu sogs lngas brjod med kyi bdag 'dod pa'i khungs ni/ rtog ge 'bar bar/ de rnams las sngar bstan pa'i dge 'dun phal chen pa la sogs brgyad dang*/ phyis bstan pa'i gnas brtan pa dang thams cad yod smra dang*| mang ston pa dang*/ chos mchog pa dang*/ 'od srungs pa rnams ni/ chos thams cad bdag med par smra ba yin la/ lhag ma gnas ma bu pa la sogs pa sde pa lnga ni gang zag tu smra ba yin te/ gang zag ni phung po las de nyid dang gzhan du brjod du med pa/ rnam shes drug gis shes par bya ba 'khor bar gyur pa yongs su gsal bar bya ba yin no zhes zer ro/ /zhes so/ /lnga ni/ gnas ma bu pa dang*/ bzang po'i lam pa dang*/ ku ru kul+le ba dang*| chos sbas pa dang*/ bla ma pa'am 'pho bar smra ba'o/ /gang zag de phung po dang gcig tha dad rtag mi rtag sogs su brjod du med kyang rang rkya thub pa'i rdzas yod du 'dod de/
'jug pa las/ kha cig de nyid gzhan nyid rtag mi rtag

/la sogs brjod med gang zag rdzas yod 'dod/ /ces gsungs shing*/ gal te khyod bum dngos por ma grub pa'i/ /zhes sogs kyis rigs ngor brjod med yin na bden grub ma yin par thal ba bum sogs kyis dpes bsgrubs pas/ rang sde'i grub mtha' smra ba dma' shos kyi mthar thug bdag smra 'dis kyang bum sogs kyi tshogs pa bden grub ma yin par khas blangs bzhin du/ spyir dngos smra yin na dngos po la bden grub kyis khyab pa dang*/ khyad par mdo sde pas/ dngos po la rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pas khyab par smra'o zhes bod na mang po mgrin gcig tu smra ba ni/ gzhung lugs rgya chen po la ma sbyangs par ma zad/ bum pa dang bum gzugs gnyis blo ma 'khrul ba'i ngor grub tshul la rtog ge sgo bstun gyi blo kha yang ma phyogs bzhin du lung rigs kyi dbang phyug tu khas len par zad do/ /des na bdag smra 'dis gang zag rdzas yod bden grub dang*/ bum pa btags yod brdzun par khas blangs pa'i nang 'gal ma rig pa ni grub mtha'i skyon yin no/ /gnyis pa la dogs pa chung ba spyir bshad pa dang*/ che ba bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni de ltar bye mdo'i grub mtha' smra ba kun kyang 'og gi mthun zhes pa re re zhing sbyar te/ phung po'i dbye ba lnga dang sogs pa khams dang skye mched kyi dbye ba bco brgyad dang*/ bcu gnyis dang*/ der ni sgo nga las skyes sogs so/ /sems can skye gnas bzhi dag tu/ /zhes sgo nga dang mngal dang drod gsher dang rdzus skyes te skye gnas bzhi dang*/ der ni dmyal sogs 'gro ba lnga zhes ngan song gsum dang lha mi gnyis te 'gro ba lnga/ khams dang reg pa dang sems pa dang rnam par shes pa'i zas te zas bzhi dang*/ phyogs kyi cha yod na gzugs can gyi chung mthar mi 'gyur bas rdul phran chung mtha' la phyogs cha med cing*| rdzun zhes pa'i tshig shugs kyis 'di bden grub dang de ma brtsams pa'i rags pa dbyibs ldan thams cad phyogs kyi cha dang bcas shing*/

blaus cha gzhan bsal du rung bas rdzun pa kun rdzob pa yin pa dang*/ spyir sems dang sems byung gi mtshan nyid yul gyi ngo bo dang khyad par tsam 'dzin pa dang gzugs can gyi 'byung gyur 'byung ba las dang*/ shes rig gi rdzas mtshungs ldan lngas mtshungs su dang*| ldan min gyi dngos po gnas skabs can gyi gzugs sems las skye ba ste 'dus byas kyi skye tshul dang*/ yul blang dor bden pa bzhi'i mtshan gzhi dang mtshan nyid kyi gtso bo dang*/ yul can la tshogs sbyor mthong sgom mi slob lam ste lam lnga dang*/ gang zag nyan thos skyes bu zung bzhi gang zag ya brgyad kyi grangs dang spangs rtogs phal cher dang*/ rang sangs rgyas bse ru lta bu dang*/ tshogs na spyod pa dang*/ byang sems kyi dang por thugs bskyed tshul dang*/ bar du tshogs bsags tshul/ tha mar 'tshang rgya tshul/ de yang srid pa tha ma pa rgyal bu don grub kyi dus su yang bskal pa grangs med gsum gyi tshogs rdzogs kyang so skye tshogs lam pa 'ching ba kun ldan yin pa dang*/ kun la thams cad snying rje yis/ /sbyin par byed pas sbyin pa rdzogs/ /zhes sogs pha rol tu phyin pa drug rdzogs tshul dang 'og min du sangs rgyas pa sogs mi 'dod par byang chub kyi shing drung du srod la bdud dpung bye ba phrag so bdun btul nas/ tho rangs sbyor lam stan gcig pa nas zad mi skye shes pa'i bar gyi spangs rtogs thams cad bden bzhi mi rtag sogs bcu drug rtogs pa'i lam kho nas thob cing*/ de'i sngon du ring 'phur skyes dang lhag spyod las 'jig rten pa'i bsam gtan gyi man ngag blangs nas ci yang med man las 'dod chags dang bral zin pa'i chags bral sngon song gi sangs rgyas yin pa dang*/ de bzhin du dge bdun nyi shu'i spangs rtogs kyi 'jog tshul dang spangs rtogs las nyams tshul phran tshegs 'ga' zhig ma gtogs thob tshul phal cher dang*/ bsam gtan bzhi dang gzugs med bzhi dang tshad med bzhi la sogs pa'i yon tan phal cher dang*/

sangs rgyas kyi sa na sngon gyi las kyis 'phangs pa'i rnam smin gyi phung po dang zag bcas las kyi lhag ma mang po la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal gyi bden pa yod pa dang*/ nyan thos dang rang rgyal dang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ste lhag med kya ི myang 'das gsum gagazugs zhig tshor ba bsil bar gyur/ /'du shes 'gags shing 'du byed zhi| |rnam par shes pa nub gyur pa/ /de 'dra 'di ni sdug bsngal mtha'/ /zhes bud shing zad pa'i me bzhin du rig pa rgyun chad pa dang*/ gzhi'i shes bya'i gtso bo zag bcas sogs mthun par 'dod do/ /'di dag gi rgyu mtshan ni/ mdzod kyi rtsa bas ji ltar bshad pa bzhin du 'grel bas kyang bsgrubs nas dgag pa ma mdzad par bye mdo thun mong du zhal gyis bzhes pas so/ /de dag so so'i mtshan nyid dang lung gi shes byed la sogs pa mdzod kyi ṭīk+kar bshad zin cing*/ 'dir bris na yi ge mang bar 'gyur bas der bslab par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la/ zag bcas zag med dang*/ bden gnyis 'jog tshul lo// dang po la/ kha cig sde pa 'di gnyis zag bcas zag med kyi 'jog tshul mi mthun te/ mdzod nas bshad pa ni bye smra dang*/ mngon pa kun btus las/ zag pa'i sgo drug gang rung dang 'brel ma 'brel la der bshad pa ni mdo sde pa'i lugs yin pa'i phyir/ de yang mngon pa kun btus/ phyi don khas len gyi sems tsam pa'i gzhung yin la/ don smra gnyis kyi nang nas kyang mdo sde pa dang sgo bstun pa yin pa'i phyir te/ 'byung ba gcig las gyur pa'i 'dus pa sogs mdo sde pa'i lugs bshad pa'i phyir ro zhes gsungs mod kyi/ mi 'thad de/ chos lnga dang ni rang bzhin gsum/ /rnam par shes pa brgyad nyid dang*/ /bdag med gnyis kyi nang du yang/ /theg chen mtha' dag 'dir zad do/ /zhes theg chen gyi brjod bya mtha' dag gtso bor bshad pa'i phyir dang*/ phyi don tshad grub khas len pa'i sems tsam pa shes bya la mi srid pa'i phyir dang*/

mdo sde pa mi 'dod pa'i rig byed min pa'i gzugs bshad pas bye smra'i gzhung du yang thal ba'i phyir dang*| spyir gzhung de'i brjod bya 'ga' zhig sde pa de dang mthun pa byung bas/ gzhung de nas bshad tshad sde pa de'i lugs su byed na ha cang thal ba'i phyir ro| |des na mngon pa kun las btus ni/ byams chos bar pa gsum po ji bzhin du/ legs par dpyad na gnyis stong gi gzhan dbang las gzhan pa'i bden grub kyi chos mi bzhed kyang*/ ma brtags ma dpyad pa'i 'khrul ngor mdo'i dngos bstan gyi rnam gzhag phal cher zhal gyis bzhes pa sems tsam pa'i mchog gyur rnam rdzun pa'i gzhung du de'i ṭīk+ka la sogs pa mang por bshad zin to| |des na chags bcas kyi blo gang gis chos de'i rang bzhin shes nas de la dmigs nas zag pa nyon mongs rnams dmigs pa dang mtshungs ldan gang rung gi sgo nas rgyas shing gnas dang thob par 'gyur ba'i chos ni zag bcas kyi dang*| cig shos rgyas par mi 'gyur ba'i chos ni zag med kyi mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir na/ mtshan gzhi ni lam sogs so/ /'dus ma byas kyi mtshan gzhi la/ mdzod du nam mkha' dang rtags 'gog brtags min gyi 'gog pa ste gsum bye smra'i lugs dang*/ mdo sde pa de'i steng du de bzhin nyid dang bzhi'o zhes bod na grags pa'ang mi 'thad de/ mngon pa kun btus la brten na ni brgyad kyang bshad la/ khungs su mi rung zhing*/ 'phags pa lha'i ye shes snying po kun las btus dang*/ dze tā ri'i gzhung rnam 'byed dang*/ dus 'khor dang*/ zhal lung sogs su/ mdo sde pa'i skabs su/ nam mkha' mo gsham bu dang mtshungs| |'gog pa gnyis kyang de bzhin te/ /zhes 'dus ma byas kyi ngo bo mi mthun pa ma gtogs mtshan gzhi zur pa ma bshad pa'i phyir dang*/ bdag med yan gar ba shes bya zur par 'dod na/ de rtogs pa'i mngon sum gyis de yul du byed dgos pa las/ bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin byas pa/

/'dus byas spyod yul can chags ni/ /rgyu yin de yi gnod byed ni/ /bdag med mthong ba 'gal ba yin/ /zhes bdag gis stong pa'i phung po dag pa ba yul du byed par bshad pa'i phyir dang*/ med dgag dngos su snang ba'i mngon sum 'dod na/ rang bzhin ma dmigs pa'i rtags kyi phyogs chos la dngos rtogs kyi mngon sum khas len dgos pa las/ gcig dmigs nyams su myong ba las/ /zhes sogs shugs rtogs nan gyis bsgrubs pa'i phyir ro/ / gnyis pa la/ rang lugs gzhag pa dang*/ gzhan lugs dgag pa'o/ / dang po ni/ mdzod du/ gang la bcom dang blo yis gzhan/ /bsal na de blo mi 'jug pa/ /bum chu bzhin du kun rdzob tu/ /yod de don dam yod gzhan no| |zhes pa dang rnam 'grel du/ don dam don byed nus pa gang*/ /de 'dir don dam yod pa yin/ /gzhan ni kun rdzob yod pa ste/ /de dag rang spyi'i mtshan nyid bshad/ /ces pa 'di gnyis don gcig ste/ chos gang la gzhig byed kyis gzhig pa dang*/ sel byed kyi blaus cha gzhan bsal bas rang 'dzin gyi blau don mthun mi 'dor ba dang 'dor ba gnyis sam/ yang na don dam par don byed nus pa dang mi nus pa'i chos gnyis po rim bzhin don dam bden pa dang kun rdzob bden pa'i mtshan nyid rnam grangs pa yin pa'i phyir dang*/ mtshan gzhi yang*/ mdzod bzhin du/ rnam 'grail gyi lha dbang blos/ chu dang 'o ma la sogs pa bzhin du kun rdzob tu yod pa yin nam/ gzugs dang bde ba la sogs pa bzhin du don dam par yod pa yin zhes gtso bo 'gog pa'i skabs su gsal bar bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /des na bum pa dang chu dang gang zag la sogs pa kun rdzob rdzun pa blos btags kyi chos yin la/ de dag gi steng gi gzugs dri sogs gzhan rig mngon sum la snang ba dang*/ bde sdug sogs rang rig la myong byar snang ba rnams don dam bden grub yul rang ngos nas grub pa yin zhes pa 'di ni/ mdzod 'grel gyi skabs su mang po dang*/

gzhan yang dbu tshad kyi dngos smra'i 'dod pa ston pa'i skabs mang po bshad kyang bod kyi rtog ge dang dbu mar rlom pa dag gis ma gzigs so/ /chu dang bum sogs de dag kun rdzob pa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ de rnams kyis sogs te/ don dam par yul rang ngos nas don byed nus pa de ni sogs la 'dod dgos na/ bum sogs de dag sogs kyi phyir| |de ltar dngos po bzhir byas la don dam pa'i dang kun rdzob pa'i dngos po gnyis yod par ni rnam 'grel mdzad pas/ don dam par ni rnam dpyad na| |de lta bur gyur ma grub phyir/ /kun rdzob pa yi dngos rnams la/ /de nyid gzhan nyid 'gog par byed/ /ces gsungs shing*/ 'jug pa las/ bum sogs 'di dag de nyid du med cing*/ /'jig rten rab tu grags par yod ji bzhin*| |zhes dngos smra ba 'gog pa'i tshe/ bum pa rdzun pa'i dngos por dngos smra rang la grub pa dper bkod pa gang zhig khyed ltar na rigs smra'i gtso bo mdo sde pas dpe ma grub kyi lan thebs par 'gyur bas/ zla grags mi mkhas pa chen por 'gyur ro/ / gnyis pa ni/ rgyu mtshan des na sogs te/ mdo sde pa de bye smra las kyang grub mtha' dman par byas pa'i phyir te/ de las kyang chos kyi bdag rgya che ba zhig 'dod par khas blangs pa'i phyir te/ bye smras ka ba bum pa chu dang 'o ma ljon shing khang khyim sogs tshogs pa dang rags pa'i chos du ma zhig rigs pas dpyad mi bzod pa'i rdzun par khas blangs la/ mdo sde pas/ de dag rigs pa dpyad bzod kyi bden grub tu khas blangs pa'i phyir ro/ /don dam bden par khas blangs pas rigs pas dpyad bzod du khas blangs par mi 'gyur ro zhe na/ dbu ma pa la de ltar yin kyang*/ mdo sde pa la snga ma de ltar 'gyur te/ don dam sogs kyi phyir ro/ /'o na dngos po dang kun rdzob bden pa'i gzhi mthun ni de ltar byas pas grub pa bden yang*/ spyi mtshan dang dngos po'i gzhi mthun ni ma grub ste/

spyi mtshan dngos med du rigs pa brgyad la sogs pas bsgrubs pa'i phyir dang*/ don byed nus pa gang yin pa/ /de ni rang gi mtshan nyid 'dod/ /ces dngos po tsam la rang mtshan gyis khyab par gsungs pas so zhe na/ ma yin te/ de dag rang spyi'i mtshan nyid bshad/ /ces bden gnyis kyi mtshan gzhi de nyid rang spyi'i mtshan gzhir yang gsal bar gsungs la/ spyi mtshan bum pa lta bus kyang*| mig dang gzugs sogs kyis rang 'dzin ma 'khrul ba skyed pa bzhin du/ don dam par don byed mi nus kyang kun rdzob tsam du rang 'dzin skyed pa'i don byed nus par gsungs te/ gal te kun la de yod na/ /spyi yi mtshan nyid rjes 'gro ldog /blo la ma mthong phyir min te/ /mig dang gzugs sogs blo bzhin no| |'dis ni brda dang rtsol ba sogs/ /nang gi yan lag rjes 'jug phyir| |bum pa 'degs dang spyi dang ni/ /grags sogs blo ni bshad pa yin| |zhes so/ /de dag ni spyi mtshan gyis don byed gtan mi nus pa dang*/ rtog pa la yul de dag gi don spyi tsam las rang mtshan mi snang bar bstan pa yin no zhe na/ 'o na mig dang gzugs sogs dper 'god pa mi rigs par 'gyur te| ri bong rwa sogs blo bzhin no/ /zhes 'god rigs pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du bum pa dang*/ 'degs 'jog sogs kyi las dang*/ grangs dang dus la sogs pa dper bkod pa la'ang rnam bcad med de/ bum gzugs 'dzin pa'i rtog pa la'ang don spyi tsam las mi snang ba'i phyir/ gzhan yang mdo sde pa de ldan sogs nas 'gal zhing mi 'thad de/ ldan min 'du byed rang mtshan dang bden grub tu 'dod pas so/ /des na spyi mtshan dngos med du bsgrubs shing spyi dngos po ba bkag pa ni/ dngos po dag pa ba zhes lan mang por gsungs pas rang mtshan gyi dngos po la dgongs la/ don byed nus pa gang yin pa zhes pa ni don dam zhes sbyar dgos par gong 'og bsgrigs pas gsal te/

spyir yang gzhung gang yin gyi gong 'og mtha' dag bsgrigs nas bshad dgos kyi rang rang gi thad so'i dngos bstan sor bzhag na nang 'gal mang du 'byung ngo*/ /'o na/ gal te thams cad nus med na/ /zhes don dam par don byed nus pa'i dngos po shes bya la mi srid do zhes dbu ma pas smras pa'i lan du/ sa bon sogs ni myug sogs la/ /nus mthong*/ zhes sa myug sogs don dam du grub par bshad pa ma yin nam zhe na/ de ni mtha' gcod pa'i phyir du de ltar lan btab pa na/ dbu ma pas| de 'dra kun rdzob tha snyad pa'i rnam gzhag yin no zhes smras pa na/ ci ste de ltar 'gyur zhes/ kho bo cag kyang mngon sum la dngos su snang ba'i sgo nas mi 'grub pa'i bya byed dang rgyu 'bras la sogs pa rgyun la ltos nas bzhag pa'i shes bya thams cad kun rdzob tha snyad par 'dod pas 'dod mthun no zhes dang*/ de dag 'jal ba'i tshad ma dpyad zhugs thob gsum tshang ba thams cad*/ tha snyad pa'i tshad ma kho na yin gyi/ don dam pa'i tshad ma ni rdul phran dang skad cig ma'i yul can dang blo yang skad cig ma'i phreng ba kho na yin te/ dngos po rang grub dus kyi skad cig gnyis par gnas na ni rtag dngos nyid du 'gyur ro/ /zhes rgyan mkhan pos lan mang du gsungs la/ yul steng nas rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa'i skad cig ma ni/ skad cig nyid phyir bya gang las/ /zhes bya byed dang smra rjod thams cad las grol bas/ don dam bden pa tha snyad pa'i shes rjod las 'das pa ni grub mtha' smra ba'i nang tshan bzhi ga mthun no/ /de ltar na don smra ba'i gtso bo gnyis ka yang*/ yul steng nas don la grub pa ni skad cig ma dang rdul phran cha med kho nar zad mod kyi/ rtog ngor tshogs pa dang rgyun du snang ba'i dngos po gcig tu rlom pa la rgyu 'bras dang bya byed dang blang dor dang dgag sgrub thams cad byed cing*/ de dag kyang kun rdzob rdzun pa'i dngos por khas len pas|

rtag dngos smra ba rnams las khyad zhugs pa gnas lugs gang zag gi bdag med mthong bas nyan rang gi byang chub thob par gzhung lugs phal mo che las 'grim gcig tu gsungs shing*/ gsung rab yongs rdzogs la bltos te tha snyad pa'i gnas lugs khyad par can smra ba po/ bdag med la dmigs pa'i rnal 'byor gyis 'khrul med du nyams su len pa po yin pas gus par bya'i/ bod kyi 'dod pa ltar na ni rtag dngos smra ba dang khyad med du 'gyur zhing*/ khyad par mdo sde pa'i lugs la dngos po tsam mthong bas gnas lugs sam de bzhin nyid mthong bar 'gyur te/ gnas lugs kyi don dang don dam bden pa mtshan nyid gcig tu mi 'dod pa'i grub mtha' smra ba su yang med pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa mi mthun pa bshad pa la/ gtso che ba spyir bshad/ so so ba bye brag tu bshad/ de'i khungs dgod/ gzhan 'khrul bar bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ ye shes snying po kun las btus sogs las 'gyur tha dad du 'byung yang don gcig pa ni/ nam mkha' dang ni 'gog pa gnyis/ /'dus ma byas gsum rtag pa ste/ /'dus byas thams cad skad cig ma/ /bdag gis stong zhing byed po med/ /dbang skyes blo ni rnam med kyis/ /phra rab bsags pa dngos su rig

kha che'i gzhung gi chu gter gyi/ /bye brag smra ba'i gzhung 'don 'gyur| |zhes dang*/ shes pa rnam bcas skyed byed ni/ /dbang po'i spyod yul snang ba med/ /nam mkha' mo gsham bu dang mtshungs/ /'gog pa gnyis kyang de bzhin te/ /'du byed bem po yod ma yin/ /dus gsum rjes 'gro dag kyang med| |thogs pa med pa'i gzugs yod min/ /zhes pa mdo sde pa yis rig |ces pas bye mdo gnyis kyi 'dod tshul mi 'thun pa'i gtso bo bshad de/ phyi mas kyang 'dus ma byas gsum po rtag par 'dod kyang mi rtag pa bkag tsam gyi med dgag yongs gcod du ri rwa dang 'dra bar ngo bo ma grub pa'i shes bya tsam du 'dod la/ snga mas ngo bo ma grub pa'i shes bya 'jog ma shes nas yongs gcod du grub pa'i rdzas sam dngos por khas len gyi 'dus ma byas dngos por 'dod ces pa'ang don byed nus pa'i 'dus byas kyi dngos por nam yang mi 'dod de/ 'dus ma byas la de dag med/ /ces de la rgyu dang 'bras bu gnyis ka med par 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang de chos gzhan gyi byed rgyu dang bral 'bras su khas len pa ni/ de gnyis la rgyu 'bras kyis ma khyab pa'am/ khyab par 'dod na grub mtha' nyid kyi nang 'gal yin no/ /bye smra'i nang tshan kha cig 'du byed rgyun brtan pa rnams skad cig gis mi 'jig pa dang*/ byed pa po'i gang zag rdzas yod brjod med 'dod kyang*/ kha che ba rnams skad cig kho nar 'jig pa dang bdag gis ston par 'dod pa ni mdo sde pa dang thun mong ba'o/ /dbang shes rang yul rnam med rjen car du 'dzin pa dang*/ rnam pas bar du chod par 'dzin pa gnyis yul 'dzin tshul ches mi mthun pa'o| |'dzin mkhan dbang po dang shes pa gnyis kas byed pa dang dbang pos mi byed pa yang ngo*/ /gzung bya rags pa ling po gcig tu snang ba ni g.yag rnga dang ne'u gsing bzhin du dbang shes kyis 'byed ma nus pas rtog pas gcig tu bzung ba yin gyi/

bsags rdul zla bcas so so ba snang bar 'dod pa ni thun mong ba'o/ /'du byed bem po zhes pa/ gzugs sems las don gzhan rdzas yod dang*/ de med par gnas skabs la btags pa'i btags yod kyi dngos po dang*| 'das ma 'ongs kyang ngo bo da lta ba ltar yod pa dang*/ don dang de ni zad phyir ro/ /zhes da lta med pa dang thogs med rig byed min pa'i gzugs yod med rnams snga phyi go rim bzhin te/ tshig 'di dag dus 'khor rtsa rgyud kyi yin no| |gnyis pa ni/ don smra gnyis bden gnyis mi mthun par 'dod pa bkag nas mthun pa de'i phyir don smra gnyis kyi grub mtha' mi mthun pa'i khyad par mdzod rtsa 'grel sogs su gsal bar 'byung ba ni 'di dag ste mngon sogs te/ snga mas 'di rnams bcom ldan 'das kyi mdo las dngos su gsungs pa ched du brjod pa'i tshoms bzhin du dgra bcom so sos bsdus pa tsam yin pas bka' yin zhes zer la/ phyi mas de ltar ma yin gyi/ ye shes la 'jug ka t+yā'i bus| |rab tu byed pa dbyig bshes kyis/ /chos kyi phung po shā ri'i bus| |gdags pa'i bstan bcos mau+o gal bus/ /rnam shes tshogs ni lha skyid kyis| |'gro ba'i rnam grangs gsus po ches/ khams kyi tshogs ni gang pos byas| |zhes pa dgra bcom de dag so sos rang dbang du brtsams pa'i bstan bcos yin no zhes 'dod pas so/ /lung sogs chos kyi phung po ni 'du byed phung po dang gzugs kyi phung por 'dod de/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dag /gang dag thub pas gsungs de dag |tshig gam ming yin de dag kyang*/ /gzugs sam 'du byed dag tu 'dus| |zhes tshig dag sgra rang mtshan rna ba'i yul dang*/ /ming spyi ldan min 'du byed yid rtog bcas kyi yul yin pas snga phyi ldog ste sbyor ro/ /chos phung gi grangs ni/ 'dir brgyad khri zhes bshad kyang*/ mdo sngags gzhan du stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi zhes pa sha stag 'byung zhing*/

tshad kyang*/ shā ri'i bus mdzad pa'i bstan bcos la sho lo ka drug stong yod pa'i sho lo ka'i grangs de tsam rigs par 'dod pa dang*/ phung khams sogs kyi gtam gyi sde tshan rdzogs pa re re dang*/ 'dod chags sogs la spyod pa brgyad khri sogs te/ spyod pa de 'dra re re'i gnyen po rdzogs par ston pa ste/ phyi ma 'di dbyig gnyen rang lugs su grags pa rnams ni theg pa thung mong ba ste/ theg chen thun mong min pa ltar na glang po che rab brtan gyis theg tshad kyi snag tshas chos phung gcig las 'bri bar mi nus so zhes bshad do/ /rtsom byed rdul phran sogs te/ 'di ni bod na gsal bar grags mod kyi/ khungs ni/ phyi rol don grub las/ phan tshun bdag nyid ma reg par/ /cha shas med par rnam gnas te/ /de phyir sa yi dkyil 'khor sogs/ /bsag pa dag ni 'byung ba yin/ zhes dang*/ tha dad phyogs nas mang po dag/'ga' la kun nas skor tsam du/ /gnas par zad kyi rdul de ni/ /cha shas bcas pa'i bdag nyid min/ /zhes dang*/ gnas brtan btsun pas rdul phra rab rnams ma 'byar ba bar med pas reg par 'du shes so zhes pa tsam du zad la/ rigs pa ni/ snga mas reg na cha gcig gis reg gam bdag nyid kun gyi regadang po ltar na reg ma reg gi cha tha dad byung bas cha bcas su 'gyur ba dang phyi ma ltar na/ rdul phran mang po bsdoms kyang gcig las ma byung bas rags pa mi rtsom par 'gyur ba'i phyir ma reg pa'i bar bcas su 'dod la/ phyi mas de ltar na de gnyis kyi bar du rdul phran gnyis pa shong ngam mi shong*/ mi shong na reg par 'gyur zhing shong na de'i bar du yang de bzhin du 'gyur bas thug pa med pa'i phyir reg kyang ma 'byar bas cha bcas kyi skyon med do zhes zer mod kyi/ rang rang gi blo tshod dang bstun pa'i rigs pa'i gnod pa ma mthong ba nyid rang rang gi grub mtha'i mthar thug yin pas/ blo gong ma'i rigs pa'i gnod par ni 'os pa yin te/

rnal 'byor pa yang blo khyad kyis/ /gong ma gong ma rnams kyis gnod/ /ces so// rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs lung dang rigs pas sgrub pa dang 'gog cing mi sgrub pa ste/ rnam gsum dri med gzugs gsungs dang*/ / 'phel dang ma byas lam sogs phyir/ /mdo las/ bstan yod thogs bcas dang*| bstan med thogs bcas dang*/ bstan med thogs med kyi gzugs gsum gsungs pas/ dang po gzugs kyi skye mched/ bar pa sgra sogs bzhi dang dbang po gzugs can yin pas/ gsum pa'i mtshan gzhi gzhan med pas dang gzugs gang la dmigs na chags sogs mi skye ba zag pa med pa'i gzugs gsungs pa yang de bzhin dang*/ rdzas las byung ba dang ma byung ba'i bsod nams bdun bdun mngon par 'phel bar gsungs te/ dge 'dun la kun dga' ra ba sogs phul na der dge bdun gyis longs spyod mdzad pa'i tshe/ sbyin pa po de gnyid log pa'i rgyud la yang bsod nams 'phel ba lta bu dang*/ gzhan byed du bcug nas rang gis ma byas pa'i srog gcod lta bu'i las lam rtogs par gsungs pa dang*/ chos ni phyi'i skye mched de bstan du med la thogs pa med pa'o zhes gsungs kyi gzugs can min pa'o zhes ma gsungs pa dang 'phags lam yan lag brgyad kyi yang dag pa'i ngag sogs gsum mnyam par bzhag pa'i rgyud la yang yod pa'i phyir dang*/ dge slong yid yengs pa dang gnyid log pa'i tshe yang sdom ldan yin pa'i phyir dang sdom pa ni 'chal tshul gyi rgyun 'gog pa'i chu lon lta bur gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes pa brgyad bye smras bkod la/ mdo sde pas| dang po gnyis dang lnga pa'i don ni/ sa phyogs keng rus su gsal bar snang ba lta bu rnal 'byor pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi gzugs su snang ba la dgongs la/ gsum pa dang bzhi pa ni/ dge sdig gi sems pas bzhag pa'i sems rgyud 'gyur ba'i rgyun gyi khyad par dang*/ gzhan rnams mi mthun phyogs mi byed pa'i dran shes khyad par can gyi mthus byas pa'i lus sems kyi khyad par yin pas sgrub byed de rnams kyis mi 'grub la rgyud 'gyur ba'i khyad par dang*/

sems pa dang dran pas bzhag pa'i lus sems kyi khyad par mngon sum gyis mi 'grub pas rtogs dka' na/ rig byed min pa'i gzugs ni de bas kyang dka'o zhes skyon spong dang bcas te 'gog par byed do/ /bod dag kyang mdo sde pa rigs pa bzang ngo snyam du mtho kha 'grims nas de'i rjes su 'brang zhing sdom pa dang gzugs can gyi gzhi mthun gtan mi 'dod la| dbu sems kyang 'di ltar bzhed do zhes mgrin gcig tu smra zhing*/ spyod 'jug las/ spong ba'i sems ni thob pa las/ /tshul khrim pha rol phyin par bshad| |ces sogs shes byed du 'dren no/ /'di ni mi 'thad de/ mngon pa kun las btus dang*/ sa sde dang*/ phung po lnga'i rab byed dang*/ dbu ma phung po lnga pa sogs las/ rig byed min pa'i gzugs gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir dang*| khyad par yang dag par blangs pa las byung ba so thar gyi sdom pa ni gzugs phung gi nang du bsdus pa'i phyir dang*/ rigs pa yang*/ so thar gzugs can ma yin na/ /len pa'i tshe lus ngag gi rig byed la bltos pa dang/ /srung ba'i tshe yid kyi mi dge ba gsum po ngo skal gyi spang byar mi 'jog par gzugs can bdun nyid la 'jog pa dang*/ /gtong ba'i tshe yang 'chal tshul gzugs can nges par dgos shing khyad par lus brjes pas gtong ba rnams mi 'thad de/ byang sems dang gsang sngags bzhin no zhes pa la mkhas mchog dbyig gnyen gyis kyang lan mi 'debs shing*/ de nyid kyang gzugs can du bzhed par gsal te| |'chal ba'i tshul khrims mi dge'i gzugs/ /de spong tshul khrims rnam gnyis so/ /zhes 'chal tshul dang de spong byed rig byed dang de ma yin gnyis so zhes gsal bar bris nas/ dgag pa dngos dang sngar bshad dran lam du 'phen pa tsam yang ma mdzad pas so/ /des na mdo sde pa la'ang rig min 'gog pas ma khyab ste/ mdo sde pa mkhas shes kyis mi 'gog pa'i phyir zhes brjod par bya'o|

|'on kyang sgrub byed rgyas pa rnams ni mi mdzad pas bye smra dang khyad che'o| |des na/ gzugs kyi mtshan nyid/ mig shes kyis blta bya zhes bris nas/ gzugs can la rten yod kyis khyab par 'dod pa dag gis 'di'i brgal brtag byed pa ni bstan pa nyams pa'i skyon yin no/ /yang dbang po yul 'dzin bzhin pa ni rten mtshungs dang*/ da lta mi 'dzin pa ni de mtshungs te/ dang po rten mtshungs kyi dbang po gzugs can tshad mar 'dod pa dang*/ tshad ma la shes rig gis khyab par 'dod pa dang*/ gzung 'dzin dang*/ rgyu 'bras phal cher kun dus mnyam du/ lhan cig 'byung gang phan tshun 'bras/ /'byung bzhin sems kyi rjes 'jug bzhin/ /zhes sogs dang*/ mtshungs ldan rgyu ni sems dag dang*| |sems byung rten mtshungs can rnams so/ /zhes 'dod pa dang*/ rgyu yi dngos po ma gtogs pa'i/ /gzung ba zhes bya gzhan ci'ang med/ /ces dang*/ phan 'dogs gang yin skyed pa yin/ /zhes rgyu 'bras la bskyed bya skyed byed kyi khyab la/ dus mnyam la ma grub na bskyed bya med pa bzhin du skyed byed kyang med la| grub na skyed byed grub pa bzhin du bskyed bya yang grub pas mi nus pa dang mi dgos par 'gyur zhes bkag nas skyed byed 'gag pa dang bskyed bya skye ba srang mda'i mtho dman bzhin du 'dod cing*/ dus tha dad pa ji ltar 'dzin/ /zhe na rigs pa shes pa yis/ /shes pa'i rnam pa 'jog nus pa'i/ /rgyu nyid la ni gzung bar shes/ /zhes gzung 'dzin rgyu 'bras dus mnyam du mi 'dod par snga phyir 'dod pas/ don 'dis rigs smra'i mchog tu grags so/ /de bzhin du da lta don du snang ba 'di rnam pas bar du chod na don dngos su ma rtogs par 'gyur bas phyi don dngos yin zhes dang*/ de 'gags kyang des bzhag pa'i shes pa'i rnam pa yin mod kyi/ de dang 'dra ba myong bas de myong bar gdags te/ bum pa'i gzugs dngos su mi 'dzin kyang de dang 'dra ba bzung bas/

'jig rten rgyu gzugs 'dzin zhes brjod/ /ces dang*/ dbu ma rgyan du/ shes pa rnam bcas phyogs la ni/ /dngos su de gnyis tha dad kyang*/ /de dang 'dra ba myong bas na| |don myong zhes ni gdags su rung*/ /zhes bshad do/ /'di la bod sngar rabs pa dag phyi don lkog na mo zhes zer la/ phyi rabs pa dag de lta na bskal don dang 'dra bar 'gyur bas/ phyi don dngos su snang zhes zer mod kyi/ bye smra dang khyad par gang gis 'byed pa soms shig /des na bstan pa rim gyis je mthor 'gyur bas/ sems tsam rnam 'den pa dang 'di gnyis snang ba shes pa yin par mtshungs kyang*/ gtod byed phyi don yod med kyis 'byed pa yin no| |lkog na mo dang de bskal don du mthong ba nyid kas ma go ste/ rang 'dzin la rnam pa gtad ma thag tu 'gag nas gtan med du song ba'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang rnam pa gtad pa nyid kyis dngos yul du song ba yin no/ /gzhan yang*/ spyir ring thung sogs dang*/ khyad par lus kyi thal mo sbyar ba lta bu'i dbyibs ni kha dog gi bkod pa las don gzhan pa'i rdzas yod du dang*/ de lta na/ gnyis bzung 'gyur te rdul la med/ /ces bkag nas kha dog gi bkod pa la btags pa'i btags yod du 'dod pa dang*/ dus rnams kun tu yod gsungs phyir| |gnyis phyir yul yod phyir 'bras phyir/ /zhes dus gsum ka da ltar ba bzhin du rdzas yod dang*/ de bzhin du/ yod na ci phyir ma skyes phyir/ /zhes dang*/ rang bzhin yang ni rtag tu yod/ /dngos po rtag par yang mi 'dod/ /rang bzhin las kyang dngos mi gzhan/ /dbang phyug tha snyad yin par gsal/ /zhes sogs kyis de bkag nas/ 'das ma 'ongs kyi dus blos btags kyi dngos po dang*/ de gnyis kyi dus can so so rnams da lta 'gags shing ma skyes nas med par 'dod pas so/ /bye smra'i sgrub byed ni/ dang po gnyis lung ste/ dge slong dag 'das ma 'ongs kyi gzugs yod de/

med na de gnyis la dmigs pa'i nyon mongs spong bar mi 'gyur ba las spong ba'i phyir/ zhes dang*/ rnam par shes pa ni gnyis las skye ste/ mig dang gzugs nas yid dang chos las so/ /zhes pa'i chos la 'das ma 'ongs kyang yod pa'o/ /phyi ma gnyis rigs pa ste/ rnam shes yin na yul yod pas khyab pa'i phyir dang*/ 'das pa'i las las da ltar 'bras bu 'byung bas so/ /zhes pa'o/ /spyir shes bya gzhi lnga ste/ snang ba gzugs kyis gzhi/ gtso bo sems kyi gzhi| 'khor sems byung gi gzhi/ gnas skabs ldan min 'du byed kyi gzhi/ bral rdzas 'dus ma byas kyi gzhi'o/ /bye brag tu/ thob dang ma thob skal mnyam dang*/ /'du shes med snyoms 'jug dag dang*/ /srog dang mtshan nyid rnams dang ni/ /ming gi tshogs la sogs pa yang*/ /zhes pa'i ldan min 'du byed rnams gang gi gnas skabs la bzhag pa'i gnas skabs can la don gzhan rang rkya thub pa'i rdzas yod du 'dod pa dang*/ gzugs sems gnyis dang sems byung tshor 'du gnyis sam sems pa dang gsum rnams rdzas yod yin gyi/ gzhan mtha' dag cha la btags pa'i gtags yod kyi dngos po dang dngos med du 'dod pa'o/ /sngar bshad pa ltar 'dus ma byas sogs te/ 'gog bden dbang po lnga'i thob byar dang*/ chos thams cad kyi mchog tu dang*/ 'phags pa'i bden par dang*/ bden pa gsum par dang*/ bral ba'i rdzas su gsungs pas dngos por yod ces dang*/ gzugs dang tshor ba bzhin du ngo bo dang*/ mig sogs bzhin du nus pa tshad mas ma dmigs pa'i phyir dang*/ rgyu dang 'bras bu med pa'i phyir dang*/ mdo las kyang*/ bral ba dang*/ zad pa dang*/ nub pa dang*/ 'byung ba med pa'i sgras gsungs la bstan bcos rab tu byed pa las kyang dngos po med pa'i chos rnams gang zhe na/ 'dus ma byas kyi chos dag go /zhes bshad pa rnams kyis so sor sgrub la/ bye smras/ bstan bcos kyi 'gal spong ni/ dngos po lnga ste/ yongs gcod du grub par rang bzhin gyi dang*/

dmigs rkyen tsam byed pa dmigs pa'i dang thob pa lta bu ldan pa'i dang*/ 'dus byas mtha' dag rgyu'i dang*/ khang zhing lta bu yongs bzung gi dngos po rnams las/ bstan bcos kyi de ni bzhi pa ma yin pa la dgongs zhes zer ro/ /de bzhin du gang zag gi bdag bkag tsam gyi med dgag de de bzhin nyid du 'jog mi shes pa gnyis dang*/ sor mo'i rtse mos rang la rang mi reg cing*/ ral gri'i so rang gis rang mi gcod pa bzhin du/ shes pa la rang myong rang rig mi 'dod pa dang*/ ci ste rang dngos mi rig na/ /ji ltar gzhan gyi ngo bo rig /ces dang*/ rang nyid gsal ba myong ba ste/ /'dra bar snang ba dmigs pa yin/ /des na shes pa thams cad kyi/ /dmigs myong dag ni tha dad yin/ /zhes mar mes rang mi gsal na gzhan yang gsal bar byed mi nus pa bzhin du/ shes pa mtha' dag la kha nang du bltas pa'i myong ba rang rig 'dod pa gnyis so/ /rgyu 'bras mtshan mtshon bsgrub bya sgrub byed sogs kyi bya byed dang gang zag gi rgyud la spangs rtogs thob pa lta bu'i ldan pa dang*/ me du de byung dang byas mi rtag bdag gcig pa lta bu'i 'brel ba rnams/ byed pa po dang*/ thob pa po dang*/ 'brel ba can rnams las rdzas sam don gzhan rdzas yod dang de'i cha la btags pa'i don gcig btags yod du 'dod pa dang*/ lus kyi shes pa bsam gtan gyi yan lag tu mi rung ba dang rung bar 'dod de/ rdzas su bcu gcig dang po ni/ /shin tu sbyangs pa bde ba yin/ /zhes bsam gtan dang po'i yan lag dga' bde gnyis las dga' ba ni/ yid shes 'khor gyi bde ba yin la| bde ba dbang shes 'khor gyi bde ba la byas na/ dbang shes ngo bo nyid kyi rnam g.yeng yin pas bsam gtan gyi 'khor du 'byung mi srid pas/ shin tu sbyangs pa la byed do zhes dang*/ dpe ston sde pa na re/ dbang shes kha phyir bltas pa phal pa rnams de ltar yin kyang*/ 'dir rlung las su rung ba la brten pa'i nang reg khyad par can yul du byed pa'i lus shes 'khor gyi tshor ba bde ba ni bsam gtan gyi yan lag tu legs par rung ngo zhes bshad pa dang*/

'phags sogs te/ de yang 'jig rten pa'i lam gyi thob pa'i 'bras bu bar pa gnyis las nyams pa ni mdo sde pa yang 'dod cing*/ rgyun zhugs las nyams pa ni bye smra yang mi 'dod mod kyi/ bzhi ni rigs las lnga 'bras las/ /nyams 'gyur dang po las ma yin/ /zhes/ gtso bor dgra bcom gyi 'bras bu las nyams pa yod par/ dgra bcom pa la yang rnyed pa dang bkur stis bar chad byed pa yod do zhes sogs la brten nas sgrubs pa dang*/ de mthong chos la bder gnas kyi snyoms 'jug khyad par can las nyams pa la dgongs kyi/ dge slong dag 'phags pa'i shes rab kyis spangs pa gang yin pa de ni legs par spangs pa yin no zhes gsungs pas 'phags lam gyis thob pa'i spangs rtogs mtha' dag nyams pa mi srid do zhes so| |des na dgra bcom la nyams pa'i chos can sogs kyi dbye ba bshad pa yang yon tan khyad par can gyi dbang du byas la/ mngon pa ye shes la 'jug pa las| nyon mongs kyi rkyen gsum ma tshang na nyon mongs mi skye zhing*/ /dgra bcom gyis phra rgyas ma spangs na dgra bcom du mi rung*/ spangs na rgyu med kyi 'bras bu mi srid pa'i rigs pas bsgrubs nas/ sol ba'i phung po'i mdo las/ mi dge ba'i sems mngon du 'gyur bar bshad pa dgra bcom la sbyar ba ltar snang yang slob pa'i dbang du byas par bsgrubs so/ /lus sogs ni lus la sems kyi sa bon yod par/ mdo sde pa'i dbang du byas nas rnam 'grel sogs su bshad la/ bye smra'i gzhung gang du'ang de mi 'byung ngo*/ /rags sogs ni/ 'dod na dbang po med pa dang*/ /sgra med phra rab rdul rdzas brgyad/ /lus dbang ldan la rdzas dgu'o| |dbang po gzhan ldan rdzas bcu'o/ /zhes bum pa lta bu'i tshogs pa'am rags pa yan lag can gcig la/ 'byung ba bzhi dang 'byung 'gyur gzugs dri ro reg bzhi ste rdul rdzas brgyad 'dus su nges par skye ste/ gang rung gcig ma tshang na rang rang gi bya ba byed mi nus pa'i phyir dang*/

yod par mngon sum gyis grub pa'i phyir te/ gzugs sogs rang 'dzin gyis rtogs/ 'byung ba bzhi 'dzin sdud smin skyod kyi bya ba bzhis 'grub pas so/ /lus dbang dang ldan na de dang dgu| mig dbang sogs dang ldan pa la lus dbang yang nges par yod pas bcu dang bcu gcig sogs nges par ldan zhing*/ de yang rigs mi mthun rnams go sa gcig tu dang*/ rigs mthun rnams tha dad du gnas te/ gzhan du na rags pa rtsom mi nus pas so zhes dang*/ bya ba tsam gyis mngon gyur mi 'grub pas gang la gang dmigs pa de yod kyis ma dmigs pa de med ces so/ /sems byung sogs ni| gti mug med pa dang lta ba dang shes bzhin ma yin pa rnams shes rab la btags shing*/ brjed ngas dang rnam g.yeng dran pa dang ting nge 'dzin nyon mongs can yin pas sems byung gi dbye bar mi bgrang ngo*/ /des na mdzod kyi rtsa bar bgrangs pa'i sems kyi dang dge ba'i sa mang bcu bcu/ nyon mongs chen po'i dang mi dge ba'i sa pa drug dang gnyis/ nyon mongs chung ngu'i sa pa bcu ste so brgyad/ dbyig bshes kyis/ sdom du mdzad pa/ rtog dpyod 'gyod gnyis khro chags dang*/ /nga rgyal the tshom ma nges brgyad/ /ces zhe drug po thams cad sems las kyang rdzas gzhan/ nang phan tshun yang rdzas gzhan gyi rdzas yod du dang*/ btsun pa dpe can/ tshor 'du sems pa gsum/ rtogs pa'i rdzas de gsum gyi steng du reg pa yid byed gnyis te lnga kho na de ltar grub kyi/ gzhan thams cad sems kyi cha la btags pas btags yod rdzas gcig nyid dang*/ btsun pa dpal len ni/ mdo las/ gang ci tshor yang rung de thams cad 'dir sdug bsngal lo zhes gsungs pas/ /bde ba'i tshor ba gzhi ma grub par 'dod pa'o/ /rten 'brel sogs ni/ ma rig nyon mongs sngon gnas skabs| |'du byed dag ni sngon las kyi/ /sogs dang*/ 'di ni gnas skabs par 'dod do/ /zhes sngon nyon mongs skyes pa'i gnas skabs kyi phung po lnga ga tshogs pa ma rig pa dang*/

de bzhin du las gsog pa'i gnas skabs kyi phung po lnga ga 'du byed yin pa sogs dang*/ rig pa'i mi mthun phyogs chos gzhan/ /ma rig mi mdza' rdzun sogs bzhin/ /zhes las 'phen par byed pa'i sems byung nyon mongs can gyi ma rig pa nyid de'i mtshan gzhir byed pa sogs so/ /bod kha cig 'di la lung gi mdo sde pa dang*/ rnam 'grel las/ nyes pa rnam pa thams cad dag /'jig tshogs lta las skyes pa yin/ /de ma rig der de las chags/ /zhes 'jig lta nyid ma rig par bzhed pa ni rigs pa'i mdo sde pa yin no zhes zer cing*/ de bzhin du/ stong nyid bdun cu par/ rgyu rkyen las skyes dngos po rnams/ /yang dag nyid du rtogs pa gang*/

/de ni ston pas ma rig gsungs| |zhes bden 'dzin nyid ma rig par bzhed do zhes zer ba ni mi 'thad de/ shing rta'i mchog de dag gis lta ba dang lta min gyi sems byung gcig tu 'dzin pa mi srid pa'i phyir ro/ /des na lta ba de dag yul gyi/ gnas lugs la rmongs pa'i cha nas mi blun po la rmongs pa zhes sgrogs pa bzhin du/ ma rig pa dang mi shes pa dang rmongs pa zhes pa'i sgra bshad du rung ba la dgongs shing*/ de dag 'khor ba'i rtsa bar bzhed pa ni/ nyon mongs can gyi sems byung ma rig pa dang gnyen po gcig cing*/ skye 'gag gcig pa la dgongs so/ /de tsam gyis 'khor ba'i rtsa ba mang por mi 'gyur te/ 'jig lta'i grogs kyi tshor 'du la sogs pa bzhin no/ /gsum pa ni/ de lta bu'i bye mdo gnyis kyi khyad par 'di dag rje btsun spyan sogs rnams kyis dus 'khor 'grel chen dang rtog ge 'bar ba dang mdzod 'grel du rgyas par ji ltar sogs bstan pas na yid ches pa'i gnas su bzung bar bya ba yin no/ /bzhi pa ni/ rgya bod sogs te/ bye brag smra ba la bdag smras khyab pa dang*/ rang sde phyi don smra ba gnyis kyi gzhi lam 'bras bu dang grub mtha'i gsang mtha' dag ston pa chos mngon pa'i mdzod la bye brag smra ba'i rtog thum yin pas bslab par mi bya'o/ /zhes dang slob dpon thogs med kyis gtan la dbab pa bsdu ba dang*| kun las btus gnyis kyis rim pa ltar de gnyis kyi grub mtha' ston no zhes pa dang*/ mdo sde pa theg chen par sdud pa dang de la lung dang rigs pa smra ba'i dbye ba 'byed pa sogs ni mi 'thad pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ bye smra'i nang tshan gyi 'dod pa brjod med kyi bdag ni dang por mdo sde rgyan du/ gal te rdzas yod brjod min pa'i/ /dgos pa yang ni brjod dgos so/ /gcig dang gzhan du brjod min pa/ /dgos pa med par mi rigs so/ /mtshan nyid dang ni 'jig rten na/

/mthong phyir bstan bcos sgo nas kyang*| |bud shing me bzhin gnyis su ni/ /brjod min mi rung dmigs phyir ro| |zhes dang*/ dus 'khor rtsa 'grel du yang bkag la 'jug par yang*/ gal te bdag gang dngos por grub gyur na/ /sems ltar grub dngos brjod du med mi rung*/ /zhes sogs kyis bkag cing*/ khyad par mdzod 'grel gyi gnas dgu par yul drug dang yid bzhin du mngon sum dang dbang po gzugs can lnga bzhin du rjes dpag gis kyang mi 'grub pa'i phyir dang*/ bud shing dang me'i dpes brjod mi rung du yang mi 'grub ste/ rigs pas brtag na de gnyis bsreg bya sreg byed yin pa'i sgo nas rdzas gzhan du grub pas dpe ma grub pa'i phyir ro| |zhes sogs lung dang rigs pa du mas btags yod du bsgrubs te/ de'i 'grel bshad du tshigs bcad kyi tshul gyis brjod bde zhing go sla bar kho bos bshad zin to/ /theg chen sogs te/ mdo sde rgyan du/ sngar lung ma bstan lhan gcig 'byung*| |spyod yul ma yin grub pa dang*/ /yod dang med na yod med dang*/ / gnyen po dang ni sgra gzhan phyir/ /zhes sogs shin tu rgyas pa dang*/ de bzhin du klu sgrub zhabs kyis/ rin chen phreng ba dang*/ legs ldan gyi rtog ge 'bar ba dang*| zhi ba lhas/ spyod 'jug tu legs par bsgrubs te/ mdor na gzhung lugs 'og ma'i nang du rgyas par ma byung bas spyir med par mi 'grub cing*| bsdus pa'i tshul gyis ma byung ba yang ma grub/ khyad par mdo sde la 'jug 'dul ba la snang*/ chos nyid dang mi 'gal ba yang*/ sde snod kyi brjod bya spyi tsam gyi cha nas theg dman gyi sde snod gsum la 'jug pa sogs kyang grub cing*/ khyad par gyi cha nas theg chen rang nyid la 'jug pa sogs dang*/ spyir zab rgyas blor ma shong ba rtog ge nyid kyi shes rab dang mos pa dang bsod nams zhan pa'i dbang gis yin par gsungs so| |bye smra'i sogs ni/

gtso bor thob pa la sogs pa'i bya byed ldan 'brel don gzhan yin na/ byed po dang 'brel med du 'gyur zhing*/ 'brel ba gnyis pa yod na de yang don gzhan pas de la yang 'brel ba gzhan dgos pas thug med du 'gyur ba sogs so/ /mdo sde pa de yi sogs te/ 'brel po sogs kyi gnas skabs can rdzas yod dang*/ khyad par rdul phran cha med ni/ drug gis cig car sbyar ba na/ /zhes sogs kyis rgya cher 'gog par 'gyur bas 'dir rgyas par mi brjod do/ /grub mtha' kun shes las gzung ba phyi don bden par grub pa'i chos bdag rigs pas dgag pa'i le'u ste gsum pa rgya cher bshad pa'o// // gnyis pa la/ theg chen spyi'i rnam gzhag bshad pa dang*/ khyad par sems tsam gyi 'dod pa dgod pa/ de gzhan dang sprel nas dgag pa'o/ /dang po la/ theg chen gyi rigs bsdu ba/ shing rta gnyis kyi bzhed tshul bshad pa'o/ /dang po la/ gzhung lugs dang*| grub mtha' bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni/ spyir theg pa zhes pa khal dang ldan pa'i glang chen sogs la grags pa ltar khur khyer ba'i don yin la/ de yang che ba dang chung bas mchog dman du bzhag go /de yang 'dis 'gro ba lam dang 'dir 'gro ba 'bras bu'i theg pa ste/ rang rang gi bsam sbyor khyad par can dang*/ /'bras bu byang chub bam myang 'das so/ /chen por 'jog pa ni/ mdo sde rgyan du dmigs pa che ba nyid dang ni/ /de bzhin sgrub pa gnyis dag dang*/ /ye shes brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang*| |thabs la mkhas par gyur pa dang*/ /yan dag grub pa chen po dang*/ / sangs rgyas phrin las chen po ste/ /chen po 'di dang ldan pas na/ /theg chen zhes ni brjod pa yin/ /zhes theg chen gyi sde snod rgya chen po la dmigs pa dang*/ rang gzhan gnyis ka'i don sgrub pa dang*/ bdag med gnyis ka rtogs pa'i ye shes dang*| gus sbyor dang rtag sbyor gyi brtson 'grus dang*/ lus ngag gi mi dge ba bdun gnang ba lta bu'i thabs mkhas dang*/

stobs sogs sangs rgyas kyi yon tan yang dag par 'grub pa dang*/ lhun grub rgyun ldan gyi phrin las rnams re re zhing chen po sbyar bas chen po bdun no/ /dbus mtha' las ni/ bla med nyid ni sgrub pa dang*/ /dmigs pa dang ni yan dag 'grub/ /bstan pa yin par 'dod pa'o| |zhes grub pa dang dmigs pa dang yang dag par 'grub pa rnams la bla med sbyar ba gsum ste/ dang po la rgya che ba la sogs pa'i dam pa bcu gnyis phar phyin bcu ldan dang*/ thos bsam sgom pa'i yid byed gsum chos spyod bcu ldan dang*/ /rnam g.yeng drug spangs pa'i mi g.yeng ba dang*/ phyin ci log bcu spangs pa'i phyin ci ma log gnyis rim bzhin zhi lhag gi rjes su mthun pa dang rtag chad la sogs pa'i mtha' spangs pa dang*/ sa bcu'i khyad par can dang khyad med de yon tan so so dang thun mong ba ste/ dam pa/ yid byed rjes mthun chos/ mtha' spangs/ khyad par can dang khyad med de sgrub pa drug dang*/ gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis rnam par bzhag pa dang*/ bdag med gnyis kyi dbyings la dmigs pa sogs dmigs pa bcu gnyis dang*/ rigs dang chos la mos pa sogs bcu po la/ ma tshang med dang mi spong dang*/ /sogs kyis ming btags pa'i yang dag 'grub pa bcu ldan te/ theg dman la gtan med pa'i khyad chos so| |de bzhin du theg bsdus su/ shes bya'i gnas dang mtshan nyid der 'jug sogs| theg chen gyi khyad chos bcu gsungs pa dang*/ mdo las/ chos lnga dang ni rang bzhin gsum/ /rnam par shes pa brgyad nyid dang*/ /bdag med gnyis kyi nang du yang*/ /theg chen mtha' dag 'dir zad do/ /zhes sogs dang*/ rgyud sde las kyang mang du gsungs te yi ge mang bar 'gyur bas bzhag go /de lta bu'i theg pa chen po ni/ rjod byed gzhung lugs gtso bor byas na/ mdo sde'i phyogs dang sngags kyi phyogs gnyis kyis bsdus te/ mdo sde'i 'khor lo bar mtha' gnyis ka dang sngags rgyud sde bzhi ga nyan thos sde gnyis kyi rigs can bkar mi 'dod pas/

mdo sngags gnyis ka la theg chen bka' sgrub rgya cher mdzad pa'i phyir ro/ /mdo sngags kyi khyad par sogs ni gzhan du bshad zin to| |gnyis pa la/ dam bca' bzhag pa/ sgrub byed dgod pa/ rtsod pa spang ba'o/ / dang po ni/ mdo sngags gnyis ka'ang grub mtha' smra ba po dbu sems sogs te/ mkhas pa chen po shān+ti pa dang*/ dri med sbas pa dang*/ sher 'byung sbas pa la sogs pa 'phags yul gyi rdo rje slob dpon tshad ldan du ma sems tsam pa yin pa'i phyir dang*/ klu sgrub yab sras dang*/ ye shes zhabs dang*/ de'i rjes 'brang phal cher dbu ma pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ gzhan yang*/ grub mtha' smra ba po dbu sems gnyis ka theg chen pa yin te/ thub bstan spyi dang khyad par theg chen gyi shing rta'i srol byed chen po gnyis su nges pa'i phyir/ rgyu mtshan ci'i phyir na/ rnam rig tsam gyi tshul dang ngo bo gnyis med kyi tshul gnyis su 'grel ba'i shing rta'i srol 'byed 'dzam gling rgyan drug gi gtso bo thogs med kyis rgyal tshab byams pa la brten nas dgongs pa nges 'grel gyi mdo dang ni 'phags pa klu sgrub zhabs kyis 'jam dbyangs la brten nas blau gros mi zad pa'i mdo bzhin du rang bzhin gsum gtan la phab pa'i sgo nas bka' tha ma nges don dang bden pa gnyis gtan la phab pa'i sgo nas bka' bar pa nges don du laigs par bkral sogs kyi phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni/ 'o na sher phyin gyi mdo'i dngos bstan stong nyid 'grel pa klu sgrub kyi rigs tshogs/ sbas don mngon rtog ston pa byams pa'i mngon rtogs rgyan| gtso bo'i don so gnyis su bsdu ba phyogs glang gi brgyad stong don bsdu/ sgo gsum rnam grangs bcu gcig tu bsdu ba dpa' bo'i 'bum ṭā+-ika ste shing rta'i srol 'byed bzhir grags pa ma yin nam zhe na/ de ltar sher sogs ni ma yin te| bstan pa spyi dang khyad par theg chen gyi de kho na nyid mchog tu gyur pa'i srol sngar ma phye ba gsal bar phye ba la shing rta'i srol 'byed du 'jog pa gang zhig

sgo gsum rnam grangs bcu gcig sogs lta zhog yum don dngos brgyad du phye ba'i kyang don de mi 'grub pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ mthun pa dang*/ mi mthun pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sde gnyis theg dman pa dang dbu sems theg chen pa yin pa de'i phyir sogs te/ gzhi'i gtso bo bdag gnyis kyis stong pa'i 'gyur med yongs grub bam bde gshegs snying po dang lam gyi gtso bo bsam pa sems bskyed dang sbyor ba phyin drug dang sa bcu'i spangs rtogs dang*/ 'bras bu sku gsum gyi rnam gzhag la sogs pa/ klu sgrub kyi mdo btus dang rin cen phreng ba dang bstod tshogs gtam tshogs nas 'byung ba dang*/ thogs med kyi gzhung las 'byung ba rnams la mi mthun pa cher med pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ phal cher zhes pa ci zhe na/ mi mthun pa'ang yod de/ 'di la| phal pa dang*/ gtso bo gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gzhan dbang dang*/ yongs grub bden pa rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub par snga ma thogs med kyis byang sa'i de kho na nyid kyi le'ur rgya cher bsgrubs pa drang nges rnam 'byed na gsal lo/ /phyi ma klu sgrub zhabs kyis de yang spyir/ rang bzhin dag ni bcos min dang*/ /rkyen la bltos pa med pa yin/ /zhes sogs dang/ khyad par/ ji ltar skad cig mtha' yod pa/ /de bzhin thog ma dbus brtag go /zhes sogs rigs pa'i tshul du mas bkag go /de bzhin du klu sgrub 'di 'dzin rnam khyad par gsum ldan gyi rang rig ni don dam du lta zhog tha snyad tsam du'ang mi bzhed de/ rtsod zlog tu rgyas par bkag pa bzhin du/ rjes 'brang gi gtso bo zla grags dang zhi ba lhas kyang bkag pas so/ /rang rig de bzhin du mtshan sogs ni/ mthong ste/ de las| j-i ltar khab len gyis drangs pa'i/ /lcags ni myur du yongs su g.yo| |de la sems ni yod min yang*/ /sems dang bcas pa lta bur snang*| |de bzhin kun gzhi'i rnam shes ni/ /rdzun yang bden pa lta bur

ni| |'gro dang 'ong bas rnam g.yo zhing*/ /rtag tu srid pa gsum po len/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de sems tsam gyi 'dod pa bkod pa yin no zhe na yang*/ ma yin te/ 'dir kun gzhi rdzun par bshad pa'i phyir dang*/ gnyis stong gi shes pa bden grub rgya cher bkag gi 'di dang mtshan nyid gsum la dgag pa ma mdzad pa'i phyir ro/ /dpal ldan zla bas/ stong nyid la kun gzhi'i sgra sbyor bar mdzad ces pa tsam gsungs kyang*/ gzhan dbang bden grub dang rang rig nan gyis bkag pa lta bu'i dgag pa rtsa 'grel gang du'ang ma mdzad do/ /'on kyang ngo bo ma sgrib lung ma bstan dang tshogs drug las rdzas gzhan rdzas yod ni tha snyad du'ang mi bzhed par gsal lo/ /tshul sogs yod de/ klu sgrub kyi rjes 'brang legs ldan dang ye shes snying po mi bzhed la/ zhi 'tsho dang ye shes zhabs rjes 'brang dang bcas pa bzhed pa'i phyir dang*/ thogs med kyi rjes 'brang phyogs glang yab sras rang rig bzhed kyang kun gzhi mi bzhed par grags la/ shān+ti pa sogs gnyis ka bzhed pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ theg chen sogs ni/ gzhi sogs rnams ston pa'i mdo tshig drang don nyid du bzhed pas na bka' 'khor lo bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i chos 'khor drang don dgongs pa can dang*/ tha ma legs par rnam par phye ba'i chos 'khor nges don mtshan nyid par bzhed pa ni thogs med lugs dang*/ mdo tshig de rnams nges sogs na/ bka' 'khor lo bar pa nges don dang tha ma drang don du bzhed pa ni klu sgrub lugs te de gnyis kyi khyad par gtso bo de yin no| |de yang gzhi la ngo bo med sogs gsungs pa'i dgongs gzhi ni/ rang dang rang gi bdag nyid du/ /med phyir rang gi ngo bo la/ /mi gnas phyir dang 'dzin bzhin du/ /med phyir ngo bo nyid med 'dod/ /snga ma phyi ma'i rten yin pas/ /ngo bo nyid ni med pa yis/ /ma skyes ma 'gags bzod nas zhi/ /rang bzhin mya ngan 'das pa grub/

/ces mdo sde rgyan du gsungs te/ sher phyin gyi mdo las/ chos thams cad ngo bo nyid med par gsungs pa la dgongs gzhi rnam pa bzhi ste/ dus gsum las ma 'ongs pa ma skyes pas rang med/ 'das pa 'gags pas rang gi bdag nyid du gnas pa med/ da lta ba skad cig ma yin par rang gi ngo bo la dus gnyis par mi gnas pa'i phyir dang*/ chos thams cad byis pa gtsang bde rtag bdag tu ji ltar 'dzin pa bzhin du med pa'i phyir ngo bo nyid med la/ de dang ma skyes ma 'gags sogs snga ma snga ma phyi ma phyi ma'i rten yin pas/ ngo bo nyid med pas na ma skyes/ ma skyes pas na ma 'gags sogs so/ /lam skye med kyi chos la bzod par gsungs pa la yang dgongs gzhi brgyad de/ 'khor ba la thog ma'i dang sngar skyes la de nyid bskyar ma'i dang*/ skye 'gyur la sngar skyes dang mi 'dra ba'i rnam pa gzhan nyid kyi dang kun brtags bden par med pas rang gi mtshan nyid kyi dang*/ gzhan dbang rkyen la ltos pas rang nyid kyi dang*/ yongs grub 'dus ma byas pas gzhan 'gyur gyi dang*/ spangs pa mi zlog pas de la slar kun nas nyon mongs kyi dang*/ sangs rgyas spangs rtogs mthar thug pas de la slar khyad par du 'gro ba'i skye ba rnams med par skye med kyi chos la bzod pa'o/ /'bras bu mthar thug theg pa gcig tu gsungs pa la yang dgongs gzhi bdun te shes bya'i chos bdag med du mtshungs pa dang*/ sgrub byed kyi lam bdag med kyi rnam ldan du mtshungs pa dang*/ bsgrubs pa'i rnam grol bral 'bras su mtshungs pa'i phyir dang*/ rigs nges ma nges tha dad kyi sgo nas ma nges pa'i nyan thos slob pa rnams theg chen du 'jug pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyis sems can la bder gshegs snying po gzigs pas bdag nyid kyi dgongs pa rnyed la/ nyan thos sngaun theg chen la bslabs pa la bdag nyid sangs rgyas so snyam pa'i bsam pa ste gang zag gnyis la bsam pa gcig thob pa'i phyir dang*/

de bzhin gshegs pas sprul nas nyan thos kyi byang chub thob tshul ston pa dang*/ theg chen de theg pa'i mthar thug yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'di la ni dgos pa yang yod de/ nyan thos rigs ma nges pa theg chen du drang ba dang*/ /byang sems rigs ma nges pa theg chen nyid du gzung ba'i phyir ro/ de dag gi gzhung ni thog ma dang ni de nyid gzhan nyid dang*/ /rang gi mtshan nyid rang dang gzhan du 'gyur/ /kun nas nyon mongs pa dang khyad par las/ /skye ba med pa'i chos la bzod par bshad| |chos dang bdag med grol ba rnams/ /mtshungs phyir rigs ni tha dad phyir| |bsam gnyis thob phyir sprul ba'i phyir/ /mthar thug phyir na theg gcig nyid| kha cig dag ni drang phyir dang*/ /gzhan dag kun tu gzung ba'i phyir/ / rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis ni/ /ma nges rnams la theg gcig bshad// ces so/ /gnyis pa la/ sku mched gnyis kyi chos bdag 'gog tshul rjes 'brang rnam bden rdzun gyi khyad par/ mtshan nyid gsum dang bden gnyis 'jog tshul lo| |dang po la/ mdor bstan pa/ so sor bshad pa/ mdo dang sbyar ba/ zhar byung bshad pa'o/ / dang po ni chos thams cad rnam par rig pa tsam du smra ba'i gtsug rgyan nam gtso bo ni sku mched gnyis yin te/ rgya gar du chos mngon pa la gnod pa lan gsum byung bas nub pa na bram ze mo gsal ba'i tshul khrims kyis bu bskyed nas bstan pa 'dzin du 'jug par 'dod de/ rgyal rigs gcig dang 'dus pas gcen thogs med dang*/ bram ze gcig dang 'dus pas gcung dbyig gnyen 'khrungs te/ ljags la gi haṃ gi yi ge a 'dri ba la sogs pa blau rno ba'i cho ga mang du byas te bskyangs nas/ gcen gyis lo bcu gnyis su rgya tshab dam pa bsgrubs pas grub ste dga' ldan du byon nas chos rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin la brten te/ chos mngon pa stong phrag brgya pa la sogs pa theg chen gyi shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod mang du gsan nas/

de'i don rgya cher ston pa sa sde lnga dang*/ bsdus te ston pa theg pa thun mong ba'i sdom pa mngon pa kun las btus dang*/ theg chen thun mong min pa'i sdom theg bsdus la sogs pa mdzad de/ 'dzam bu'i gling du byams pa'i chos lnga dang bcas pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad do/ /gcung gis chos mngon pa dar bar lung bstan pa'i yul ljongs kha cher byon nas/ kha che 'dus pa bzang po la theg chung gi mngon pa sde bdun dang bye brag bshad mdzod la sogs pa legs par bslabs te/ kha che bye brag tu smra ba'i lugs gtso bor ston cing rigs pa dang 'gal ba rnams rtsa bar yang cung zad bkag cing*/ 'grel pas rgyas par bkag nas mdo sde pa'i lugs 'jog pa'i bstan bcos mdzod rtsa 'grel mdzad de/ theg chen la thugs sdang bar gnas pa/ gcen gyis 'dul thabs mdzad pas/ phyis theg chen la shin tu mos shing mkhas par gyur te| pra ka ra ṇa sde brgyad la sogs pa rang gi dang*/ gzhan 'grel gyi bstan bcos rgya cher brtsams shing*/ 'bum sde dgu bcu go dgu thugs la mnga' ba brgyad stong pa la zhal 'don rgyun du mdzad pa sogs kyi rnam thar rgyas pa gzhan du gsal lo/ /sku mched gnyis kyi gzhung de dag tu theg chen gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag kyang rgyas par 'byung mod kyis bstan bcos kyi dgos pa'i gtso bo ni slob ma'i rgyud 'chos pa yin zhing*/ sems rgyud kyi nyes pa'i gtso bo yang bdag tu 'dzin pa yin pas/ bdag 'dzin gyi gnyen po ston pa ni sangs rgyas pa'i gzhung gi khyad chos yin no/ /de yang 'dzin stangs kyi zhen yul bkag nas 'gog pa las/ gang zag gi bdag ni nyan thos sde gnyis kyis legs par bkag zin nas rtsal du mi 'don zhar byung gi tshul du ston la/ chos kyi bdag ni rtog pa dang rtog med la snang ba gnyis mched gnyis kyis rtsal du bton nas 'gog ste/ 'dir rtog pa la bum pa dang bum pa'i ming gcig tu snang ba ni ngo bo nyid du btags pa'i kun brtags dang*/

bum pa'i mi rtag pa dang de'i ming bden pa'i gcig tu snang ba ni khyad par du btags pa'i kun brtags dang rtog med la sngon po dang der 'dzin gyi gzung cha 'dzin cha gnyis rgyangs chad rdzas gzhan bden par snang ba'i kun brtags te/ rim pa bzhin rtog sogs brtson pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa la/ gcen gyis rtog pa la dang gcung gis rtog med la snang ba'i chos bdag 'gog tshul lo/ /dang po la/ dngos dang*/ des grub pa'i don no/ /dang po ni/ chos kyi bdag med bde blag tu grub par 'gyur te/ rtog pa la sogs 'di snang ba bzhin du bden par ma grub pa'i phyir ro/ /'di ltar/ ming gi snga rol blau med phyir/ /mang ba'i phyir dang ma nges phyir/ /de yi bdag nyid bdag mang dang*/ /bdag 'dres 'gal bas 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i don/ lto ldir ba lta bu'i don de bum pa zhes pa lta bu'i ming de'i bdag nyid du gcig pa 'gal te/ gcig na brda med pa'i byis pas ming mi shes pa'i snga rol tu lto ldir ba mthong ba'i tshe bum pa'o snyam pa'i ming can gyi blau skye dgos pa las de 'dra skye ba med pa'i phyir/ yang ming don gcig pa 'gal ba yin te/ gcig na brgya byin lta bu'i gcig pu de bdag nyid mang por 'gyur dgos pa'i phyir te/ don brgya byin gcig nyid la mig stong dang skabs gsum dbang po sogs mang po'i ming dang ldan pas so/ /yang ming don gcig pa 'gal ba yin te/ gcig na don yul dang yul can gnyis gcig tu 'dres par 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ ming mngon sum zhes pa gcig pu 'di don rtog bral gyi blo gcig nyid la 'jug par ma nges pa'i sgo nas dbu ma pa dag bum pa sogs kyi yul la mngon sum du grags pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang yul dang dus kyi dbang gis ming gcig nyid don du ma la 'jug pa mang ngo*/ /gzhan yang*/ ming dang don dag tha dad min na/ me sgra brjod pa dag gis kha ni cis mi sreg

/ces sogs mdo rgyud gzhan du rgyas par 'byung ste| rtog pa la snga phyi gcig dang mang po gcig dang gcig du mar snang ba sogs snang ba ltar grub par bzung bas rang gzhan gyi lta ba ngan pa rnams byung la/ ma grub kyang log pa tha dad las log pa dang du mas 'bras bu gcig dang gcig gis 'bras bu du ma byed pa'i gzhan sel la mkhas pas yang dag pa'i lta ba skye bar 'gyur te rigs pa'i gzhung las rtogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ rtog med la gzung 'dzin rdzas gzhan du snang ba'ang rtog pa la snang ba'i ngo bo nyid dang khyad par du brtags pa'i kun brtags kyi bdag 'di'i rtsa ba can yin zhing*/ mdo sde so so las gsungs pa'i lam gyi spang bya'i rtog pa mngon rtogs rgyan las 'byung ba gzung rtog gnyis dang 'dzin rtog gnyis te bzhi dang*/ de las phye ba'i dgu bzhi so drug pa phrag gsum ste shes sgrib gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog brgya rtsa brgyad du grags pa dang chos dang chos nyid rnam 'byed las med pa'i chos dang gang zag rdzas yod du 'dzin pa gnyis/ skye 'jig gi 'gyur ba dang*/ chos dang chos nyid tha dad don dam du 'dzin pa gnyis/ chos dang gang zag kun brtags tsam yang med par 'dzin pa'i skur 'debs te/ med la 'dzin pa rnam pa lnga zhes pa'i rnam rtog lnga/ dbus mtha' las/ yi ge don dang yid byed dang*/ /mi 'phro ba dang mtshan nyid gnyis/ /ma dag dag dang glo bur dang*/ /mi dngangs pa dang khengs pa med/ /ces pa yi ge dang don dang yid la byed pa dang*/ mi 'phro ba dang rang gi mtshan nyid dang spyi'i mtshan nyid dang/ ma dag dag pa dang*/ glo bur ba dang*/ mi dngangs pa dang ma khengs pa rnams la phyin ci log gi rtog pa ste rnam rtog bcu dang*/ khyad par mdo sde rgyan las rgyal ba'i sras rnams kyis ni yod dang med pa dang*/ /sgro 'dogs skur ba'i rtog dang gcig dang du ma dang*/ /rang dang khyad par rtog dang ming don ji bzhin du/

/ mngon par zhen pa'i rtog pa yang dag spang bar bya/ /zhes pa byang sems kyi rnam rtog bcu rnams 'dir bshad pa'i ngo bo nyid dang khyad par du brtags pa'i kun brtags bden par 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog nyid la brten pa'i phyir/ 'di sogs gsungs so/ /de yang mdo las/ 'tshol ba bzhi dang yongs shes bzhi dang de'i phan yon rnams rgyas par gsungs pa'i don/ mdo sde rgyan las/ ming dang dngos dag phan tshun du/ /glo bur ba ni nyid du btsal/ /'dogs pa rnam pa gnyis po 'dir| |de tsam nyid du 'tshal ba'o/ /thamasacad dmigs su med pa'i phyir| |yang dag ye shes rnam pa bzhi/ /sa rnams kun la brtan pa yi/ /don kun sgrub par byed pa yin/ /zhes ming dang don dang ngo bo dang khyad par 'tshol ba bzhi las/ ming don 'brel med brda'i dbang gis phan tshun glo bur du 'byung ba dang*| des na ngo khyad gnyis kyang ming rkyang tsam du btsal zhing bsgoms pas/ chos bdag thams cad dmigs su med pa'i de bzhi yongs su shes pa'i yongs shes kyi ye shes bzhi ni sa thams cad la spangs rtogs don thams cad sgrub par byed ces sogs kyi rgya cher brten pa'i gcen gyi slob ma'i rgyud 'chos tshul lo/ /gnyis pa la/ dngos dang*/ thun mong gi rigs pa gzhan yang bshad pa'o| |dang po ni/ nyi shu pa las/ drug gis cig car sbyar ba na/ /phra rab rdul cha drug tu 'gyur/ /drug po dag kyang go gcig na/ /gong bu'ang rdul phran tsam du 'gyur| |zhes gsungs pa'i don/ phyi don dpyad na mi 'grub ste dbus rdul gcig la phyogs bzhi steng 'og dang drug gi rdul phran cig car du sbyar ba'i tshe dbus rdul de shar sogs so so'i phyogs la lta na/ dbus rdul cha bcas su 'gyur zhing so sor mi lta'i shar sogs na rags pa rtsom par mi 'gyur ba des na'o| |'o na mdo las/ mig dang gzugs/ rna ba dang sgra sogs skye mched gnyis tshan dang*/ khyad par gzugs sogs lnga gsungs pa mi 'thad do zhe na/

rang gi sa bon gang las su/ /rnam rig rnam pa gang byung ba/ /de dang de yi skye mched ni/ /rnam pa gnyis su thub pas gsungs/ /gzugs sogs skyed byed yod par ni/ /des 'dul ba yi skye bo la/ /dgongs pa'i dbang gis gsungs pa ste/ /rdzus te 'byung ba'i sems can bzhin/ /zhes rmi lam bzhin du bag chags las gnyis snang 'byung ba la dgongs shing*/ gang zag yod par gsungs pa ltar don smra khyed lta bu drang ba'i don du gsungs zhes so/ /sems snang rkyang pa yin na yul dus nges pa mi 'thad do zhe na'ang*/ sems can dmyal ba'i srung ma bzhin du rang rang gi las kyi dbang gis 'thad do/ /dmyal srung bye smra yi dwags kyi 'gro bar dang*/ mdo sde pa 'byung bzhi nyid der snang zhes zer ba la/ dud 'gro mtho ris su 'byung ba ni mi dang rdzogs byed kyi las 'dra bas yin na/ dmyal ba dang yi dwags 'phen rdzogs kyi las gnyis ka mi 'dra bas mi 'thad pa dang*| las kyi nus pas 'byung bzhi sems can du snang na sems nyid ci'i phyir mi snang zhes dang*/ sems nyid yin kyang srog gcod pa la sogs pa'i bya ba byed pa'ang mi 'gal te/ drang srong khros pas so can gyi grong stong pa dang*/ 'dre'i yid dbang gis mi'i dran pa nyams par byed pa bzhin/ zhes sogs gsungs te rgyas par der blta'o/ /de ltar phyi don 'gog tshul rtsod sogs bshad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ rigs pa'i rnam grangs gzhan yang theg bsdus las*/ don ni don du grub gyur na/ /ye shes rtog pa med mi 'gyur/ /de med pas na sangs rgyas nyid/ /thob par 'thad pa ma yin no/ /mi rtag ye shes rgyu ba la/ /don kun snang ba med pa'i phyir/ /don med khong du chud par bya/ /de med pas na rnam rig med| |ces bden par yod na 'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi ngor yod dgos pa las/ de'i ngor med pa'i phyir dang*/ dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang*/

/lha rnams ji ltar rigs rigs su/ /dngos gcig yid ni tha dad phyir/ /don ma grub par 'dod pa yin/ /zhes chu klung du snang ba'i dngos po gcig nyid/ /las bzang ngan gyi dbang gis/ lha la bdud rtsi dang mi la chu dang yi dwags la rnag khrag dang*/ tsha dmyal la khro chu khol mar mthong ba sogs 'gro ba rigs drug gi snang ba 'phral gyi 'khrul rgyus ma bslad pa rnams kyang so sor 'gyur ba'i phyir dang*/ rnam 'grel las/ du ma'i bdag skyon phyir| |zhes skyes bu lhas byin gyi lus gcig nyid dgra dang gnyen gyi mig sngar yid 'ong dang yid mi 'ong gi snang ba 'gyur ba'i phyir dang*/ rmi lam dang sad pa'i gnas skabs dag don byed pa la khyad med de/ rmi lam na ni rmis pa bzhin| |don byed mtshungs pas rang bzhin med/ /ces sems 'grel las gsungs pa ltar sangs sogs dang*/ rnam 'grel las/ don dang 'dra bar dmigs pa ste/ /gsal bar snang ba myong ba yin/ /zhes dang*/ nges par blo dang lhan cig tu/ /cig car du ni myong 'gyur ba'i/ /yul ni de las gzhan nyid du| |rnam gang gis ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes sogs dang*/ rnam nges las/ lhan cig dmigs pa nges pa'i phyir/ /sngo dang de blo gzhan ma yin/ /zhes dang*/ rig gter las/ gsal dang lhan cig dmigs pas grub/ /ces sogs ltar gsal bar myong ba'i phyir dang*/ lhan cig dmigs pa nges pa'i phyir/ /zhes pa'i rtags kyis 'grub ste/ da lta 'khrul ngor bsnyon du med pa'i bzung cha 'di chos can/ rang 'dzin shes pa las rdzas gzhan pa'i phyi rol don du med de/ rang 'dzin shes pa dang lhan cig dmigs pa nges pa'i phyir te/ gcig dmigs byed kyi tshad mas cig shos kyang phan tshun nges par dmigs pa'i phyir/ rgyas par gzhan du bshad zin to| |gzhan yang*/ de 'dra las yin 'khrul bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang*/ de 'dra ba dang de las byung/ /gal te myong ba'i mtshan nyid yin/ /don mtshungs can gyi rnam par shes/

/mtshungs pa de ma thag myong 'gyur/ /zhes sogs ltar/ don las skyes pa sogs mi srid de/ don sogs na'o/ /rgyu mtshan rgyas par de rnams kyi phyir na don sogs yin cing snang ba ltar grub pa chos bdag yin pa de'i phyir sogs bzhed do/ /gsum pa ni/ rigs pa de lta bus grub pa'i rnam rig gi tshul 'di ni/ bstan bcos mkhan po dag gis rang dga'i blos sbyar ba ma yin te/ bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi lang kar gshegs pa dang dgongs pa nges par 'grel ba dang*/ mdo sde sa bcu pa la sogs pa zab mo stong pa nyid dang*/ yangs pa spyod phyogs rgya chen po ston pa'i theg chen gyi mdo sde mang po las gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir/ lang gshegs las/ phyi rol snang ba yongs med de/ /sems ni sna tshogs can du snang*| |zhes dang gtso bo rdul dang rnam rig dang*/ /gang zag rgyun dang phung po dang*| |dbang phyug rkyen dang byed po rnams/ /sems tsam du ni ngas brtags te| |don yod ma yin sems nyid de/ /phyi rol don mthong log pa yin/ / rigs pas rnam par brtags na ni/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa 'gag par 'gyur// zhes dgongs pa nges 'grel las mtshan nyid gsum gyi rnam gzhag shin tu gsal ba dang*/ bka' bar pa las ngo bo nyid maid par gsungs pa thams cad/ kun brtags mtshan nyid dang*/ gzhan dbang skye ba dang*/ yongs grub don dam pa ngo bo nyid med pa ste/ ngo bo nyid med par gsum la dgongs nas gsungs pa'i drang don dang*/ de dag bden rdzun phyi nas ston pa'i bka' tha ma nges don du rgyas par gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ sa bcu pa las/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag khams gsum po 'di ni sems tsam mo/ /zhes dang sa drug pa mngon du gyur pa'i rtogs pa la gnas pas srid gsum rnam shes tsam du de kho na nyid mthong bar gsungs pa dang*| 'od srungs kyis zhus pa las/ gang dag ral gri mda' chen mtshon 'byin pa'i| |gnod pa byed pa yod pa ma yin te/

/sems kyi dbang gis ngan song de dag na/ /lus la 'bab mthong de na mtshon cha med/ /ces sogs dang rgyan stug po bkod pa las/ zla ba skar ma'i tshogs dang ni/ /lhan cig mkha' la gnas pa ltar| |de bzhin kun gzhi rnam shes kyang*/ /rnam shes bdun dang lhan cig gnas| |zhes sogs dang*/ de bzhin du/ lang gshegs dang dgongs pa nges 'grel las kyang*/ kun gzhi rnam shes rgya cher gsungs te/ mdor na/ sems tsam gyi gzhi ston pa lang gshegs dang rgyan stug po bkod pa/ lam ston pa nges 'grel dang sa bcu pa/ 'bras bu ston pa sangs rgyas kyi sa'i mdo ste/ sems tsam mdo lngar grags pa dang*/ gzhan yang*/ snying po mdo bcu la sogs pa 'khor lo tha mar gtogs pa phal cher las sems tsam gyi tshul gsungs shing*/ byams mgon gyis kyang*/ rgyan dang 'byed gnyis su rgyas par gsungs pas/ gzhung lugs 'di ni gnas skabs su mos par bya zhing mkhas par bya ba'i gnas yin no/ /bzhi pa ni/ gang dag sems tsam pa ni dngos por smra ba yin pas/ de ni rang sde'i mu stegs par gsungs pas shin tu sdang bar bya ba yin zhing don dam par ni gzugs bzhin du sems kyang ma grub la*/ tha snyad du ni sems bzhin du phyi rol gyi don yang grub pas/ rtsom byed rdul phran yod cing*/ de yang cha med du mas spangs pa na bden grub du 'gyur bas/ gzhi grub la cha bcas kyi khyab pa'i phyir na/ rdul phran cha bcas su tshad mas grub pa ni dpal ldan zla grags bzhed do zhes ding sang zer ba ni mi 'thad de/ 'dod pa de la ni/ phyogs kyi cha dang bcas bzhin du rdul phran yin na ri sogs 'bab pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa la/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad/ 'phros don no/ /dang po ni/ spyir rnam par rig pa'i tshul ni mdo dang sngags las rgya cher gsungs shing*/ byams pa dang thogs med mched gnyis kyis rgyas par bkral ba yang lugs 'di smra ba la rnam bden rdzun gyi dbye ba ma mdzad par dngos bstan rnam rdzun nyid du gsal bar gsungs mod kyi/
