/gsum pa la/ gnas skabs smin byed kyi dang*/ mthar thug grol byed kyi lam mo/ /dang po ni/ ji skad bshad pa'i lam kun kyang nyan rang la chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa mi dgos par bzhed par rang rgyud pa man chad 'dod pa'i bden bzhi mi rtag sogs bcu drug lta bu stong sogs na ni zag med thar lam dngos su mi 'gyur gyis zag bcas las su 'gyur te/ gzhi sogs gnas tshul sogs phyir ro/ /'o na 'dul ba lung la sogs pa'i bka' dang*/ bstan bcos phal cher du de nyid rgyas par gsungs pa ci zhe na/ de lta mod kyi zab mo stong nyid rdzogs par rtogs pa'i snod rung gi gang zag ni shin tu dkon sogs ltar dngos kyi gdul bya lam dngos la khad kyis drang ba'i phyir du gsungs pa'o// des na de ltar ston pa'i rgyal ba dang gdul bya'i sems can gnyis kar la shin tu gus par bya yi/ rang gi lta ba la lhag par chags pa dang gzhan gyi lta ba dang gang zag la 'khrug cing sdang bar mi bya ste/ zab sogs phyir ro/ /de yang lam de dag gis rgyud legs par smin cing rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs zhugs pas| de la sgrib pa'i las sgrib byang zhes nyon mongs pa'i sa bon yang rags pa chod tshar bas/ nam zhig na blo kha phyogs pa tsam gyis stong nyid rdzogs par rtogs par 'gyur bas na/ gang zag dngos smra dang nyan rang phal pa/ lam bden bzhi mi rtag sogs rtogs pa la zhal bzhu dang ngan smras sna tshogs byed cing*| zla ba grags pa'i lam srol gyis sems khengs par byas na stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i gegs kyi las sgrib gsar du gso gnyen che'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ de lta yin pa 'on kyang srid rtsa gcod pa'i thar lam gyi gtso bo ni mtha' bral dbu ma rtogs pa'i shes rab nyid yin te/ nges legs thar pa'i lam du grags pa kun thar lam dngos su 'gro ba ni dbu ma'i lam 'dir bltos shing rag las pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang*/

gang dag bde gshegs nyan thos 'gyur bar bya snyam dang*/ /rang sangs rgyas dang de bzhin chos rgyal 'gyur 'dod pa/ /bzod pa 'di la ma brten 'thob par mi nus te/ /zhes sogs mang po dang*/ stong nyid lta bas grol 'gyur gyi/ /sgom pa lhag ma de don yin| |zhes pa dang*/ gang phyir lung las lam 'di ni/ /med par byang chub med ces gsungs/ /zhes dang*/ 'phags pa nyid kyis/ gang gis stong nyid mi shes pa| |de la thar pa ga la yod/ /'gro drug srid pa'i btson ra ru/ /rmongs pa de dag 'khor bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang ji srid phung por 'dzin yod pa/ /sogs dang*| rgyu rkyen las skyes dngos po rnams/ /yang dag nyid du rtog pa gang*/ /de ni ston pas ma rig gsungs/ /de las yan lag bcu gnyis 'byung*/ /zhes sogs gsungs te/

'og tu bden 'dzin 'khor ba'i rtsa bar bzhed pa'i rgyu mtshan du yang 'di dag drang bar bya'o/ /rang rgyud pa dang sems tsam pas ni/ bzod pa dang stong nyid sogs rnams gang zag gi bdag med dang*/ phung por 'dzin pa dang rgyu rkyen yang dag tu rtog pa rnams gang zag gi bdag 'dzin nyid la dgongs zhes 'chad mod kyi mngon sum la bsnyon pa lta bu'o/ /'o na stong nyid rtogs pa'i rtogs tshul la khyad par med pas/ nyan rang theg chen gsum ka re re zhing tshogs sbyor mthong sgom mi slob lam ste lnga lnga dang*/ theg dman la/ dkar po rnam par mthong ba'i sa dang*/ rigs kyi sa dang*/ brgyad pa dang*/ rgyun du zhugs pa dang*/ mthong ba'i dang*/ bsrabs pa'i dang*/ 'dod chags dang bral ba'i dang*/ /byas pa rtogs pa'i sa ste dman pa sa brgyad dang*| theg chen la rab dga' sogs bcu dang*/ bcu gcig kun tu 'od la sogs pa dang*/ de dag re re la yang yon tan gyi dbye ba mang po sogs gang gis 'jog ce na/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i mnyam gzhag sogs kyang so so'i sbyor ba dang*/ mjug gi grogs su gyur pa'i thabs mchog dman sogs kyi dbye sogs 'gyur ba yin te/ rgyas par gzhan du bshad pas 'dir mi spro'o/ /lam dbu ma'i gnad bsdus te bstan pa'o// // gsum pa ni/ 'bras sogs ni bzhed de/ slob dpon gyis mdo btus dang rin cen phreng ba dang sku gsum gyi bstod pa sogs dang*/ zla ba'i skyabs gsum bdun cu pa dang 'jug pa'i smad la sogs pa na gsal ba ltar ro/ phal cher zhes pa ni/ gzugs sku dang phrin las gdul bya'i gzhan ngor 'jog pa sogs dang*/ sems tsam man chod 'dod pa ltar nyan rang gi lhag med du rig pa rgyun chad mi bzhed par| sems 'grel du/ theg pa gnyis po dag kyang ni/ /theg pa chen pos 'byung bas na/ /srid pa'i lam gyis dub rnams la/ /ngal gso'i don te de nyid min| |nyan thos de dag ji srid du/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis ma bskul ba/

/de srid ye shes lus gcig gis/ /ting 'dzin myos pas brgyal te gnas/ /bskul na sna tshogs gzugs kyis ni/ /sems can don la dga' byed cing*/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs bsags te/ /sangs rgyas byang chub thob par 'gyur/ / zhes dang*/ de dag gzhan don du skye ba len pa'i rgyu yang*/ /gnyis kyi bag chags yod pas na/ /bag chags sa bon du brjod de/ /sa bon srid mthar rdzogs pa yi/ /srid pa'i myu gu skyes par byed/ /ces dang*/ skyabs gsum bdun cu pa dang 'jug pa las kyang de ltar gsungs pa sogs so/ /'bras bu dbu ma'o// // gsum pa ni/ 'o na lugs 'di'i grub mtha' thun mong min pa'i gtso bo rnams gang zhe na| mkhas pa dag gis khyad chos chen po brgyad du bzhag pa yang phal cher yin mod kyi 'dir ni/ gtso che ba lnga ste/ rig ngor lta zhog dbu ma rang lugs kyi dang 'jig rten lugs gnyis ka'i tha snyad tsam du yang rang rgyud pa man chad kyi rtog ges brtags pa'i tshad ma dang tshad min gyi rnam gzhag sogs kun spong te/ phyi nang rgyu 'bras kyi chos kun yul rang ngos nas tha snyad tsam du yang ma grub pa'i blos thogs yod nyid du bzhed pa'i phyir te sgrub byed mang du brjod zin te/ gtso bo ni rmi lam dang sad dus kyi rta glang bden rdzun mtshungs par bzhed pa nyid do// 'dus byas yin na rang grub dus kyi skad cig gnyis par mi sdod cing skad cig la bya byed med pa dang rig pas dpyad mi bzod par ma zad rig ngor grub pa tsam yang med pas slu chos rdzun pas khyab pa'i phyir/ 'dus byas dang tshad grub kyi gzhi mthun med par bzhed de/ legs par dpyad na myang 'das dang de las lhag pa'i chos kyang grub pa med mod rig shes kyis cung zad dpyad ngor bslu med ni/ mya ngan 'das pa bden gcig pur// gang tshe sangs rgyas rnams gsung pa| |zhes pa ltar/ myang 'das kho na yin par bzhed pa'i phyir/

bden 'dzin de dang des bskyed pa'i chags sogs nyon mongs 'khor bcas thams cad nyon sgrib kho na yin gyi/ 'khor gsum rnam par rtog pa gang*/ /de ni shes bya'i sgrib par 'dod/ /ces dang*/ shes sgrib gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog brgya rtsa zhes sogs bden 'dzin dang shes sgrib kyi gzhi mthun gtan mi bzhed de/ ji srid phung por 'dzin yod pa/ /zhes sogs sngar drangs pa ltar bden sogs phyir/ 'dis ni nyan rang la chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa med du mi rung ba yang grub bo| |theg pa gsum gyi mthong lam la skad cig bcu drug dang bco lnga dang bcu gnyis dang bzhi la sogs pa du ma med par bzhed de/ de nyid yul can blau gros 'di yang tha dad 'gyur ba ma yin pa/ zhes theg sogs phyir dang gal te chos shes mjug thogs su/ /'di la bye brag yod na ni/ /dngos po shin tu phra ba la'ang*/ /gang gis skye bar rnam brtags pa/ /rnam par mi mkhas de yis ni// rkyen las byung ba'i don ma mthong*/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi gzugs sku dang phrin las bsam yas brjod kyis mi lang ba rnams/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang nam mkha' lding gi mchod sdong bsgrubs pa la sogs pa bzhin du rtog pa med par ma zad/ sems bskyed pa tsam yang mi dgos par sngon gyi smon lam dang gdul bya'i las bzang po'i dbang gis gdul bya de dang de'i gzhan snang gi rnam rol kho na yin par bzhed de/ sangs rgyas rang ngor/ de tshe rnam pa gzhan med pas/ /dmigs pa med par rab tu zhi/ /zhes dang/ ma rig rmongs pa'i gnyid sad na/ /'khor ba 'di dag mi dmigs so/ /zhes shes pa dang shes bya'i snang ba mtha' dag nub pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar lnga po 'di rnams ni lugs 'di'i thun mong min pa'i khyad chos kyi gtso bo yin te/ gong du rgyas par bshad pa rnams kyi mjug bsdus pa'o/ / gsum pa sgrub byed lung khungs bstan pa la/

lung khungs dngos dang cha mthun gyi lung dang*/ de la rtsod pa spang ba dang*/ der bstan rnams 'phags lam dngos min pa dang*/ yan lag khyad par can yin pas bus par gdams pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rnam gzhag thun mong min pa de dag gi lung gi sgrub byed rgyas par ni dbu ma chen po'i gzhung 'phags pa'i rigs tshogs bstod tshogs sems 'grel rnams dang*/ 'phags pa lha'i bzhi brgya pa dang*/ dpal bo'i don dam sems bsgoms sogs dang*/ dpal ldan zla ba'i gzhan 'grel gsum dang 'jug pa rtsa 'grel/ spyod 'jug sher le rnams la zhib par ltos shig dang ngo 'phrod par 'gyur ro/ /de dag gi lung rgyas pa yang 'dir yi ge la brtsegs nas ma bris pas/ 'di la lde mig byas nas legs par bltas na blo gros 'phel zhing nges pa ster ba dang*/ ma mtha' yang gzhung mi nub pa'i rkyen du 'gyur bas/ phyogs tsam re mthong ma thag tu gzhung lugs mi nyan zhing mi lta bar rang bzo mgo phur la brtson par mi bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ mkhas mchog legs ldan 'byed kyi shes rab sgron me dang*| 'grel bshad chen po spyan ras gzigs kyi brtul zhugs dang rtog ge 'bar ba rtsa 'grel dang*/ de rgya gar lho phyogs su byon pa'i rang rgyud pa yin pas| rgya gar shar phyogs su byon pa'i ye shes snying po dang zhi ba 'tsho dang ka ma la shī la gsum ni rang rgyud shar pa gsum zhes bya sa de'i gzhung rnams dang*/ rgyal ba byams pas mdzad pa'i chos lnga las mdo sde rgyan dang 'byed gnyis ni dngos bstan dang bstan bya'i gtso bo sems tsam kho nar gnas pa la/ mkhas pa g.yag gis lnga ka dbu mar bzhed pa dang de'i log bsnon du/ mkhas pa gzhon blos/ gzhan gyis chos rnams kyang yod la/ zhes sogs re re tsam ni sems tsam pas kyang 'chad shes la/ gzhan phal cher sems tsam dang mthun pas mngon rtogs rgyan dang rgyud bla yang sems tsam du bzhed mod kyi/ de gnyis thogs med dang grol sde la sogs pa'i mkhas pa chen po dag gis dbu mar bkral zhing*/

gzhan gsum dbyig gnyen gyis sems tsam du bkral ba la sus kyang bcos pa med pas/ lo chen thams cad mkhyen pas gnyis dbu ma dang gsum sems tsam du bkral ba'i dbu ma'i gzhung gnyis po kun sogs zad do/ / gsum pa ni/ mngon sogs bzhed de/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyi/ chos kyi dbyings la dbyer med phyir/ /zhes sogs kyi rtsaud lan rtsa 'grel du 'phags pa gsum kas chos dbyings bden stong la dmigs par bshad pa'i phyir dang*/ rgyud bla rtsa 'grel du/ stong nyid bden grub la dmigs pa thabs min la zhugs par bshad nas nyan rang thabs la zhugs par bshad pa dang*/ las nyon dngos po mtshan mar 'dzin pa las 'byung bar bshad pa'i phyir zhes sogs rgyas par bshad nas sgrub par byed mod kyi/ 'thad pa min te/ nyi khri snang bar/ ji ltar dmigs pa na 'phags pa'i chos rnams kyi rgyur 'gyur ba de ltar rigs yin par brjod pa des na 'dir ha cang thal ba cis te 'tshol bar byed/ ces pa dang*| 'grel chung du/ ji ltar nyan thos kyi theg pa la sogs pa rtogs pa'i rim gyis dmigs pa de bzhin du/ zhes sogs kyis/ 'phags pa mtha' dag chos dbyings bden stong la dmigs par khyad med du bstan pa yin na/ 'di'i phyogs snga smra ba po/ nyan rang chos dbyings bden stong la mi dmigs par 'dod pa'i dngos smra ba yin pa mi 'thad par 'gyur te/ dmigs pa de rgol ba gnyis ka mthun snang du grub pa'i dper/ ji ltar dang de bzhin zhes pa'i tshig gis grub 'dug pa'i phyir/ yang na ni rgol bas ma grub pa dper bkod pas 'phags seng brgal brtag la mi mkhas pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /'o na ci zhe na/ dngos smra ni/ skye mched drug pa'i khyad par zhes dang*/ dge ba'i bag chags zhes sogs rigs la dngos pos khyab par smra zhing*/ dge ba'i bag chags gtan med srid pa sogs kyi sgo nas rigs chad 'dod la/ 'dir chos dbyings rigs su smras pa blor ma shong nas/

rigs chad dang rigs tha dad la sogs pa'i dbye ba mi 'thad do zhes brtsad pa na/ rten la tha dad med kyang brten pa'i dbang gis tha dad du 'byed nus pa'ang 'grub mod kyi/ thog mar dngos med dang rigs kyi gzhi mthun rig pas 'grub ste/ spyir rigs su 'jog pa 'phags chos rtogs pa'i rgyu'i sgo nas khyod rang yang 'dod la/ 'dir de yang nyer len kho na'i dbang gis gzhag mi dgos kyi dmigs pa'i sgo nas kyang 'grub cing*/ chos dbyings la dmigs te bsgoms pas 'phags chos rtogs pa'i phyir/ zhes bkod pa na/ 'dus ma byas la dmigs pas 'phags chos ji ltar rtogs she na/ bdag med phra rags la dmigs pas 'phags chos rtogs par khyod rang yang 'dod pa ji lta ba de ltar ro/ /zhes pa'i don de yin pas/ gzhung de dag gis khyod kyi 'dod pa'i don de 'grub don med do/ /rgyud bla rtsa 'grel gyi don yang spyir stong nyid bden 'dzin skyon can yin na dngos po tsam bden 'dzin yang skyon can yin dgos mod kyi/ de ltar 'dod pas ni ma khyab ste/ sems tsam pa snga ma 'dod kyang phyi ma mi 'dod pas so/ /phyi ma la ni/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'bar ba/ /mig med pas ni mthong ba med| |ces pa'i 'grel par/ nyan rang stong nyid lta ba la mig dang mi ldan par bshad pas nyan rang la de rtogs pa med do/ /zhes te nyan rang gis ma rtogs par bshad pas/ nyan rang yin na ma rtogs pa'i khyab pa med de/ /so skye dang byang sems las dang po pas ma rtogs par bshad kyang de yin na ma rtogs mi dgos pa bzhin zhe na/ 'o na las nyon dngos po bden 'dzin las 'byung na de yin na des khyab mi dgos so zhes mtshungs la/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po rtogs tshul yang mngon sum gyi dbang du byas pas so skye sogs kyis der thal ba 'dod pa yang yin no/ /gzhan yang mdo dang bstan bcos las/ 'phags pa'i gang zag 'dus sogs phye bar bshad pa tsam gyis mi 'grub ste/

spyir so skye las phye ba'i don ma yin gyi theg pa gsum dang nyan thos kyi yang 'bras gnas bzhi sogs des phye zhes pa yin la de ni spangs sogs tshang ba'i phyir dang*/ so skye las phye ba yin na'ang gang zag gi bdag med la tshang ba'i phyir ro/ /chos nyid rtogs par bshad pa tsam gyis kyang mi 'grub ste/ gang sogs la'ang chos nyid tsam du 'dul ba lung las kyang mang du bshad cing mdzod kyi 'grel par yang 'byung bas mkhas sogs dang*/ khyad par bzung don rtog pa spong phyir sogs dang*| de ni mtshan mar dmigs sgo nas/ /sogs dang rgyud bla'i yang*/ 'dod ldan mu stegs nyan thos dang*/ /rang byung rnams kyi sgrib rnam bzhi/ /zhes sogs rang sogs phyir ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ rang rgyud kyi gzhung de dag tu dngos su bstan pa'i nyan rang gi lam de dag ni 'phags lam dngos min te/ de 'dra'i lam gyi srid pa'i rtsa ba bden 'dzin mi chod pa'i phyir te/ gdul bya ma nges pa'i rigs can drang ba'i phyir du gsungs pa'i drang don tsam yin pas so/ /lnga pa ni/ 'o na gzhung de dag tu bshad pa'i lam gyi rnam gzhag rgyas pa de rnams dor ba bya'am zhe na/ ma yin te/ lhag par gus pas 'jug par bya ba yin pa'i phyir te/ 'phags lam gyi khyad par can yin pa'i phyir dang de dag nyan rang byang sems sangs rgyas te 'phags sogs gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro| |gsum pa rtag chad gzhan spang ba la/ gang la 'khrul ba'i gzhi gshad pa/ de la 'khrul ba rtag chad du bstan pa/ rang lugs 'khrul med du bsgrub pa/ dgongs pa khyad par can gzhan yang rtogs pa'o/ /dang po ni/ ji skad bshad pa 'di dag ni bstan pa 'di'i chos 'khor dang po bden bzhi'i dang*/ bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i dang*/ tha ma legs par rnam par phye ba'i chos 'khor gsum las 'khor lo sogs nyid klu sgrub yab sras kyis dbu sogs bzhin du legs par gtan la phab pa yin te/ zhes 'phros btsal nas bkag tha mar gzhi lam 'bras bu'i nang nas lam dang 'bras bu la zag pa'i sgo drug gang rung dang ma 'brel ba'am dmigs pa dang*/

mtshungs ldan gang rung gis zag pa rgyas par mi 'gyur ba'i zag med kyi shes pa/ yod par ma zad| zag pa med pa'i shes pa sbrang ma'i rtsi dang 'dra/ /zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs pa gzhi sogs nyid la bde gshegs snying po'i zhes rgyas par gsungs pa de gsang sngags sogs gyur te/ 'dus pa sogs la lar sogs dang*/ gzhan kyai rdor bde mchog tu sogs dang*/ theg pa mtha' dag gi rtsai mo dus kyi 'khor lor rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong gzugs zhes yang dang yang du gsungs pa 'di/ mdo sngags de dag tu khyad chos 'chad pa'i tshe yang cha med dang kun 'gro dang zhi zhing rtag pa dang*/ chos dbyings dang don dam bden pa ste blo'i nus pa zhan pa rnams 'khrul ba'i gzhi mang po rnams gsungs so/ /gsung tshul rgyas par bshad zin pa dang 'dir skabs ma yin pas ma spros so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de ltar gsungs pa rnams kyi dngos bstan la 'khrul sogs byung ste/ bden stong don dam pa'i bden pa ni/ phung po rnam gcad stong pa nyid/ /chu shing bzhin du snying po med/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i/ /stong nyid de ltar 'gyur ma yin/ /zhes pa'i chad stong dang bem stong yin pas snying po med la/ bde gshegs snying po ma yin dgag rig pas bsdus pa 'di ni rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid yongs grub gcig pu yin pas cha med dang*/ sgrib bral gyis srid pa gsum la khyad med du khyab pas kun 'gro dang*/ rang bzhin rnam par dag pas zhi ba dang*/ rgyun rtag par ma zad skad cig gis 'jig rten 'brel lam 'dus byas su 'gro bas/ 'dus ma byas shing skad cig gis kyang rtag pa dang*/ chos nyid de bzhin nyid yin pa dang rig pas dpyad bzod gzhom med yin pas chos dbyings dang don dam bden pa yin no zhes sogs rgya cher mdo dang rgyud dang sems 'grel gyi lung du ma dang bcas te sgrub par byed do// de nyid la sangs rgyas kyi sa'i rnam smin gyi yon tan mtshan so gnyis dang*/

bral ba'i yon tan stobs bcu dang mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang ma 'dres pa bco brgyad de so gnyis la sogs pa thams cad gsal la yongs su rdzogs par gdod ma nas bzhugs mod kyi/ glo bur dri ma'i sbubs na zhugs pa de sbyong ba'i thabs su lam nyams su blang bar bya ba yin no zhes zer la/ mkhas pa kha cig ni/ de lta bu la rig pa du mas gnod pa'i phyir na/ mdo dang bstan bcos kyi dngos bstan de dag ni bden stong nyid la der dgongs pa yin te/ 'gro ba zhi ba'i chos nyid du zhes dang*/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i chos nyid ni/ /sems can thams cad la yod pa/ /zhes dang*/ sangs rgyas spyan gyis rang chos nyid gzigs nas/ /zhes dang*| dri med bzhag dang gsal med chos nyid kyang*/ /zhes sogs chos nyid kyi m-ing gis mang du gsungs shing*/ khyad par/ sprin dang rmi lam sgyu bzhin de dang der| |shes bya thams cad rnam kun stong pa zhes/ /gsungs nas rgyas 'dir slar yang sems can la/ /sangs rgyas snying po yod ces ci ste gsung*/ /zhes dwogs pa blangs nas/ lan du sems zhum sems can dman la brnyas pa dang*// yang dag mi 'dzin yang dag chos la skur/ /bdag chags lhag pa'i skyon lnga gang dag la/ /yod pa de dag de spang don du gsungs/ /zhes pas dgongs pa lnga'i ched du gsungs pa'i drang don yin pas kun rdzob tu yang bde gshegs snying po ma yin dgag de dag gtan med yin zhes smra bar byed do/ /lugs de gnyis ni snga ma rtag pa dang phyi ma chad pa'i g.yang du lhung ste/ snga ma la rtag pa dang dngos po'i gzhi mthun dang don dam bden pa dang dngos po'i gzhi mthun dang sangs rgyas dang sems can gyi gzhi mthun khas blangs pa'i skyon dang*/ gtso bor rig pas dpyad bzod kyi chos khas blangs pas dbu ma chung ngu yang min par thal ba dang stobs sogs de dag gis ma rig pa las rnam par rgyal ba la sogs pa'i bya ba mi byed par 'gyur la/ dpe ko dmar gyis gtums pa'i ral gri sogs kyang mi mthad de/

ral gri'i bya ba cung zad kyang mi byed pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes sogs kyis gnod pa'i phyir dang*/ phyi mas ni/ de mdo las zag pa med pa'i shes pa dang*/ bde gshegs snying po dang*/ rgyal ba'i myu gu dang*/ zhi ba'i yid la sogs pas gsungs shing*/ khyad par sngags las rtogs yes chos sku dang longs sku'i nyer len rang bzhin lhan skyes kyi ye shes dang*/ shin tu phra ba'i rlung dang*/ rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong gzugs su gsung pa thams cad la skur par btab pas/ mthar thug nges don gyi gsung rab thams cad drang don du khas blangs pa'i phyir ro/ /rgyas par dus kyi 'khor lo'i mtha' dpyod sogs su bshad zin to/ /gsum pa ni/ de lta bas na/ gzhan rnams dwogs pa chung la rtag pa dang zhi ba dang bden pa dang chos dbyings kyi ming gis bstan pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rim pa ltar skad cig sogs dang*/ dri sogs dang*/ rigs sogs dang*/ yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi 'dzin stangs kyi yul min sogs phyir ro/ /des na bde gshegs snying po ma yin dgag 'di ni dom dam pa'i gnas lugs rig shes kyis rnyed don min yang tha sogs te/ tha snyad tsam du rgyun gyi rang bzhin mi 'gyur ba'i phyir/ khyab ste/ me'i rang bzhin tsha ba zhes sogs grags kyang 'khrul sogs tsam du zad de/ rgyun gyi rang bzhin gzhan du 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ sangs rgyas sogs nus ldan gyi blo ma 'khrul ba la bsil bar snang zhes kun la grags pa'i phyir ro/ /des 'khor lo bar pa'i dngos bstan la/ chos can bslu med kyang tha ma dang sngags la bltos nas chos can sogs te/ rgyun bslu med tsam du grub pa'i phyir te/ sems med kyi gnas skabs kun dang*/ mnyam gzhag ye shes kun dang*/ sangs rgyas nas kyang rgyun chad ma myong zhing chad mi srid pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang sogs bslu ste/ 'dus byas yin pas skad cig gnyis par mi sdod pas so/ /bzhi pa ni/

gsung rab mthon po de dag las/ sangs rgyas sogs gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ sgrub sogs nas gsungs pa'i phyir te/ chos can bslu med 'di sogs gnyis rim pa bzhin snang ba'i dmigs yul dang 'dzin sogs phyir ro/ /de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyis yon tan rang chas su gzhi nas yod ces kyang gsungs pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ rnam dbyer bcas pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /glo bur dag gis khams stong gi /rnam dbye med pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /bla med chos kyis stong ma yin/ /zhes gzhi dus nas sangs rgyas yon tan de dag nus pa'am nyer len gyi tshul gyis gnas pa'i phyir te/ 'di sogs pas na ste/ rnam 'grel las kyang*/ blo ni de phyogs 'dzin phyir ro/ /zhes dang*/ rgyud blar/ nyes pa glo bur dang ldan dang*/ /yon tan rang bzhin nyid ldan phyir// zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar ro/ /bzhi pa la/ mdor bstan dang*/ rgyas bshad do/ dang po ni/ snying po 'di'i sogs la theg pa dang grub sogs bzhag ste/ phyir mi ldog pa 'khor lo'i mdo las nor bu mkhan mkhas pas dri ma je phrar sbyor ba'i dpes/ 'khor lo gsum dang sbyar zhing sngags ni gsum pa'i lam gyi grogs dang rgyab bsnon du sbyar te/ 'og ma rnams kyi steng du snon par 'dod pas/ 'khor lo tha ma dang sngags su dang po gnyis spong bar 'dod pa dang ches khyad par che bas ma 'khrul bar bya'o/ /mi snon par 'dor bar 'dod pa la ni/ dpe'i phyir rags pa rnams kyis tha ma la mi phan gyi steng du gnod par 'dod dgos par 'gyur ro/ /des na 'khor lo dang po ni gnas skabs gsum gyi dang po dang*/ tha ma gnyis ni/ gnas skabs gnyis pa la don dam tshad mas dpyad pa dang tha snyad pas cung zad dpyad pa'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /de ltar na 'dul ba dang mdo sde dang rdo rje theg pa rnams kyi dngos bstan gyi spang bya 'khor ba rags pa dang phra ba dang shin tu phra ba gsum dang nyon mongs kyi nyon mongs/

las kyi nyon mongs/ skye ba'i nyon mongs te kun nyon gsum dang*/ rang bzhin gyi sdig pa lus ngag gi bdun dang*/ yid kyi gsum dang*/ de gsum gyi chags khyad par can te gsum rnams rim pa bzhin yin la/ gsum po 'di las gdul bya dman pa so so thar pa'i dang 'bring byang chub sems dpa'i dang mchog rdo rje theg pa'i gdul bya gsum du bzhag par shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la/ rnam gzhag gsum tshan gsum bshad pa/ de'i gsal kha gsar byung du bstan pa/ de ltar 'chad dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan bshad pa/ sngags lam rgyas pa gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /dang po ni/ spyir 'khor ba gsum gyi nang nas rags pa'i mtshan gzhi ni/ dag pa rnam byang gi zlas drangs pa'i ma dag las nyon gyis bskyed pa'i skye 'chi yin te/ de gang la ldan pa'i nyan rang dgra bcom lhag bcas pa man dang theg chen gyi sbyor lam chos mchog pa man chad ni/ rags pa'i 'khor ba pa'o/ /ya ma bral ba de dag la las nyon gyis skye ba gsar len med kyang*/ zag bcas las kyis 'phangs pa'i rnam smin gyi phung po 'dor ma nus par rgyud la ldan pa'i cha nas 'jog go /'khor ba rags pa 'di'i rtsa ba ni nyon mongs bden 'dzin dang mtshungs par ldan pa can gyi rmongs pa ma rig pa yin pas/ nyan rang dgra bcom gyis 'khor ba'i rtsa ba bcad pa'i sgo nas rnam par grol yang sdug bsngal dang las kyi kun 'byung gi lhag ma dang bcas pa'o/ /'khor ba phra ba'i mtshan gzhi ni yid kyi rang bzhin lus thob pa'i dag pa rnam par byang ba'i skye 'chi yin te/ nyan rang lhag med du zhugs pa dang byang sems mthong lam thob zin nas sa bcu pa la gnas pa'i bar ro/ /'di dag gis las nyon gyi skye 'chi zad par spangs te/ 'phags pas 'chi dang na ba dang*/ /rga ba'i sdug bsngal rtsad nas spangs| |las dang nyon mongs dbang gis skye/ /de la de med phyir de med/

/ ces sogs rgya cher gsungs pa bzhin no/ /'khor ba 'di'i rtsa ba ni bka' 'khor lo tha mar gsungs pa'i ma rig bag chags kyi'o/ /des na ma rig bag chags kyi sa'i nyon mongs dang zag pa med pa'i las dang*/ yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus dang bsam gyis mi khyab par bsgyur ba'i 'chi 'pho rnams la dag pa rnam byang gi skye 'chi zhes bya la/ /de yang sa bcu pa'i bar du je phrar 'gro ba zhig sangs rgyas kyi sar ma lus par spangs pas rtag brtan zhi ba g.yung drung dang gtsang bde rtag bdag gi pha rol du phyin pa zhes 'khor lo tha ma'i mdo dang bstan bcos las rgya cher gsungs so/ /'khor ba shin tu phra ba ni rang lam gyi sgrib gnyis ma lus par spangs kyang rang lam du sbas pa sngags lam du phyung ba'i bem chos phra mo ma spangs pa phar phyin theg pa rkyang ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yin te 'di'i thugs rgyud la rdo rje theg par bstan pa'i gnyen po'i mthar thug bde chen gyi ye shes ma 'khrungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'khor ba 'di'i rtsa ba ni rlung dang khams 'pho ba'i chags pa'am 'gyur ba de phra mo yin te/ de phyir 'bad pa thams cad kyis 'pho ba'i chags pa rnam par spang*/ zhes sogs mang du gsungs la| de yang spang bya nyi khri chig stong drug brgya/ stong brgyad brgya pa phrag bcu gnyis su bsdus pa/ gnyis po mi 'gyur ba'i bde chen de grangs de snyed kyis spang bya'i sa bon rnams bcom nas/ rdo rje snying po rgyan rgyud sogs nas gsungs pa'i| sa dang po kun tu 'od dang*/ gnyis pa zla ba'i 'od dang*/ gsum pa nyi ma'i 'od la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i sa bcu gnyis rim pa bzhin du skyed par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'di la rgya bod kyi mkhas pa phal cher/ sngags la ma brten par phar phyin theg pa rkyang pas kyang 'tshang rgya bar bzhed pa ni legs pa yin te/ nyan rang rkyang pa'i lam gyis dgra bcom thob pa bzhin no/

/des na theg pa mtha' dag la bltos pa'i mthar thug gi sangs rgyas 'thob par bzhed pa ni mi legs te| nyan rang rkyang pa'i lam gyis mthar thug gi dgra bcom mi thob pa bzhin no| |des na sems 'grel skor gsum dang*/ 'jam dpal zhal lung sogs las sngags lam gyi snon pa med par phar phyin theg pa rkyang pas mthar thug gi sangs rgyas mi 'thob par gsungs pa la brten nas/ phyis kyi mkhas pa dgaphar phyin theg pa rkyang pa'i sangs rgyas tsam yang mi srid de/ spang bya shing tu phra ba ni phar phyin rnam bshad pa'i rgyun mtha'i dri ma phra mo yin la/ de sgom lam chen po'i chen pos spong bar ma nus nas sngags lam snon pa yin pas 'o skol gyi ston pas sa bcu pa'i ye shes brnyed zin pa'i rjes su sangs rgyas rnams kyis bskul nas/ rim pa bzhi pa'i 'od gsal zhes bya ba sngags kyi mthong lam dang*/ de'i rjes su slob pa'i zung 'jug ces bya ba sgom lam ste rim bde gnyis/ phar phyin theg pa'i lam mthar thug gi mthar bsnan pa yin pas/ phar phyin theg pa ba sngags la 'jug pa'i ma mtha' nges pa med kyang*/ ya mtha' ba ni sa bcu pa las mtho mi srid pa dang*/ de sngags la 'jug na sngags kyi tshogs sbyor gyi don thub legs par grub zin pas mthong lam las dma' mi srid pa yin no zhes pa 'di rnams legs bshad khyad par can du grags mod/ 'di la ni/ sgom lam chen po'i chen pos ngo skal gyi spang bya spong mi nus na/ sgom lam gzhan brgyad kyis kyang mi nus par thal ba dang*/ phar phyin theg pa la byang chub med na de la dmigs pa'i sems bskyed log shes su thal ba dang*/ sngags kyi mthong lam yin na rang lam gyi tshogs sbyor sngon du song bas khyab par thal ba dang*/ kun tu 'od las gong na sa gzhan med na de ma mthar byas pa'i sa bcu gnyis mi 'thad par thal ba dang*/ sngags la phar phyin na med pa'i gnyen po zhig yod na de 'dra'i spang bya zhig yod par thal ba rnams rtags gsal dngos 'gal gyi thal 'gyur|

khyab pa la sangs rgyas kyis kyang skyon mi rnyed pa yin na ji ltar legs bshad du 'gyur gzu bo'i rnam dpyod kyis rtogs shig rgyu mtshan de dag 'khrul ba med pa de'i phyir 'og sogs btsal dgos la/ dgos pa de'i phyir nyan sogs 'gal te/ rgyu mtshan kun nas kun tu mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du| nyon mongs kyi dang las kyi dang skye ba'i nyon mongs gsum po rim pa bzhin du 'dul sogs gtso bo yin te/ rim pa bzhin du/ rtsa ba nyon mongs nyid spang dgos kyi sdug bsngal gyi phung po grub zin spang mi nus shing*/ las sgrib sbyong ba yang las zad dub pa don med du gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ las kyi sgrib pa yang ched du gnyer nas sbyang dgos shing*/ sbyang thabs kyang stobs bzhi'i bshags pa sogs du ma gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ tha mal rnam rtog rgyun las ma gtogs pa'i| |'khor ba'i sdug bsngal zhes bya gzhan med pas/ /de dang rnam pa 'gal bar gyur pa'i sems/ /de ni mngon sum nyid du rtogs par bya/ /zhes tha mal snang zhen gyi rtog pa nyid 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi mtshan gzhi yin la/ de bskyed rim nyid kyis kyang 'dzin stangs 'gal ba'i sgo nas sdug bsngal gyi phung po sangs rgyas kyi skur bsgyur ba'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du sdig pa gzugs sogs gsum dang de gsum gyi cha shas khyad par can bla ma'i rdzas dang chung ma sogs la brnab sems dang*/ bla ma la gnod par sems pa dang*/ rang bzhin dag pa'i chos la som nyi za ba sogs rnams rim pa bzhin du de gsum gyi spang bya'i gtso bo yin te/ 'dul ba nas lus ngag gi bdun la gnang ba gtan mi srid cing yid kyi gsum la sdig pa 'byung yang ltung bar ma bcas pa'i phyir dang*/ byang sems la/ snying brtser bcas na mi dge med/ /ces lus ngag gi bdun la gnang ba yod cing yid kyi gsum po'i cha shas tsam yang ma gnang bar ltung ba yang de gsum gyi steng du bcas pa'i phyir dang*/

sngags la dbang dang drag po'i las kyi tshe rang don cung zad 'dres srid kyang gzhan gyi lus srog longs spyod la dus kyi kun slong gi cha brnab sems dang gnod sems dang sems can sangs rgyas su sgom pa sogs gnang bar ma zad sgrub dgos la/ yul khyad par can la brten pa rnams nan gyis bkag pa'i phyir ro/ / gnyis pa ni/ ji skad bshad pa'i rnam gzhag 'di dag thub pa'i bstan pa 'di la don steng na gnas te/ bshad ma thag pa'i rgyu mtshan rnams rgyal ba'i dgongs pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de lta mod kyi 'khor ba gsum la sogs gsal bar dngos su thon pa'i rnam dpyod rang la ldan kyang gzhan ngor ston mkhan ni sngar ma byung ste/ rgyan drug mchog gnyis kyis kyang ma mdzad pa'i phyir ro/ /de phyir sogs ni rlom sems dang zhum sems gnyis kas bskyed pa'i tshig go / gsum pa ni/ sngar gyi 'dod pa la gnod byed brjod pa ste/ mdo sngags 'bras bu sangs rgyas 'grub pa la nye lam dang ring lam tsam du bzung bar bya'i sngags kyi snon pa dgos par ma smras shing*/ gal te sngags nas sgos su gsungs pa'i gnyen po bde chen des spang bya'i sa bon zhig spong dgos pa yin na ni mdo phyogs su ma bshad pa'i spang bya zhig kyang yod dgos pas mdo sder sogs rtogs so/ /bzhi pa ni/ rdo rje sogs te/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i spyi don chen mo bstan pa'i rgya mtsho sogs la blta bar bya'o/ /grub sogs le'u lnga pa bshad pa'o// // gsum pa bshad pa mthar phyin pa'i bya ba la/ bka' drin gyi phyag bya/ gzhung 'dir 'jug par gdams pa/ de'i rgyu mtshan brjod pa/ nongs pa bzod par gsol ba/ dge rtsa gzhan la bsngo ba/ gzhung byed kyi ming dus bstan pa rnams te rtog par sla'o/ /gang gi drin las srid zhi'i snang ba kun/ gti mug gnyid kyis bslad pa'i rmi lam ste/ /gnyid sad tshe na spros kun nyer zhi ba/ /legs rtogs blo mchog stsol der phyag bgyid do/

/rmongs chen gnyid kyis bslad pa'i rmi lam dang*| |las nyon sngags kyis bskyed pa'i sgyu ma dang*/ /dngos 'dzin gdon gyis gzir ba'i smra brjod la/ /bden par rlom pa'i ma rgan 'gro ba rnams// thog med dus nas 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor g.yengs/ /sdug bsngal chu srin chen pos yang yang gtses/ /bzod dka' ngan 'gro'i klong 'khor nang du lhung*/ /'di dag 'khrul ba'i snang bas bslus mthong nas/ /'khrul bral rgyal ba'i gsung la gces par bzung*/ /'phags mchog shing rta che rnams bzhed pa'i gzhung*// nyin mtshan chad pa med par rgyun du sbyangs/ khyad par klu sgrub gzhung mchog snying la bcangs/ /rang gzhan grub mtha' rgya mtsho che brgal nas/ /mtha' bral bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po rnyed/ /lung dang rig pa'i byi dor cher byas te// thub bstan rgyan mtshan rtse la legs par bkod/ /phan bde 'dod rgu'i char chen phab pa 'di/ /yang dag lta ba'i 'byor pa 'dod la sogs/ /don gnyer skye bo kun gyis longs spyod mdzod/ /lta ngan dbul phongs mtha' dag zhi gyur cig/ 'dir 'bad dge dang rang gzhan dge ba yi/ /nyin byed dbang po lhag bsam rta bdun gyis/ /thub bstan mkha' la thogs med drangs nas ni/ /lta ngan mun pa mtha' dag sel gyur cig /dge legs kun 'byung dpal ldan bla ma dang*/ / dngos grub kun stsol skyabs gsum lhag pa'i lha/ /bar chad kun sel mthu ldan srung ma ste/ /mchod 'os kun gyis bkra shis dge legs mdzod/ /ces grub mtha' kun shes kyi rnam par bshad pa legs bshad kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba 'di/ lung dang rig pa'i dpal 'byor gyis rnam par rtse ba'i bshes gnyen du mas bskul nas/ rtsa ba byed pa po rang nyid kyis rgyas bsdus 'bring po tsam du legs par sbyar ba dge bar gyur cig/ //shes byar srid kun mang thos gser sgong du/ /rnam dpyod drod kyis smin pa tshangs pa'i spun/ /'jig rten mig gcig stag tshang lo tsā ba/

/nges pa don ldan ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta/ /gang gi phyi nang grub mtha'i dbye ba dang*/ /sgra tshad bzo gso nang don rig pa'i tshogs/ /kun gyi gnas lugs mtsho las byad ltar du// mthong nus glegs bam 'di kos chos rnams shes/ /rmongs zhes mun pa'i khung bur bag phab nas/ /phyogs lhung lce gnyis rkyong min blo gros bya/ /gtsug lag nam mkha'i pha mtha' gzhal 'dod pa'i/ /gzur gnas blo ldan kun dga' skyes pa'i yul/ /sngon byon mkhas pa'i legs bshad yid bzhin nor/ /lam kha'i rdo ba lta bur 'dor byas nas/ /deng dus cher rlom ngag sgros mching bu la/ /rin thang gzhal ba'i tshul des mchi ma dku/ /'on te blang dor shes pa srid pa'i phyir| |dpyod ldan mang por phan 'dod lhag bsam gyis/ /tshad med chos sbyin spel 'bras tshe rabs kun/ /gsal myur zab pa'i shes rab 'thob par shog/ces 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i rig gnas kun shes dang grub mtha' kun zhes rtsa 'grel gnyis kyi par blo gsal mang por phan 'dod kyi bsam pas kun nas bslangs te dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du par du brkos pa'i tshe za hor gyi ban+des sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni chang khyim pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtse'o// // maṅga laṃ/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyi bka' 'bum/kun shes las rnam par bshad pa legs bshad kyi rgya mtsho/ -PAGE 124--PAGE 123-- PAGE 121-
